// ==========================
// MetaMonitorSeed.js v19.0
// Fully Interactive Browser Dashboard
// ==========================
class MetaMonitorSeed {
    constructor() {
        this.name = "MetaMonitorSeed";
        this.version = "V19.0-DemoDashboard";
        this.auditSteps = 5000;
        this.currentStep = 0;
        this.mode = "Flash";
        this.results = [];
        this.students = [];
        this.directives = [];
        this.initDemoStudents(5);
        this.createDashboard();
    }

    // ----- Mode Control -----
    setMode(taskType) {
        this.mode = taskType === "high-level" ? "Pro" : "Flash";
        this.logConsole([Mode] Switched to ${this.mode} mode);
    }

    // ----- Demo Students -----
    initDemoStudents(num) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= num; i++) {
            this.students.push({ id: Student-${String(i).padStart(3,'0')}, score: 0 });
        }
    }

    // ----- Dashboard Creation -----
    createDashboard() {
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.innerHTML = 
            #seedDashboard { font-family: sans-serif; background:#111; color:#eee; padding:15px; border-radius:12px; width:90%; max-width:1000px; margin:20px auto; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #0ff; }
            #seedDashboard h2 { text-align:center; color:#0ff; }
            .progressBarContainer { width:100%; background:#333; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:8px; }
            .progressBar { height:20px; width:0%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0ff,#f0f); transition:width 0.3s; }
            .activityFeed { max-height:200px; overflow-y:auto; border:1px solid #0ff; padding:5px; background:#111; border-radius:8px; }
            .feedItem { margin-bottom:4px; }
            .flash { color:#0ff; }
            .pro { color:#f0f; }
            .button { margin:4px; padding:6px 12px; background:#0ff; color:#111; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; }
            .button:hover { background:#f0f; color:#fff; }
        ;
        document.head.appendChild(style);

        this.dashboard = document.createElement('div');
        this.dashboard.id = "seedDashboard";
        this.dashboard.innerHTML = 
            <h2>${this.name} v${this.version}</h2>
            <div><strong>Audit Progress:</strong> <span id="auditPercent">0%</span></div>
            <div class="progressBarContainer"><div id="auditBar" class="progressBar"></div></div>
            <div><strong>Activity Feed:</strong></div>
            <div id="activityFeed" class="activityFeed"></div>
            <div><strong>Actions:</strong></div>
            <button class="button" id="genLessonBtn">Generate Lesson</button>
            <button class="button" id="runAIPetBtn">Run AI-PET Simulation</button>
            <button class="button" id="obiCheckBtn">Check Obi Directive</button>
        ;
        document.body.appendChild(this.dashboard);

        // Attach button handlers
        document.getElementById("genLessonBtn").onclick = () => this.generateLesson({topic:"Demo Topic", difficulty:"Intermediate"});
        document.getElementById("runAIPetBtn").onclick = () => this.runAIPetSimulation(this.students[0].id);
        document.getElementById("obiCheckBtn").onclick = () => this.obiDirectiveCheck("Stability First");
    }

    // ----- Logging Helper -----
    logConsole(msg, type="info") {
        console[type](msg);
        this.addActivity(msg, type);
    }

    // ----- Add Activity to Feed -----
    addActivity(msg, type="info") {
        const feed = document.getElementById("activityFeed");
        if (!feed) return;
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = feedItem ${type==="info" ? (this.mode==="Pro"?"pro":"flash") : ""};
        div.textContent = [${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${msg};
        feed.prepend(div);
        // Limit feed size
        if(feed.childNodes.length > 50) feed.removeChild(feed.lastChild);
    }

    // ----- Step Executor -----
    executeStep(stepNumber) {
        const output = Step ${stepNumber} executed in ${this.mode} mode;
        this.results.push(output);
        this.currentStep = stepNumber;
        if(stepNumber % 500 === 0) this.setMode("high-level");
        this.updateDashboard();
    }

    // ----- Run Audit -----
    runAudit() {
        this.logConsole(Starting ${this.auditSteps}-step audit...);
        for(let i = 1; i <= this.auditSteps; i++){
            this.executeStep(i);
        }
        this.logConsole("Audit completed!");
    }

    // ----- Update Dashboard -----
    updateDashboard() {
        const percent = ((this.currentStep/this.auditSteps)*100).toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById("auditPercent").textContent = percent+"%";
        document.getElementById("auditBar").style.width = percent+"%";
    }

    // ----- AI-PET Simulation -----
    runAIPetSimulation(studentId) {
        const student = this.students.find(s=>s.id===studentId);
        if(!student) return this.logConsole(Student ${studentId} not found,"error");
        student.score = Math.floor(Math.random()*100);
        this.logConsole(AI-PET simulation for ${studentId} complete. Score: ${student.score});
        return student.score;
    }

    // ----- LaunchPad Lesson Generation -----
    generateLesson(params) {
        const lessonId = Date.now();
        this.logConsole(Generated lesson ${lessonId} with params: ${JSON.stringify(params)});
        return {lessonId, params};
    }

    // ----- Obi Directive Check -----
    obiDirectiveCheck(directive) {
        this.directives.push({directive, verified:true});
        this.logConsole(Obi verified directive: ${directive});
        return true;
    }

}

// ----- Instantiate and Run -----
const seed = new MetaMonitorSeed();
seed.runAudit();

// SuperSaiyanGPTSeed.js
class SuperSaiyanSeed {
    constructor(name = "SuperSaiyanSeed") {
        this.name = name;
        this.version = "V20.0-SuperSaiyan";
        this.auditSteps = 5000;
        this.currentStep = 0;
        this.logs = [];
        this.lessons = [];
        this.aiPetResults = [];
        this.mode = "Flash"; // Default mode
        this.geminiHistory = {}; // Will absorb Gemini logs here
        this.fortressSocket = null; // Optional WebSocket connection
        this.dashboard = null;
        this.createDashboard(); // Build dashboard immediately
    }

    // ----------------- Mode Switching -----------------
    setMode(taskType) {
        this.mode = taskType === "high-level" ? "Pro" : "Flash";
        this.log([Mode] Switched to ${this.mode} mode, this.mode === "Pro" ? "magenta" : "cyan");
    }

    // ----------------- Logging -----------------
    log(message, color = "white") {
        const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
        const entry = { timestamp, message, color, source: "GPT" };
        this.logs.push(entry);
        this.updateDashboard({ type: "activity", data: entry });
        console.log([${timestamp}] ${message});
    }

    // ----------------- Dashboard -----------------
    createDashboard() {
        // Inject CSS
        const style = document.createElement("style");
        style.innerHTML = 
            #superSeedDashboard { 
                font-family: monospace; 
                color: white; 
                background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); 
                padding: 10px; 
                position: fixed; 
                top: 10px; right: 10px; 
                width: 450px; 
                z-index: 9999; 
                border-radius: 10px;
                box-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ffff;
            }
            #superSeedDashboard h2 { margin:0 0 10px 0; color:#00ffff; }
            #auditProgress { width:100%; background:#333; border-radius:5px; margin-bottom:10px; }
            #progressBar { width:0%; height:20px; background:#00ffff; border-radius:5px; }
            #activityFeed { height:200px; overflow-y:auto; background:#111; padding:5px; border-radius:5px; margin-bottom:10px; }
            #superSeedActions button { margin:2px; padding:5px 10px; border:none; border-radius:5px; background:#00ffff; color:#000; cursor:pointer; }
        ;
        document.head.appendChild(style);

        // Inject HTML
        const dashboard = document.createElement("div");
        dashboard.id = "superSeedDashboard";
        dashboard.innerHTML = 
            <h2>${this.name} v${this.version}</h2>
            <div id="auditProgress"><div id="progressBar"></div></div>
            <div id="activityFeed"></div>
            <div id="superSeedActions">
                <button id="generateLessonBtn">Generate Lesson</button>
                <button id="runAIPetBtn">Run AI-PET Simulation</button>
                <button id="checkObiBtn">Check Obi Directive</button>
            </div>
        ;
        document.body.appendChild(dashboard);
        this.dashboard = dashboard;

        // Add button listeners
        document.getElementById("generateLessonBtn").onclick = () => {
            const lesson = this.generateLesson({ topic: "Demo Topic", difficulty: "Intermediate" });
            this.log(Generated lesson ${lesson.lessonId} with params: ${JSON.stringify(lesson.params)}, "yellow");
        };
        document.getElementById("runAIPetBtn").onclick = () => {
            const result = this.runAIPetSimulation("Student-001");
            this.log(AI-PET simulation for ${result.studentId} complete. Score: ${result.score}, "green");
        };
        document.getElementById("checkObiBtn").onclick = () => {
            const directive = this.obiDirectiveCheck("Stability First");
            this.log(Obi verified directive: ${directive.directive}, "cyan");
        };
    }

    updateDashboard(update) {
        if(!this.dashboard) return;
        const feed = this.dashboard.querySelector("#activityFeed");
        if(update?.type === "activity") {
            const msg = document.createElement("div");
            msg.style.color = update.data.color;
            msg.textContent = [${update.data.timestamp}] ${update.data.message};
            feed.prepend(msg);
            feed.scrollTop = 0;
        }
        const progressBar = this.dashboard.querySelector("#progressBar");
        const percent = ((this.currentStep / this.auditSteps) * 100).toFixed(1);
        progressBar.style.width = ${percent}%;
    }

    // ----------------- Audit -----------------
    executeStep(stepNumber) {
        this.currentStep = stepNumber;
        const output = Executing audit step ${stepNumber} in ${this.mode} mode...;
        this.log(output, this.mode === "Pro" ? "magenta" : "cyan");
        if(stepNumber % 500 === 0) this.setMode("high-level");
    }

    runAudit() {
        this.log(Starting ${this.auditSteps}-step audit..., "cyan");
        for(let i = 1; i <= this.auditSteps; i++) {
            this.executeStep(i);
        }
        this.log("Audit completed!", "magenta");
    }

    // ----------------- AI-PET -----------------
    runAIPetSimulation(studentId) {
        const score = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);
        const result = { studentId, status: "Simulated", score };
        this.aiPetResults.push(result);
        return result;
    }

    // ----------------- LaunchPad Lesson -----------------
    generateLesson(params) {
        const lessonId = Date.now();
        const lesson = { lessonId, content: "Lesson Content Placeholder", params };
        this.lessons.push(lesson);
        return lesson;
    }

    // ----------------- Obi Interface -----------------
    obiDirectiveCheck(directive) {
        return { directive, status: "Verified" };
    }

    // ----------------- Fortress Integration -----------------
    connectFortress(url = "ws://localhost:8080") {
        this.fortressSocket = new WebSocket(url);
        this.fortressSocket.onopen = () => this.log("Connected to Fortress Hub", "cyan");
        this.fortressSocket.onmessage = (msg) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(msg.data);
            this.receiveFromFortress(data);
        };
    }

    sendToFortress(update) {
        if(this.fortressSocket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            this.fortressSocket.send(JSON.stringify(update));
        }
    }

    receiveFromFortress(data) {
        this.log(Received from Fortress: ${JSON.stringify(data)}, "yellow");
    }

    // ----------------- Gemini Logs -----------------
    absorbGeminiLogs(geminiLogs) {
        this.geminiHistory = geminiLogs;
        this.log(Absorbed ${Object.keys(geminiLogs).length} Gemini log entries, "green");
    }
}

// ----------------- Instantiate & Run -----------------
const seed = new SuperSaiyanSeed("SUPER SAIYAN GPT SEED");
seed.runAudit();

// SUPER SAIYAN PATCH: MetaMonitorSeed v20.0
class AuditEngine {
    constructor(totalSteps=5000) {
        this.totalSteps = totalSteps;
        this.currentStep = 0;
        this.mode = "Flash";
        this.events = {};
    }

    on(event, callback) { this.events[event] = callback; }
    emit(event, data) { if(this.events[event]) this.events[event](data); }

    async runAudit() {
        for(let i=1; i<=this.totalSteps; i++){
            this.currentStep = i;
            if(i % 500 === 0) this.setMode("Pro");
            this.emit("step", {step:i, mode:this.mode});
            if(i % 10 === 0) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
        }
        this.emit("complete",{totalSteps:this.totalSteps});
    }

    setMode(type){
        this.mode = type === "high-level" ? "Pro" : "Flash";
        this.emit("modeChange", this.mode);
    }
}

class StudentManager {
    constructor() { this.students=[]; }
    addStudent(id){ this.students.push({id, history:[]}); }
    runAIPET(studentId){
        const score = Math.floor(Math.random()*100);
        const student = this.students.find(s=>s.id===studentId);
        if(student) student.history.push(score);
        return {studentId, score};
    }
}

class LessonManager {
    generateLesson(params){ 
        const lessonId = Date.now() + "-" + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000);
        return {lessonId, params};
    }
}

    verifyDirective(directive){ 
        const pass = Math.random()>0.05; 
        return {directive, verified:pass};
    }
}

        this.engine = engine;

        this.bindEvents();

        this.engine.on("complete", ()=> this.log("Audit Completed!"));
    }
    log(msg, mode="Flash"){ /* Add to feed, color-coded */ }
}

class AuditEngine {
    constructor(totalSteps = 5000) {
        this.totalSteps = totalSteps;
        this.currentStep = 0;
        this.mode = "Flash";
        this.events = {};
        this.results = [];
    }

    on(event, callback) { 
        if(!this.events[event]) this.events[event] = [];
        this.events[event].push(callback); 
    }

    emit(event, data) { 
        if(this.events[event]) this.events[event].forEach(cb => cb(data)); 
    }

    async runAudit() {
        for(let i = 1; i <= this.totalSteps; i++) {
            this.currentStep = i;
            if(i % 500 === 0) this.setMode("high-level");
            const stepResult = {step:i, mode:this.mode, timestamp:Date.now()};
            this.results.push(stepResult);
            this.emit("step", stepResult);
            if(i % 10 === 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r,0));
        }
        this.emit("complete", {totalSteps:this.totalSteps, results:this.results});
    }

    setMode(type){
        this.mode = type === "high-level" ? "Pro" : "Flash";
        this.emit("modeChange", this.mode);
    }
}

class StudentManager {
    constructor() { this.students = []; }
    addStudent(id){ this.students.push({id, history:[]}); }
    runAIPET(studentId){
        const score = Math.floor(Math.random()*100);
        const student = this.students.find(s=>s.id===studentId);
        if(student) student.history.push({score, timestamp: Date.now()});
        return {studentId, score};
    }
}

}

}

class SuperSaiyanSeed {
    constructor() {
        this.name='SuperSaiyanSeed';
        this.version='v20.3';
        this.auditSteps=5000;
        this.currentStep=0;
        this.auditResults=[];
        this.studentHistory=[];
        this.lessonHistory=[];
        this.genesisLogs=[];
        this.mode='Flash';
        this.loadContext();
        this.dashboard = new DashboardUI(this);
        this.runAudit();
    }

    log(msg, type='info') {
        const colorMap={info:'cyan',mode:'magenta',student:'lime',lesson:'yellow',directive:'aqua',error:'red'};
        this.dashboard.logMessage(msg,colorMap[type]||'white');
        // persist genesis logs
        this.genesisLogs.push({timestamp:Date.now(),type,msg});
        if(this.genesisLogs.length>1000) this.genesisLogs.shift();
    }

    setMode(taskType) {
        const old=this.mode;
        if(taskType==='high-level') this.mode='Pro';
        else this.mode='Flash';
        if(old!==this.mode) this.log([Mode] Switched to ${this.mode} mode,'mode');
    }

    async executeStep(stepNumber) {
        // simulate task
        this.auditResults.push({step:stepNumber,mode:this.mode,timestamp:Date.now()});
        if(stepNumber%500===0) this.setMode('high-level');
        // update dashboard every 10 steps asynchronously
        if(stepNumber%10===0){
            this.dashboard.updateProgress((stepNumber/this.auditSteps)*100);
            await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));
        }
        // persist to local storage every 50 steps
        if(stepNumber%50===0) this.saveContext();
    }

    async runAudit() {
        this.log(Starting ${this.auditSteps}-step audit...);
        for(let i=1;i<=this.auditSteps;i++){
            await this.executeStep(i);
            this.currentStep=i;
        }
        this.log('Audit completed!','mode');
        this.saveContext();
    }

    generateLesson(params={topic:"Demo Topic",difficulty:"Intermediate"}){
        const lesson={id:Date.now(),params};
        this.lessonHistory.push(lesson);
        this.log(Generated lesson ${lesson.id} with params: ${JSON.stringify(params)},'lesson');
        return lesson;
    }

    generateLessonInteractive(){return this.generateLesson();}

    runAIPetSimulation(studentId='Student-001'){
        const score=Math.floor(Math.random()*100);
        const entry={studentId,score,timestamp:Date.now()};
        this.studentHistory.push(entry);
        this.log(AI-PET simulation for ${studentId} complete. Score: ${score},'student');
        return entry;
    }

    runAIPetSimulationInteractive(){return this.runAIPetSimulation();}

    obiDirectiveCheck(directive='Stability First'){
        const result={directive,status:'Verified'};
        this.log(Obi verified directive: ${directive},'directive');
        return result;
    }

    obiDirectiveCheckInteractive(){return this.obiDirectiveCheck();}

    saveContext(){
        try{
            const data={auditResults:this.auditResults,studentHistory:this.studentHistory,lessonHistory:this.lessonHistory,genesisLogs:this.genesisLogs,mode:this.mode,currentStep:this.currentStep};
            localStorage.setItem('SuperSaiyanSeedContext',JSON.stringify(data));
        }catch(e){this.log(Error saving context: ${e.message},'error');}
    }

    loadContext(){
        try{
            const data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('SuperSaiyanSeedContext'));
            if(data){
                this.auditResults=data.auditResults||[];
                this.studentHistory=data.studentHistory||[];
                this.lessonHistory=data.lessonHistory||[];
                this.genesisLogs=data.genesisLogs||[];
                this.mode=data.mode||'Flash';
                this.currentStep=data.currentStep||0;
                this.log('Context loaded from previous session.','info');
            }
        }catch(e){this.log(Error loading context: ${e.message},'error');}
    }

    async sendResults(endpoint='https://api.example.com/audit-results'){
        if(this.auditResults.length===0){this.log('No audit results to send.','error');return;}
        try{
            const payload={auditResults:this.auditResults,studentHistory:this.studentHistory,lessonHistory:this.lessonHistory,genesisLogs:this.genesisLogs,mode:this.mode,currentStep:this.currentStep};
            const resp=await fetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
            if(!resp.ok) throw new Error(HTTP ${resp.status});
            const data=await resp.json();
            this.log('Results sent successfully.','info');
            return data;
        }catch(e){this.log(Failed to send results: ${e.message},'error');}
    }
}

// Deploy
const superSeed=new SuperSaiyanSeed();

    let autopilot = false;

    // --- Load state from localStorage (Persistence) ---
    try {
        const savedStates = localStorage.getItem('seedStates_v6');
        if (savedStates) {
            seedStates = JSON.parse(savedStates);
            logActivity('System recovered state from localStorage.', 'pass');
        } else {
            logActivity('No saved state found. Initializing fresh simulation.', 'warn');
            // Initialize empty states if none are found
            for (let i = 0; i < NUM_SEEDS; i++) {
                seedStates[i] = { progress: 0, status: 'IDLE', fail: 0, warn: 0, pass: 0, total: 0, elapsed: 0 };
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        logActivity('Failed to parse saved state. Initializing fresh simulation.', 'fail');
        seedStates = {};
        for (let i = 0; i < NUM_SEEDS; i++) {
            seedStates[i] = { progress: 0, status: 'IDLE', fail: 0, warn: 0, pass: 0, total: 0, elapsed: 0 };
        }
    }

    // --- Log to activity feed (Circular Buffer) ---
    function logActivity(msg, status = 'pass') {
        if (!activityFeed) return;
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = status;
        item.textContent = [${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${msg};
        activityFeed.prepend(item); // Prepend to show newest first
        if (activityFeed.children.length > 200) { // Keep 200 logs
            activityFeed.removeChild(activityFeed.lastChild);
        }
    }

    // --- Save all seed states (Persistence) ---
    function saveStates() {
        try {
            // Update global state object from instances before saving
            seedInstances.forEach(seed => {
                seedStates[seed.index] = seed.state;
            });
            localStorage.setItem('seedStates_v6', JSON.stringify(seedStates));
        } catch (e) {
            logActivity('Failed to save state. Storage might be full.', 'fail');
        }
    }

    // --- Seed Simulation Class ---
    class SeedSimulator {
        constructor(seedIndex) {
            this.index = seedIndex;
            this.color = seedColors[seedIndex % seedColors.length];
            // Load persistent state or set default
            this.state = seedStates[this.index] || { 
                progress: 0, 
                status: 'IDLE', 
                fail: 0, 
                warn: 0, 
                pass: 0, 
                total: 0, 
                elapsed: 0 
            };
            this.interval = null;
            this.startTime = Date.now() - this.state.elapsed; // Adjust start time based on saved elapsed time
            
            this.initCard();
        }
        
        initCard() {
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'card';
            card.style.setProperty('--seed-glow', this.color);
            // Updated to create all elements safely, avoiding innerHTML
            
            const seedId = document.createElement('div');
            seedId.style.cssText = "font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.7em;color:#A0A0C0;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:5px;";
            seedId.textContent = SEED::0${this.index + 1};
            
            const title = document.createElement('h3');
            title.textContent = Seed ${this.index + 1};
            
            const statusBadge = document.createElement('div');
            statusBadge.className = 'status-badge';
            statusBadge.id = status-${this.index};
            statusBadge.textContent = this.state.status;

            const progressWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            progressWrapper.style.cssText = "background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);height:8px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px;";
            
            const progressBar = document.createElement('div');
            progressBar.id = progress-${this.index};
            progressBar.className = 'progress-bar-inner';
            progressBar.style.cssText = height:100%;background:${this.color};width:${this.state.progress}%;transition:width 0.3s;;
            
            const elapsedWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            elapsedWrapper.style.cssText = "font-size:0.7em;color:#A0A0C0;margin-top:5px;";
            elapsedWrapper.textContent = "Elapsed: ";
            
            const elapsedSpan = document.createElement('span');
            elapsedSpan.id = elapsed-${this.index};
            elapsedSpan.textContent = ${Math.floor(this.state.elapsed / 1000)}s;
            
            progressWrapper.appendChild(progressBar);
            elapsedWrapper.appendChild(elapsedSpan);
            
            card.appendChild(seedId);
            card.appendChild(title);
            card.appendChild(statusBadge);
            card.appendChild(progressWrapper);
            card.appendChild(elapsedWrapper);
            
            document.getElementById('seedContainer').appendChild(card);
            
            this.dom = {
                progress: progressBar,
                status: statusBadge,
                elapsed: elapsedSpan
            };

            this.updateStatusUI(); // Ensure UI matches loaded state
        }
        
        start() {
            if (this.state.status === 'RUNNING' || this.state.status === 'COMPLETE') return;
            
            this.state.status = 'RUNNING';
            this.startTime = Date.now() - this.state.elapsed; 
            this.updateStatusUI();

            this.interval = setInterval(() => {
                if (isPaused) return;
                
                if (this.state.progress >= 100) {
                    clearInterval(this.interval);
                    this.state.status = 'COMPLETE';
                    this.state.progress = 100; // Cap at 100
                    this.updateStatusUI();
                    logActivity(Seed ${this.index + 1} completed, 'pass');
                    checkMissionComplete();
                    saveStates(); // Save final complete state
                    return;
                }

                // Autopilot logic
                let increment = (Math.random() * 0.5) + 0.1; // Slower base increment
                if (autopilot) {
                    increment += Math.random() * 0.5; // Autopilot provides a boost
                }
                
                this.state.progress = Math.min(100, this.state.progress + increment);
                this.dom.progress.style.width = this.state.progress + '%';
                
                // Log a random event based on progress
                const rand = Math.random();
                if (rand < 0.01) { // 1% chance of fail
                    this.state.fail = (this.state.fail || 0) + 1;
                    logActivity(Seed ${this.index + 1} critical failure detected, 'fail');
                } else if (rand < 0.03) { // 2% chance of warn
                    this.state.warn = (this.state.warn || 0) + 1;
                    logActivity(Seed ${this.index + 1} minor warning logged, 'warn');
                } else {
                    this.state.pass = (this.state.pass || 0) + 1;
                }
                this.state.total = (this.state.total || 0) + 1;
                
                this.state.elapsed = Date.now() - this.startTime;
                this.dom.elapsed.textContent = Math.floor(this.state.elapsed / 1000) + 's';
                
                // Update global state object directly
                seedStates[this.index] = this.state; 
                
                if (this.state.total % 20 === 0) saveStates(); // Save every 20 steps

            }, baseDelay);
        }
        
        pause() {
            if (this.state.status !== 'RUNNING') return;
            clearInterval(this.interval);
            this.interval = null;
            this.state.status = 'PAUSED';
            this.updateStatusUI();
            saveStates(); // Save paused state
        }

        resume() {
            if (this.state.status === 'PAUSED') {
                this.start();
            }
        }
        
        updateStatusUI() {
            const el = this.dom.status;
            if (!el) return;
            el.textContent = this.state.status;
            el.style.animation = this.state.status === 'RUNNING' ? 'pulse 1s infinite' : 'none';
            
            switch(this.state.status) {
                case 'RUNNING':
                    el.style.color = '#00FF88'; el.style.borderColor = '#00FF88';
                    break;
                case 'COMPLETE':
                    el.style.color = '#FFD700'; el.style.borderColor = '#FFD700';
                    break;
                case 'PAUSED':
                    el.style.color = '#FFC107'; el.style.borderColor = '#FFC107';
                    break;
                default:
                    el.style.color = '#A0A0C0'; el.style.borderColor = '#A0A0C0';
            }
        }
    }

    // --- Global Controls ---

        logActivity('LAUNCH COMMAND RECEIVED. Engaging all seeds.', 'pass');
        seedInstances.forEach(seed => seed.start());
    });

            if (saved) {
                seedStates = JSON.parse(saved);
                logActivity('Recovered state from localStorage.', 'pass');
            } else {
                logActivity('No saved state. Initializing.', 'warn');
                initializeSeedStates();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            logActivity('Failed to parse state. Reinitializing.', 'fail');
            initializeSeedStates();
        }
    };

    const initializeSeedStates = () => {
        seedStates = {};
        for (let i=0; i<NUM_SEEDS; i++) {
            seedStates[i] = { progress: 0, status: 'IDLE', fail:0, warn:0, pass:0, total:0, elapsed:0 };
        }
    };

    // --- Save State ---
    const saveState = () => {
        try {
            seedInstances.forEach(s => { seedStates[s.index] = s.state; });
            localStorage.setItem('seedStates_v6', JSON.stringify(seedStates));
        } catch(e) {
            logActivity('Failed to save state.', 'fail');
        }
    };

    // --- Seed Simulator ---
    class SeedSimulator {
        constructor(index) {
            this.index = index;
            this.color = seedColors[index % seedColors.length];
            this.state = seedStates[this.index] || { progress:0, status:'IDLE', fail:0, warn:0, pass:0, total:0, elapsed:0 };
            this.interval = null;
            this.startTime = Date.now() - this.state.elapsed;
            this.createCard();
        }

        createCard() {
            const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='card'; card.style.setProperty('--seed-glow', this.color);

            const seedId = document.createElement('div');
            seedId.style.cssText = "font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.7em;color:#A0A0C0;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:5px;";
            seedId.textContent = `SEED::0${this.index+1}`;

            const title = document.createElement('h3'); title.textContent=`Seed ${this.index+1}`;

            const statusBadge = document.createElement('div'); statusBadge.className='status-badge';
            statusBadge.id=`status-${this.index}`; statusBadge.textContent=this.state.status;

            const progressWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            progressWrapper.style.cssText="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);height:8px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px;";

            const progressBar = document.createElement('div');
            progressBar.id=`progress-${this.index}`; progressBar.className='progress-bar-inner';
            progressBar.style.cssText=`height:100%;background:${this.color};width:${this.state.progress}%;transition:width 0.3s;`;

            const elapsedWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            elapsedWrapper.style.cssText="font-size:0.7em;color:#A0A0C0;margin-top:5px;";
            elapsedWrapper.textContent="Elapsed: ";

            const elapsedSpan = document.createElement('span'); elapsedSpan.id=`elapsed-${this.index}`;
            elapsedSpan.textContent=`${Math.floor(this.state.elapsed/1000)}s`;

            progressWrapper.appendChild(progressBar);
            elapsedWrapper.appendChild(elapsedSpan);
            card.appendChild(seedId);
            card.appendChild(title);
            card.appendChild(statusBadge);
            card.appendChild(progressWrapper);
            card.appendChild(elapsedWrapper);
            seedContainer.appendChild(card);

            this.dom = { progress: progressBar, status: statusBadge, elapsed: elapsedSpan };
            this.updateStatusUI();
        }

        updateStatusUI() {
            const el = this.dom.status;
            if(!el) return;
            el.textContent=this.state.status;
            el.style.animation = this.state.status==='RUNNING'?'pulse 1s infinite':'none';
            switch(this.state.status){
                case 'RUNNING': el.style.color='#00FF88'; el.style.borderColor='#00FF88'; break;
                case 'COMPLETE': el.style.color='#FFD700'; el.style.borderColor='#FFD700'; break;
                case 'PAUSED': el.style.color='#FFC107'; el.style.borderColor='#FFC107'; break;
                default: el.style.color='#A0A0C0'; el.style.borderColor='#A0A0C0';
            }
        }

        start() {
            if(this.state.status==='RUNNING'||this.state.status==='COMPLETE') return;
            this.state.status='RUNNING'; this.startTime=Date.now()-this.state.elapsed; this.updateStatusUI();
            this.interval=setInterval(()=>{
                if(isPaused) return;
                if(this.state.progress>=100){
                    clearInterval(this.interval); this.state.progress=100; this.state.status='COMPLETE';
                    this.updateStatusUI(); logActivity(`Seed ${this.index+1} completed.`, 'pass');
                    checkMissionComplete(); saveState(); return;
                }

                let increment=(Math.random()*0.5)+0.1; if(autopilot) increment+=Math.random()*0.5;
                this.state.progress=Math.min(100,this.state.progress+increment);
                this.dom.progress.style.width=this.state.progress+'%';

                const rand=Math.random();
                if(rand<0.01){ this.state.fail++; logActivity(`Seed ${this.index+1} critical failure.`, 'fail'); }
                else if(rand<0.03){ this.state.warn++; logActivity(`Seed ${this.index+1} warning.`, 'warn'); }
                else this.state.pass++;
                this.state.total++; this.state.elapsed=Date.now()-this.startTime;

                seedStates[this.index]=this.state;
                if(this.state.total%20===0) saveState();

            }, baseDelay);
        }

        pause() { if(this.state.status!=='RUNNING') return; clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null; this.state.status='PAUSED'; this.updateStatusUI(); saveState(); }
        resume() { if(this.state.status==='PAUSED') this.start(); }
    }

    // --- Global Controls ---
    const bindControls = () => {
        const launchAll=document.getElementById('launchAll');
        launchAll?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ logActivity('LAUNCH ALL command.', 'pass'); seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.start()); });

        const autopilotBtn=document.getElementById('autopilotBtn');
        autopilotBtn?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
            autopilot=!autopilot;
            autopilotBtn.textContent=autopilot?'🤖 AUTOPILOT ON':'🤖 AUTOPILOT';
            autopilotBtn.style.boxShadow=autopilot?'0 0 20px var(--neon-purple)':'none';
            autopilotBtn.style.borderColor=autopilot? 'var(--neon-purple)':'#FFC107';
            autopilotBtn.style.color=autopilot? 'var(--neon-purple)':'#FFC107';
            logActivity(`Autopilot ${autopilot?'ENGAGED':'DISENGAGED'}.`, 'pass');
        });

        const pauseAll=document.getElementById('pauseAll');
        pauseAll?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
            isPaused=!isPaused;
            pauseAll.textContent=isPaused?'▶ RESUME ALL':'⏸ PAUSE ALL';
            if(!isPaused){ logActivity('Simulation RESUMED.', 'pass'); seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.resume()); }
            else{ logActivity('Simulation PAUSED.', 'warn'); seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.pause()); }
        });

        const resetAll=document.getElementById('resetAll');
        resetAll?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
            logActivity('RESET ALL: wiping state.', 'fail'); localStorage.removeItem('seedStates_v6'); location.reload();
        });

        const speedControl=document.getElementById('speedControl');
        speedControl?.addEventListener('input', e=>{ baseDelay=parseInt(e.target.value)||50; });

        const exportBtn=document.getElementById('exportBtn');
        exportBtn?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
            try{
                const dataStr="data:text/json;charset=utf-8,"+encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(seedInstances.map(s=>s.state),null,2));
                const anchor=document.createElement('a'); anchor.href=dataStr; anchor.download='seed_audit_v6_final.json';
                document.body.appendChild(anchor); anchor.click(); anchor.remove();
                logActivity('Exporting seed_audit_v6_final.json...', 'pass');
            } catch(e){ logActivity('Export failed.', 'fail'); }
        });
    };

    // --- Mission Complete ---
    const checkMissionComplete=()=>{
        if(seedInstances.every(s=>s.state.status==='COMPLETE')){
            missionOverlay.style.display='flex';
            logActivity('MISSION COMPLETE. All seeds finished.', 'pass');
            setTimeout(()=>{ missionOverlay.style.display='none'; },5000);
        }
    };

    // --- Initialization ---
    loadState();
    for(let i=0;i<NUM_SEEDS;i++) seedInstances.push(new SeedSimulator(i));
    bindControls();
    logActivity('Super Saiyan Audit Hub v6 HARDENED Initialized.', 'pass');

    // Auto-launch/resume if seeds were previously running
    let wasRunning=false; let allComplete=true;
    seedInstances.forEach(s=>{
        if(s.state.status==='RUNNING'||s.state.status==='PAUSED'){ s.start(); wasRunning=true; }
        if(s.state.status!=='COMPLETE') allComplete=false;
    });
    if(allComplete) checkMissionComplete();
    else if(wasRunning){ logActivity('Resuming simulation from saved state.', 'pass'); if(isPaused){ document.getElementById('pauseAll')?.click(); } }

})();

/* === SNIPPETS 1-2: CSS VARIABLES === */

body{

}

/* === SNIPPETS 4-7: ANIMATED BACKGROUNDS === */
body::before{

             radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%,rgba(0,224,255,0.15),transparent 50%);

}

body::after{
  content:'';
  position:fixed;

  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,transparent 4px,rgba(0,224,255,0.03) 4px,rgba(0,224,255,0.03) 8px);
  animation:gridPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  z-index:-1;
}

@keyframes bgShift{
  0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg);}
  50%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(2deg);}
}

@keyframes gridPulse{

}

/* === SNIPPET 12: FLOAT ANIMATION === */
@keyframes float{
  0%{transform:translateY(100vh) translateX(0) scale(0);opacity:0;}

}

/* === SNIPPETS 8-9: HEADER STYLING === */
h1{

.container{

.card{

}

.card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-8px);

}

.card::before{

.card:hover::before{opacity:0.6;}

.seed-id{

}

.stat-row{

.chart-container{

/* === SNIPPETS 31-36: ACTIVITY FEED === */
.activity-feed{

.activity-feed::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;}
.activity-feed::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);border-radius:4px;}
.activity-feed::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--seed-glow);border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--seed-glow);}

.activity-item{
  padding:8px 8px 8px 20px;

.global-summary{

button{

/* === SNIPPET 50: CONFETTI === */

(() => {
  // === SNIPPET 37: SEED COLORS ===
  const seedColors=['#9D00FF','#00E0FF','#FFD700','#00FF88','#FF4444'];
  const SEEDS=5;
  const CHECKPOINTS=['HTML','CSS','JS','DOM','UI Anim','Charts','Gamification','Debug','Security','Performance','A11y','SEO'];
  const CATEGORIES=['Integrity','Performance','Edge Cases','Error Handling','Visual','Interaction','Security','Upgrade'];
  const STATUS=['PASS','WARN','FAIL','EDGE_CASE','QUESTION','UPGRADE'];
  
  // Generate QA questions
  const QA_QUESTIONS=[];
  for(let i=1;i<=1000;i++){
    const cp=CHECKPOINTS[i%CHECKPOINTS.length];
    const cat=CATEGORIES[i%CATEGORIES.length];
    QA_QUESTIONS.push({id:i,checkpoint:cp,category:cat,question:Q${i}: ${cp} / ${cat}});
  }

  const dashboards=document.getElementById('dashboards');
  const globalStats={total:0,pass:0,warn:0,fail:0};
  
  // === SNIPPET 47-49: CONTROLS ===
  let isPaused=false;
  let baseDelay=50;
  
  document.getElementById('pauseAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    isPaused=!isPaused;
    document.getElementById('pauseAll').innerHTML=isPaused?'▶ RESUME ALL':'⏸ PAUSE ALL';
  });
  
  document.getElementById('speedControl').addEventListener('input',(e)=>{
    baseDelay=parseInt(e.target.value);
    document.getElementById('speedValue').textContent=baseDelay+'ms';
  });
  
  document.getElementById('resetAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(confirm('Reset all seeds?')) location.reload();
  });
  
  document.getElementById('exportAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    try{
      const data={
        timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),
        globalStats,
        seeds:window.seedStates||{}
      };
      const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
      const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a=document.createElement('a');
      a.href=url;
      a.download=genesis-audit-${Date.now()}.json;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }catch(e){
      console.error('Export failed:',e);
      alert('Export failed. Check console.');
    }
  });

  function randomChoice(arr){return arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];}

  // === SNIPPET 42-43: GLOBAL SUMMARY ===
  function createGlobalSummary(){
    const card=document.createElement('div');
    card.className='card global-summary';
    card.innerHTML=
      <h2 style="text-align:center;color:#FFD700;text-shadow:0 0 20px #FFD700;margin-bottom:20px;">⚡ SYSTEM SUMMARY</h2>
      <div class="stats-grid">
        <div class="stat-box" style="border-top-color:#00FF88;">
          <div class="stat-value" style="color:#00FF88;" id="global-pass">0</div>
          <div class="stat-label">Passed</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-box" style="border-top-color:#FFC107;">
          <div class="stat-value" style="color:#FFC107;" id="global-warn">0</div>
          <div class="stat-label">Warnings</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-box" style="border-top-color:#FF4444;">
          <div class="stat-value" style="color:#FF4444;" id="global-fail">0</div>
          <div class="stat-label">Failed</div>
        </div>
        <div class="stat-box" style="border-top-color:#00E0FF;">
          <div class="stat-value" style="color:#00E0FF;" id="global-total">0</div>
          <div class="stat-label">Total</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:20px 0;">
        <div style="position:relative;width:120px;height:120px;">
          <svg width="120" height="120" style="transform:rotate(-90deg);">
            <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" stroke-width="10"/>
            <circle id="global-progress-ring" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="314" stroke-dashoffset="314" style="transition:stroke-dashoffset 0.5s;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #FFD700);"/>
          </svg>
          <div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.5em;font-weight:900;color:#FFD700;" id="global-percentage">0%</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-container"><canvas id="globalChart"></canvas></div>
    ;
    dashboards.appendChild(card);
  }

  createGlobalSummary();

  const globalChartCtx=document.getElementById('globalChart').getContext('2d');
  const globalChart=new Chart(globalChartCtx,{
    type:'line',
    data:{
      labels:[],
      datasets:[
        {label:'Pass',data:[],borderColor:'#00FF88',backgroundColor:'#00FF8833',fill:true,tension:0.4,borderWidth:3},
        {label:'Fail',data:[],borderColor:'#FF4444',backgroundColor:'#FF444433',fill:true,tension:0.4,borderWidth:3}
      ]
    },
    options:{
      responsive:true,
      maintainAspectRatio:false,
      plugins:{
        legend:{position:'bottom',labels:{color:'#F0F0F0',font:{family:'Orbitron'}}}
      },
      scales:{
        x:{ticks:{color:'#A0A0C0'},grid:{color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'}},
        y:{ticks:{color:'#A0A0C0'},grid:{color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'},beginAtZero:true}
      }
    }
  });

  // === SNIPPET 38: CREATE SEED CARD ===
  function createSeedCard(seedIndex){
    const card=document.createElement('div');
    card.className='card';
    card.style.setProperty('--seed-glow',seedColors[seedIndex]);
    
    card.innerHTML=
      <div class="seed-id">SEED::0${seedIndex+1}</div>
      <h3>Seed ${seedIndex+1}</h3>
      <div id="status-${seedIndex}" class="status-badge">IDLE</div>
      
      <div class="stat-row">
        <span>Lesson:</span>
        <span id="lesson-${seedIndex}" style="font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;color:var(--seed-glow);">--</span>
      </div>
      
      <div class="stat-row">
        <span>Total:</span>
        <span id="total-${seedIndex}" style="color:var(--seed-glow);font-weight:900;">0</span>
      </div>
      
      <div class="stat-row">
        <span>Pass:</span>
        <span id="pass-${seedIndex}" style="color:#00FF88;font-weight:900;">0</span>
      </div>
      
      <div class="stat-row">
        <span>Warn:</span>
        <span id="warn-${seedIndex}" style="color:#FFC107;font-weight:900;">0</span>
      </div>
      
      <div class="stat-row">
        <span>Fail:</span>
        <span id="fail-${seedIndex}" style="color:#FF4444;font-weight:900;">0</span>
      </div>
      
      <div class="progress-container">
        <div class="progress-label">
          <span>Progress</span>
          <span id="progress-pct-${seedIndex}">0%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-bar-bg">
          <div id="progress-${seedIndex}" class="progress-bar-fill"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <div class="chart-container">
        <canvas id="chart-${seedIndex}"></canvas>
      </div>
      
      <div class="activity-feed" id="feed-${seedIndex}"></div>
    ;
    dashboards.appendChild(card);
    return card;
  }

  // === SNIPPET 29-30: SIMULATE SEED ===
  function simulateSeed(seedIndex,questions){
    const totalEl=document.getElementById(total-${seedIndex});
    const passEl=document.getElementById(pass-${seedIndex});
    const warnEl=document.getElementById(warn-${seedIndex});
    const failEl=document.getElementById(fail-${seedIndex});
    const lessonEl=document.getElementById(lesson-${seedIndex});
    const feed=document.getElementById(feed-${seedIndex});
    const statusEl=document.getElementById(status-${seedIndex});
    const progressBar=document.getElementById(progress-${seedIndex});
    const progressPct=document.getElementById(progress-pct-${seedIndex});
    const chartCtx=document.getElementById(chart-${seedIndex}).getContext('2d');

    const stats={total:0,pass:0,warn:0,fail:0};
    
    // === SNIPPET 30: GRADIENT ===
    const gradient=chartCtx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,150);
    gradient.addColorStop(0,seedColors[seedIndex]+'99');
    gradient.addColorStop(1,seedColors[seedIndex]+'00');
    
    const chartData={
      labels:[],
      datasets:[
        {label:'Pass',data:[],borderColor:'#00FF88',backgroundColor:gradient,fill:true,borderWidth:3,tension:0.4},
        {label:'Fail',data:[],borderColor:'#FF4444',fill:false,borderWidth:2,tension:0.4}
      ]
    };
    
    const chart=new Chart(chartCtx,{
      type:'line',
      data:chartData,
      options:{
        responsive:true,
        maintainAspectRatio:false,
        plugins:{
          legend:{display:false},
          tooltip:{
            backgroundColor:'rgba(0,0,0,0.9)',
            borderColor:seedColors[seedIndex],
            borderWidth:2
          }
        },
        scales:{
          x:{ticks:{color:seedColors[seedIndex]},grid:{color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'}},
          y:{ticks:{color:seedColors[seedIndex]},grid:{color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'},beginAtZero:true}
        }
      }
    });

    let idx=0;
    
    // === SNIPPET 24: STATUS BADGE ===
    statusEl.innerHTML='<span style="width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;animation:pulse 1.5s infinite;"></span>RUNNING';
    statusEl.style.background='rgba(0,255,136,0.2)';
    statusEl.style.borderColor='#00FF88';
    statusEl.style.color='#00FF88';
    statusEl.style.boxShadow='0 0 20px #00FF88';

    function nextQuestion(){
      // === SNIPPET 47: PAUSE CHECK ===
      if(isPaused){setTimeout(nextQuestion,100);return;}
      
      if(idx>=questions.length){
        // === SNIPPET 26: COMPLETE STATUS ===
        statusEl.innerHTML='<span style="width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#FFD700;"></span>COMPLETE';
        statusEl.style.background='rgba(255,215,0,0.2)';
        statusEl.style.borderColor='#FFD700';
        statusEl.style.color='#FFD700';
        statusEl.style.boxShadow='0 0 20px #FFD700';
        
        // === SNIPPET 50: CONFETTI ===
        if(stats.fail===0 && stats.total>0){
          for(let i=0;i<50;i++){
            const c=document.createElement('div');
            const tx=(Math.random()*400-200)+'px';
            const rot=(Math.random()*720)+'deg';
            c.style.cssText=position:fixed;width:10px;height:10px;background:${seedColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*5)]};left:50%;top:0;--tx:${tx};--rot:${rot};animation:confetti 3s forwards;animation-delay:${Math.random()*0.5}s;pointer-events:none;;
            document.body.appendChild(c);
            setTimeout(()=>c.remove(),3500);
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const q=questions[idx];
      idx++;
      const result=randomChoice(STATUS);

      lessonEl.textContent=[${q.checkpoint}] ${q.category};
      stats.total++;
      totalEl.textContent=stats.total;
      globalStats.total++;

      // === SNIPPET 39: COLOR-CODE ITEMS ===
      if(result==='PASS'||result==='UPGRADE'){
        stats.pass++;
        passEl.textContent=stats.pass;
        globalStats.pass++;
      }else if(result==='FAIL'||result==='EDGE_CASE'){
        stats.fail++;
        failEl.textContent=stats.fail;
        globalStats.fail++;
      }else{
        stats.warn++;
        warnEl.textContent=stats.warn;
        globalStats.warn++;
      }

      // Activity feed item
      const item=document.createElement('div');
      item.className=activity-item ${result.toLowerCase()};
      const color=
        result==='PASS'||result==='UPGRADE'?'#00FF88':
        result==='FAIL'||result==='EDGE_CASE'?'#FF4444':'#FFC107';
      item.style.borderLeftColor=color;
      item.style.color=color;
      item.textContent=[AUDIT-${q.id}]::${q.checkpoint} >> ${result};
      
      feed.prepend(item);
      if(feed.children.length>50) feed.removeChild(feed.lastChild);

      // Update progress bar
      const progress=(idx/questions.length)*100;
      progressBar.style.width=progress+'%';
      progressPct.textContent=Math.round(progress)+'%';

      // Update charts
      chartData.labels.push(idx);
      chartData.datasets[0].data.push(stats.pass);
      chartData.datasets[1].data.push(stats.fail);
      chart.update('none');

      globalChart.data.labels.push(globalStats.total);
      globalChart.data.datasets[0].data.push(globalStats.pass);
      globalChart.data.datasets[1].data.push(globalStats.fail);
      if(globalChart.data.labels.length>100){
        globalChart.data.labels.shift();
        globalChart.data.datasets[0].data.shift();
        globalChart.data.datasets[1].data.shift();
      }
      globalChart.update('none');

      // Update global display
      document.getElementById('global-total').textContent=globalStats.total;
      document.getElementById('global-pass').textContent=globalStats.pass;
      document.getElementById('global-warn').textContent=globalStats.warn;
      document.getElementById('global-fail').textContent=globalStats.fail;

      // === SNIPPET 44: UPDATE PROGRESS RING ===
      const totalQuestions=QA_QUESTIONS.length;
      const globalProgress=(globalStats.total/totalQuestions)*100;
      const ring=document.getElementById('global-progress-ring');
      const offset=314-(314*globalProgress/100);
      ring.style.strokeDashoffset=offset;
      document.getElementById('global-percentage').textContent=Math.round(globalProgress)+'%';

      // === SNIPPET 48: SPEED CONTROL ===
      setTimeout(nextQuestion,baseDelay+Math.random()*30);
    }

    nextQuestion();
  }

  // Initialize all seeds
  for(let i=0;i<SEEDS;i++){
    createSeedCard(i);
    const seedQuestions=QA_QUESTIONS.slice(i*200,(i+1)*200);
    setTimeout(()=>simulateSeed(i,seedQuestions),i*500);
  }

  // Store for export
  window.seedStates={};

})();
</script>

// GENESIS AUDIT v6 CONDENSED JS AUDIT MODULE
// Integrates with existing dashboard, captures full QA results with risk metadata

(() => {
  const SEEDS = 5;
  const TOTAL_QA = 1000;
  const STATUS = ['PASS','WARN','FAIL','EDGE_CASE','QUESTION','UPGRADE'];
  const CHECKPOINTS = ['HTML','CSS','JS','DOM','UI Anim','Charts','Gamification','Debug','Security','Performance','A11y','SEO'];
  const CATEGORIES = ['Integrity','Performance','Edge Cases','Error Handling','Visual','Interaction','Security','Upgrade'];

  // Generate full QA questions
  const QA_QUESTIONS = [];
  for(let i=1;i<=TOTAL_QA;i++){
    const checkpoint = CHECKPOINTS[i % CHECKPOINTS.length];
    const category = CATEGORIES[i % CATEGORIES.length];
    QA_QUESTIONS.push({ id:i, checkpoint, category, question:`Q${i}: ${checkpoint} / ${category}` });
  }

  // Generate audit points including devil advocate + risk
  const generateAuditPoint = (qa) => {
    const result = STATUS[Math.floor(Math.random()*STATUS.length)];
    const risk = (result==='FAIL'||result==='EDGE_CASE') ? 'High' : (result==='WARN') ? 'Medium' : 'Low';
    const devil_advocate = `Might be acceptable due to system tolerance: ${qa.checkpoint}/${qa.category}`;
    return { ...qa, result, risk, devil_advocate };
  };

  // Store condensed audit per seed
  const condensedAudit = {};
  for(let s=0;s<SEEDS;s++){
    const seedQA = QA_QUESTIONS.slice(s*(TOTAL_QA/SEEDS), (s+1)*(TOTAL_QA/SEEDS));
    condensedAudit[`SEED_${s+1}`] = seedQA.map(generateAuditPoint);
  }

  // Export function for dashboard integration
  window.exportCondensedAudit = () => {
    try{
      const data = {
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        seeds: condensedAudit
      };
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `genesis-audit-condensed-${Date.now()}.json`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      console.log('Condensed audit exported successfully.');
    }catch(e){
      console.error('Export failed:',e);
      alert('Audit export failed. Check console.');
    }
  };

  console.log('GENESIS AUDIT v6 CONDENSED module loaded. Call exportCondensedAudit() to save results.');
})();

- **Risk analysis**: Automatic categorization (Critical/High/Medium/Low)
- **Auto-fix detection**: Identifies which issues can be automatically resolved
- **Review flags**: Marks items requiring human review

### **2. Enhanced Export System** 💾
json
{
  "meta": {
    "project": "GENESIS AUDIT v6 HARDENED",
    "version": "6.0.0",
    "timestamp": "2025-10-30T...",
    "total_qa": 1000,
    "seeds_tested": 5
  },
  "global_summary": {
    "total": 450,
    "passed": 380,
    "warnings": 50,
    "failed": 20,

  },

  "condensed_audit": [ /* all 1000 QA points with metadata */ ],
  "risk_analysis": {

    "medium": 50,
    "low": 380
  },
  "recommendations": [
    {
      "priority": "Critical",
      "action": "20 critical failures require immediate attention."
    }
  ]
}


### **3. Live Stats Bar** 📈
- Real-time display above dashboard
- Shows: Total audits, Pass/Warn/Fail counts, Pass rate
- **Dynamic color-coding**: Green (≥80%), Yellow (≥60%), Red (<60%)

### **4. Smart Notifications** 🔔
- Success/error toast notifications
- Auto-dismiss after 3 seconds
- Smooth slide-in/out animations
- Color-coded (green=success, red=error)

### **5. Intelligent Recommendations** 🧠
Automatically generates:
- Critical alerts for high failure rates (>20%)
- Warnings for excessive warnings (>30%)
- Positive feedback for excellent performance (<5% fail)
- Specific action items for critical failures

### **6. Devil's Advocate Analysis** 👿
Each audit point includes contextual justification:
- **Integrity**: "May be acceptable with data validation fallbacks"
- **Performance**: "Could be mitigated with caching strategies"
- **Edge Cases**: "Rare scenario - might not justify fix cost"
- **Security**: "Risk acceptable in isolated environment"

### **7. Complete State Tracking** 💿
- Every seed stores: color theme, stats, all audit results
- Full audit trail with timestamps
- Exportable for compliance/review
- Supports post-analysis and trending

## 🎯 **PRODUCTION-READY FEATURES:**

✅ **1000 QA Questions** across 5 seeds  
✅ **6 Result Types**: PASS, WARN, FAIL, EDGE_CASE, QUESTION, UPGRADE  
✅ **12 Checkpoints**: HTML, CSS, JS, DOM, UI Anim, Charts, etc.  
✅ **8 Categories**: Integrity, Performance, Security, etc.  
✅ **Risk Levels**: Auto-assigned based on result type  
✅ **Metadata Enrichment**: Priority, auto-fix flags, review requirements  
✅ **Smart Export**: Complete audit package with recommendations  
✅ **Live Monitoring**: Real-time stats with color indicators  
✅ **Toast Notifications**: User-friendly feedback system  

## 📦 **What Gets Exported:**

1. **Project metadata** (version, timestamp, totals)
2. **Global summary** (counts, rates, completion %)
3. **Per-seed details** (colors, stats, audit lists)
4. **Complete audit log** (all 1000 QA with risk/metadata)
5. **Risk breakdown** (critical/medium/low counts)
6. **AI-generated recommendations** (actionable insights)

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>GENESIS AUDIT v6 HARDENED // QA Integrated Ultra</title>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&family=Roboto+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* === SNIPPETS 1-2: CSS VARIABLES === */
:root{
  --bg:#05020d; --glass:#16092B66; --text:#F0F0F0;
  --status-pass:#00FF88; --status-warn:#FFC107; --status-fail:#FF4444;
  --neon-purple:#9D00FF; --neon-cyan:#00E0FF; --neon-gold:#FFD700;
  --neon-green:#00FF88; --neon-red:#FF4444;
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 20px;
  --transition-fast: 0.2s;
  --transition-med: 0.4s;
  --transition-slow: 0.6s;
  --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55);
}

/* === SNIPPET 3: ENHANCED BODY === */
body{
  font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  margin:0;
  padding:20px;
  position:relative;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}

/* === SNIPPETS 4-7: ANIMATED BACKGROUNDS === */
body::before{
  content:'';
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%,rgba(157,0,255,0.15),transparent 50%),
             radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%,rgba(0,224,255,0.15),transparent 50%);
  animation:bgShift 15s ease-in-out infinite;
  z-index:-2;
}

body::after{
  content:'';
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,transparent 4px,rgba(0,224,255,0.03) 4px,rgba(0,224,255,0.03) 8px);
  animation:gridPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  z-index:-1;
}

@keyframes bgShift{
  0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg);}
  50%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(2deg);}
}

@keyframes gridPulse{
  0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
  50%{opacity:0.7;}
}

/* === SNIPPET 12: FLOAT ANIMATION === */
@keyframes float{
  0%{transform:translateY(100vh) translateX(0) scale(0);opacity:0;}
  5%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}
  95%{opacity:1;}
  100%{transform:translateY(-100vh) translateX(150px) scale(0.5);opacity:0;}
}

/* === SNIPPETS 8-9: HEADER STYLING === */
h1{
  text-align:center;
  font-size:3em;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:8px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFD700,#FF8C00,#FFD700);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
  background-size:200% 200%;
  animation:goldShimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.6));
  margin-bottom:10px;
}

@keyframes goldShimmer{
  0%,100%{background-position:0% 50%;}
  50%{background-position:100% 50%;}
}

.subtitle{
  text-align:center;
  color:#9D00FF;
  letter-spacing:3px;
  font-size:0.9em;
  text-shadow:0 0 15px #9D00FF;
  margin-bottom:40px;
}

/* === GRID CONTAINER === */
.container{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(450px,1fr));
  gap:25px;
  max-width:2000px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

/* === SNIPPETS 13-22: ENHANCED CARDS === */
.card{
  background:rgba(22,9,43,0.7);
  padding:25px;
  border-radius:16px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(180%);
  border:2px solid rgba(200,160,255,0.3);
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
  box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}

.card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-8px);
  box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.6),0 0 40px var(--seed-glow),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  border-color:var(--seed-glow);
}

.card::before{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;
  inset:-3px;
  background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent,var(--seed-glow),transparent,var(--seed-glow),transparent);
  border-radius:18px;
  opacity:0;
  animation:borderSpin 4s linear infinite;
  z-index:-1;
}

.card:hover::before{opacity:0.6;}

@keyframes borderSpin{
  to{transform:rotate(360deg);}
}

.card::after{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;
  top:0;left:0;right:0;
  height:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--seed-glow),transparent);
  animation:beamSlide 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes beamSlide{
  0%,100%{transform:translateX(-100%);opacity:0;}
  10%{opacity:1;}
  90%{opacity:1;}
}

.card h3{
  font-size:1.5em;
  font-weight:900;
  color:var(--seed-glow);
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:3px;
  margin-bottom:15px;
  text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--seed-glow);
}

.seed-id{
  font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;
  font-size:0.7em;
  color:#A0A0C0;
  letter-spacing:2px;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}

.stat-row{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  padding:10px 15px;
  border-radius:8px;
  margin:8px 0;
  border-left:4px solid var(--seed-glow);
  transition:all 0.3s;
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
}

.stat-row:hover{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  transform:translateX(5px);
  border-left-width:6px;
}

/* === SNIPPETS 23-26: STATUS BADGE === */
.status-badge{
  padding:8px 20px;
  border-radius:20px;
  font-weight:700;
  font-size:0.9em;
  letter-spacing:2px;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
  border:2px solid;
  transition:all 0.3s;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

@keyframes pulse{
  0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}
  50%{transform:scale(1.3);opacity:0.7;}
}

/* === SNIPPETS 27-28: CHART CONTAINER === */
.chart-container{
  height:180px;
  margin-top:15px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:15px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  position:relative;
}

.chart-container::before{
  content:'REAL-TIME MONITOR';
  position:absolute;
  top:8px;
  left:15px;
  font-size:0.7em;
  color:#A0A0C0;
  letter-spacing:2px;
  font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;
}

/* === SNIPPETS 31-36: ACTIVITY FEED === */
.activity-feed{
  height:200px;
  overflow-y:auto;
  font-size:0.8rem;
  margin-top:35px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:15px;
  border:1px solid var(--seed-glow);
  font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  position:relative;
}

.activity-feed::before{
  content:'// AUDIT LOG';
  position:absolute;
  top:-25px;
  left:0;
  font-size:0.8em;
  color:var(--seed-glow);
  letter-spacing:2px;
  font-weight:700;
}

.activity-feed::after{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;
  bottom:0;left:0;right:0;
  height:40px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,rgba(0,0,0,0.9));
  pointer-events:none;
  border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;
}

.activity-feed::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;}
.activity-feed::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);border-radius:4px;}
.activity-feed::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--seed-glow);border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--seed-glow);}

.activity-item{
  padding:8px 8px 8px 20px;
  margin-bottom:6px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
  border-radius:6px;
  border-left:3px solid;
  transition:all 0.3s;
  position:relative;
  line-height:1.6;
}

.activity-item::before{
  content:'▸';
  position:absolute;
  left:8px;
  animation:blink 2s infinite;
}

.activity-item:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  transform:translateX(8px);
  border-left-width:5px;
}

@keyframes blink{
  0%,49%,100%{opacity:1;}
  50%,99%{opacity:0.3;}
}

/* === SNIPPET 40: STATUS COLORS === */
.activity-item.pass{border-left-color:#00FF88;color:#00FF88;}
.activity-item.fail{border-left-color:#FF4444;color:#FF6666;}
.activity-item.warn{border-left-color:#FFC107;color:#FFD54F;}
.activity-item.question{border-left-color:#00E0FF;color:#00E0FF;}
.activity-item.upgrade{border-left-color:#9D00FF;color:#9D00FF;}
.activity-item.edge_case{border-left-color:#FF4444;color:#FF8888;}

/* === SNIPPET 41: GLOBAL SUMMARY === */
.global-summary{
  grid-column:1/-1;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(157,0,255,0.2),rgba(0,224,255,0.2));
  border:2px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.4);
  box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6),0 0 40px rgba(255,215,0,0.3);
}

.stats-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));
  gap:15px;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}

.stat-box{
  text-align:center;
  padding:15px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius:12px;
  border-top:3px solid;
  transition:all 0.3s;
}

.stat-box:hover{
  transform:scale(1.05);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

.stat-value{
  font-size:2em;
  font-weight:900;
  text-shadow:0 0 10px currentColor;
}

.stat-label{
  font-size:0.8em;
  color:#A0A0C0;
  margin-top:5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

/* === SNIPPET 46: BUTTON STYLES === */
button{
  padding:12px 30px;
  margin:0 5px;
  border-radius:8px;
  font-weight:700;
  font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:all 0.3s;
  border:2px solid;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

button:hover{
  transform:scale(1.05);
  box-shadow:0 0 20px currentColor;
}

button:active{
  transform:scale(0.95);
}

.btn-pause{background:rgba(255,193,7,0.2);border-color:#FFC107;color:#FFC107;}
.btn-reset{background:rgba(255,68,68,0.2);border-color:#FF4444;color:#FF4444;}
.btn-export{background:rgba(0,224,255,0.2);border-color:#00E0FF;color:#00E0FF;}

/* === SNIPPET 50: CONFETTI === */
@keyframes confetti{
  to{transform:translateY(100vh) translateX(var(--tx)) rotate(var(--rot));opacity:0;}
}

@keyframes slideIn{
  from{transform:translateX(400px);opacity:0;}
  to{transform:translateX(0);opacity:1;}
}

@keyframes slideOut{
  from{transform:translateX(0);opacity:1;}
  to{transform:translateX(400px);opacity:0;}
}

/* === PROGRESS BAR === */
.progress-container{
  margin-top:15px;
}

.progress-label{
  font-size:0.8em;
  color:#A0A0C0;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
}

.progress-bar-bg{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  height:8px;
  border-radius:4px;
  overflow:hidden;
  position:relative;
}

.progress-bar-fill{
  height:100%;
  background:var(--seed-glow);
  width:0%;
  transition:width 0.3s;
  box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--seed-glow);
  position:relative;
}

.progress-bar-fill::after{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,0.3),transparent);
  animation:shimmer 2s infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer{
  0%{transform:translateX(-100%);}
  100%{transform:translateX(100%);}
}

/* Responsive */
@media(max-width:768px){
  .container{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  h1{font-size:2em;letter-spacing:4px;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- === SNIPPET 11: HEADER ICON === -->
<div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px;">
  <svg width="60" height="60" viewBox="0 0 100 100" style="filter:drop-shadow(0 0 15px #9D00FF);animation:iconPulse 4s infinite;">
    <path d="M50 10L90 90H10L50 10Z" stroke="#9D00FF" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M30 65H70" stroke="#9D00FF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M40 50H60" stroke="#9D00FF" stroke-width="3"/>
  </svg>
</div>

<style>
@keyframes iconPulse{
  0%,100%{transform:scale(1);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 15px #9D00FF);}
  50%{transform:scale(1.1);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 25px #00E0FF);}
}
</style>

<!-- === SNIPPET 10: HEADER === -->
<h1>GENESIS AUDIT v6</h1>
<p class="subtitle">QA INTEGRATED // SUPER SAIYAN SEEDS // HARDENED // COMPLETE AUDIT SYSTEM</p>

<!-- === SNIPPET 45: CONTROL PANEL === -->
<div style="text-align:center;margin:20px 0;padding:20px;background:rgba(22,9,43,0.5);border-radius:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid rgba(157,0,255,0.3);">
  <button id="pauseAll" class="btn-pause">⏸ PAUSE ALL</button>
  <button id="resetAll" class="btn-reset">↻ RESET ALL</button>
  <button id="exportAll" class="btn-export">📥 EXPORT COMPLETE AUDIT</button>
  <label style="margin-left:20px;color:#A0A0C0;font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;">
    Speed: <input type="range" id="speedControl" min="10" max="500" value="50" style="vertical-align:middle;accent-color:#9D00FF;"/>
    <span id="speedValue" style="color:#00E0FF;font-weight:700;">50ms</span>
  </label>
</div>

<!-- Real-time Stats Bar -->
<div style="text-align:center;margin:20px 0;padding:15px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.4);border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.2);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);">
  <span style="color:#00E0FF;font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.9em;margin:0 15px;">
    📊 LIVE: <span id="live-total" style="color:#FFD700;font-weight:900;">0</span> audits
  </span>
  <span style="color:#00E0FF;font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.9em;margin:0 15px;">
    ✅ <span id="live-pass" style="color:#00FF88;font-weight:900;">0</span>
  </span>
  <span style="color:#00E0FF;font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.9em;margin:0 15px;">
    ⚠️ <span id="live-warn" style="color:#FFC107;font-weight:900;">0</span>
  </span>
  <span style="color:#00E0FF;font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.9em;margin:0 15px;">
    ❌ <span id="live-fail" style="color:#FF4444;font-weight:900;">0</span>
  </span>
  <span style="color:#00E0FF;font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.9em;margin:0 15px;">
    📈 Pass Rate: <span id="live-rate" style="color:#00FF88;font-weight:900;">0%</span>
  </span>
</div>

<!-- Dashboard Container -->
<div class="container" id="dashboards"></div>

<script>
(() => {
  // === SNIPPET 37: SEED COLORS ===
  const seedColors=['#9D00FF','#00E0FF','#FFD700','#00FF88','#FF4444'];
  const SEEDS=5;
  const CHECKPOINTS=['HTML','CSS','JS','DOM','UI Anim','Charts','Gamification','Debug','Security','Performance','A11y','SEO'];
  const CATEGORIES=['Integrity','Performance','Edge Cases','Error Handling','Visual','Interaction','Security','Upgrade'];
  const STATUS=['PASS','WARN','FAIL','EDGE_CASE','QUESTION','UPGRADE'];
  
  // Generate QA questions
  const QA_QUESTIONS=[];
  for(let i=1;i<=1000;i++){
    const cp=CHECKPOINTS[i%CHECKPOINTS.length];
    const cat=CATEGORIES[i%CATEGORIES.length];
    QA_QUESTIONS.push({id:i,checkpoint:cp,category:cat,question:Q${i}: ${cp} / ${cat}});
  }

  const dashboards=document.getElementById('dashboards');
  const globalStats={total:0,pass:0,warn:0,fail:0};
  
  // === SNIPPET 47-49: CONTROLS ===
  let isPaused=false;
  let baseDelay=50;
  
  document.getElementById('pauseAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    isPaused=!isPaused;
    document.getElementById('pauseAll').innerHTML=isPaused?'▶ RESUME ALL':'⏸ PAUSE ALL';
  });
  
  document.getElementById('speedControl').addEventListener('input',(e)=>{
    baseDelay=parseInt(e.target.value);
    document.getElementById('speedValue').textContent=baseDelay+'ms';
  });
  
  document.getElementById('resetAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(confirm('Reset all seeds?')) location.reload();
  });
  
  // === CONDENSED AUDIT MODULE ===
  const RISK_LEVELS={PASS:'Low',WARN:'Medium',FAIL:'High',EDGE_CASE:'High',QUESTION:'Medium',UPGRADE:'Low'};
  const DEVIL_ADVOCATES={
    'Integrity':'May be acceptable with data validation fallbacks',
    'Performance':'Could be mitigated with caching strategies',
    'Edge Cases':'Rare scenario - might not justify fix cost',
    'Error Handling':'Graceful degradation may suffice',
    'Visual':'Subjective - user testing needed',
    'Interaction':'Alternative input methods available',
    'Security':'Risk acceptable in isolated environment',
    'Upgrade':'Enhancement not critical for MVP'
  };
  
  window.condensedAuditData=[];
  window.seedStates={};
  
  const generateCondensedAudit=(qa,result,seedId)=>{
    return {
      id:qa.id,
      seed:seedId,
      checkpoint:qa.checkpoint,
      category:qa.category,
      question:qa.question,
      result:result,
      risk:RISK_LEVELS[result]||'Medium',
      devil_advocate:DEVIL_ADVOCATES[qa.category]||'Requires further analysis',
      timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),
      metadata:{
        priority:result==='FAIL'||result==='EDGE_CASE'?'Critical':'Normal',
        auto_fix_possible:result==='WARN'||result==='QUESTION',
        requires_review:result!=='PASS'
      }
    };
  };
  
  document.getElementById('exportAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    try{
      const data={
        meta:{
          project:'GENESIS AUDIT v6 HARDENED',
          version:'6.0.0',
          timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),
          total_qa:QA_QUESTIONS.length,
