<h1>Audit Hub v6</h1>
<button onclick="runAudit()">Run Audit</button>
<input type="text" id="search" placeholder="Search issues..." style="padding:5px; margin-left:10px; border-radius:3px; border:none;">

<table id="auditResults">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Issue</th>
      <th>Problem</th>
      <th>Recommendation</th>
      <th>Risk</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody></tbody>
</table>

<script>
(function(){
  const auditPoints = [
    { issue:"IIFE Encapsulation", problem:"Single-file IIFE limits modularity.", recommendation:"Refactor into modules.", risk:"Medium", details:"Consider splitting UIManager, StateManager, SimulationEngine into separate modules for easier testing." },
    { issue:"Global State Handling", problem:"Inconsistent state between global seedStates and instances.", recommendation:"Use seedStates as source of truth.", risk:"High", details:"Desync can break simulations. All instances should update from the central state." },
    { issue:"Interval Management", problem:"Timers may overlap during pause/resume.", recommendation:"Check interval status; clear existing intervals.", risk:"High", details:"Overlapping intervals can cause duplicated operations and inconsistent audit logs." },
    { issue:"Error Handling", problem:"Parsing errors from localStorage may crash system.", recommendation:"Wrap in try/catch; provide fallback.", risk:"Medium", details:"Ensure robust fallback state to avoid total system failure." }
  ];

  window.runAudit = function() {
    const tbody = document.querySelector("#auditResults tbody");
    tbody.innerHTML = "";
    const filter = document.querySelector("#search").value.toLowerCase();

    auditPoints.forEach(p => {
      if(filter && !(p.issue.toLowerCase().includes(filter) || p.problem.toLowerCase().includes(filter))) return;
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.className = p.risk.toLowerCase();
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${p.issue}</td>
        <td>${p.problem}</td>
        <td>${p.recommendation}</td>
        <td>${p.risk}</td>
      `;
      tr.addEventListener('click', ()=> {
        if(tr.querySelector('.details')) {
          const existing = tr.querySelector('.details');
          existing.style.display = existing.style.display === 'none' ? 'table-cell' : 'none';
        } else {
          const detailsTd = document.createElement('td');
          detailsTd.colSpan = 4;
          detailsTd.className = 'details';
          detailsTd.textContent = p.details;
          tr.appendChild(detailsTd);
        }
      });
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  };

  document.querySelector("#search").addEventListener("input", runAudit);
})();
</script>

</body>

}

.show { display: block; animation: slideDown 0.3s ease; }

  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

const auditData = [
  {id:1, category:"Architecture & State", title:"IIFE Encapsulation", risk:"Medium", details:"Problem: Single-file IIFE limits modularity. Solution: Split into modules."},
  {id:2, category:"Architecture & State", title:"Global State Handling", risk:"High", details:"Problem: State split can desync. Solution: Enforce single source of truth."},
  {id:3, category:"Architecture & State", title:"Interval Management", risk:"High", details:"Problem: Overlapping intervals. Solution: Check and clear existing intervals."},
  {id:4, category:"Architecture & State", title:"Error Handling", risk:"Medium", details:"Problem: localStorage parsing errors. Solution: Use try/catch fallback."}
];

// Create rows
function renderTable(filter="", search="") {
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#auditTable tbody");
  tbody.innerHTML = "";
  auditData.forEach(item => {
    if ((filter === "all" || item.risk === filter) &&
        (search === "" || item.title.toLowerCase().includes(search) || item.category.toLowerCase().includes(search))) {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${item.id}</td>
        <td>${item.category}</td>
        <td>${item.title}</td>
        <td>
          <div class="risk-bar" style="width:0;background:${item.risk==='High'?'#e74c3c':item.risk==='Medium'?'#f39c12':'#2ecc71'}"></div>

      `;
      const detailsRow = document.createElement("tr");
      const detailsTd = document.createElement("td");
      detailsTd.colSpan = 4;
      detailsTd.className = "details";
      detailsTd.textContent = item.details;
      detailsRow.appendChild(detailsTd);

      tbody.appendChild(tr);
      tbody.appendChild(detailsRow);

        tr.querySelector(".risk-bar").style.width="100%";
      }, 50);
    }
  });
}

// Initial render

// Filters
document.getElementById("riskFilter").addEventListener("change", e => renderTable(e.target.value, document.getElementById("search").value.toLowerCase()));
document.getElementById("search").addEventListener("input", e => renderTable(document.getElementById("riskFilter").value, e.target.value.toLowerCase()));

</script>

                progressBar.id = \progress-\${this.index}\;

                elapsedWrapper.style.cssText = "font-size:0.7em;color:#A0A0C0;margin-top:5px;";

                elapsedSpan.id = \elapsed-\${this.index}\;

1. Core Idea
Each visual “layer” subscribes to seed state updates. The Hub emits events like:

hub.onSeedUpdate(seedId, state);
hub.onAuditEvent(event); // pass, fail, warn, etc.
Each layer listens and renders independently. No layer should mutate seed data—only read it.

2. Layer Base Class
class VisualLayer {
  constructor(name, container) {
    this.name = name;
    this.container = container; // DOM node for this layer
    this.active = true;
  }

  toggle(active) {
    this.active = active;
    this.container.style.display = active ? 'block' : 'none';
  }

  update(seedId, seedState) {
    if(!this.active) return;
    // override in subclass
  }

  destroy() {
    this.container.remove();
  }
}
3. Example Layers
a) Sparklines for Audit History
class SparklineLayer extends VisualLayer {
  constructor(container) {
    super('Sparkline', container);
    this.seedHistory = {}; // seedId -> [progress...]
  }

  update(seedId, seedState) {
    if(!this.seedHistory[seedId]) this.seedHistory[seedId] = [];
    this.seedHistory[seedId].push(seedState.progress);
    this.render(seedId);
  }

  render(seedId) {
    const ctx = this.container.getContext('2d');
    const data = this.seedHistory[seedId];
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.container.width, this.container.height);
    ctx.beginPath();
    data.forEach((p, i) => ctx.lineTo(i, this.container.height - (p/100*this.container.height)));
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}
b) Heatmap for Failures/Warnings
class HeatmapLayer extends VisualLayer {
  constructor(container) {
    super('Heatmap', container);
    this.seedColors = {}; // seedId -> color intensity
  }

  update(seedId, seedState) {
    const intensity = seedState.fail + seedState.warn;
    this.seedColors[seedId] = Math.min(255, intensity*5);
    this.render(seedId);
  }

  render(seedId) {
    const el = this.container.querySelector(`#seed-${seedId}`);
    if(!el) return;
    el.style.boxShadow = `0 0 10px rgb(${this.seedColors[seedId]},0,0)`;
  }
}
c) Mission Complete Glow
class MissionGlowLayer extends VisualLayer {
  update(seedId, seedState) {
    if(seedState.status === 'COMPLETE') {
      const el = this.container.querySelector(`#seed-${seedId}`);
      if(el) el.classList.add('glow-gold');
    }
  }
}
.glow-gold {
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px gold;
  transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease-in-out;
}
4. Layer Manager
class LayerManager {
  constructor(hub) {
    this.layers = [];
    this.hub = hub;
    hub.onSeedUpdate((seedId, state) => {
      this.layers.forEach(layer => layer.update(seedId, state));
    });
  }

  addLayer(layer) {
    this.layers.push(layer);
  }

  toggleLayer(name, active) {
    const layer = this.layers.find(l => l.name === name);
    if(layer) layer.toggle(active);
  }
}

<div class="hub-container">
  <h1>Super Saiyan Audit Hub v6 🚀</h1>
  <div class="control-panel">
    <button id="launch-all">🚀 Launch All Seeds</button>
    <button id="autopilot">🤖 AUTOPILOT</button>
    <button id="pause-all">⏸ PAUSE ALL</button>
    <button id="reset-all">↻ RESET ALL</button>
    <button id="export-json">💾 EXPORT JSON</button>
    <input type="range" id="speed-slider" class="slider" min="10" max="500" value="100">
  </div>

  <div class="seeds">
    <!-- Seed Cards will be inserted dynamically -->
  </div>

  <div class="activity-feed" id="activity-feed"></div>
</div>

<div id="mission-overlay">MISSION COMPLETE ✨</div>

<script>
/* ===== HUB LOGIC ===== */
const DEFAULT_SEEDS = 5;
const seedsContainer = document.querySelector('.seeds');
const activityFeed = document.getElementById('activity-feed');
const missionOverlay = document.getElementById('mission-overlay');

class Seed {
  constructor(id) {
    this.id = id;
    this.progress = 0;
    this.status = 'IDLE';
    this.fail = 0;
    this.warn = 0;
    this.pass = 0;
    this.total = 0;
    this.elapsed = 0;
    this.interval = null;
    this.createCard();
  }

  createCard() {
    this.card = document.createElement('div');
    this.card.classList.add('seed-card');
    this.card.id = `seed-${this.id}`;
    this.card.innerHTML = `
      <canvas class="canvas-layer" width="260" height="100"></canvas>
      <h3>Seed ${this.id}</h3>
      <div class="progress-bar-container"><div class="progress-bar"></div></div>
      <div class="status IDLE">IDLE</div>
      <div class="metrics">Pass: <span class="pass">0</span> Fail: <span class="fail">0</span> Warn: <span class="warn">0</span></div>
    `;
    seedsContainer.appendChild(this.card);
    this.progressBar = this.card.querySelector('.progress-bar');
    this.statusEl = this.card.querySelector('.status');
    this.passEl = this.card.querySelector('.pass');
    this.failEl = this.card.querySelector('.fail');
    this.warnEl = this.card.querySelector('.warn');
    this.canvas = this.card.querySelector('canvas');
    this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d');
    this.history = [];
  }

  start() {
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.status = 'RUNNING'; this.updateUI();
    const tick = () => {
      const delta = Math.random()*(autopilotActive?5:2);
      this.progress = Math.min(100, this.progress + delta);
      this.elapsed += 1;
      const rnd = Math.random();
      if(rnd<0.02){ this.fail++; logEvent(`Seed ${this.id} FAIL`, 'fail'); }
      else if(rnd<0.05){ this.warn++; logEvent(`Seed ${this.id} WARN`, 'warn'); }
      else { this.pass++; }
      this.total++;
      this.history.push(this.progress);
      this.updateUI();
      updateLayers(this.id, this);
      if(this.progress>=100){ this.complete(); clearInterval(this.interval); }
    };
    this.interval = setInterval(tick, speedSlider.value);
  }

  pause() { this.status='PAUSED'; this.updateUI(); if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval); }
  resume() { if(this.progress<100){ this.start(); } }
  reset() {
    this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.fail=0; this.warn=0; this.pass=0; this.total=0; this.elapsed=0;
    this.history=[]; this.updateUI();
    updateLayers(this.id, this);
  }

  complete() {
    this.status='COMPLETE';
    this.card.classList.add('glow');
    logEvent(`Seed ${this.id} COMPLETE`, 'pass');
    this.updateUI();
    checkMissionComplete();
  }

  updateUI() {
    this.progressBar.style.width = this.progress + '%';
    this.statusEl.textContent = this.status;
    this.statusEl.className = 'status ' + this.status;
    this.passEl.textContent = this.pass;
    this.failEl.textContent = this.fail;
    this.warnEl.textContent = this.warn;
  }
}

let seeds = [];
let autopilotActive = false;
const speedSlider = document.getElementById('speed-slider');

function logEvent(msg,type='info'){
  const item = document.createElement('div');
  item.textContent = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${msg}`;
  item.className = type==='pass'?'log-pass':type==='fail'?'log-fail':'log-warn';
  activityFeed.appendChild(item);
  if(activityFeed.scrollHeight>activityFeed.clientHeight) activityFeed.scrollTop = activityFeed.scrollHeight;
}

function checkMissionComplete(){
  if(seeds.every(s=>s.status==='COMPLETE')){
    missionOverlay.style.display='flex';
    setTimeout(()=>missionOverlay.style.display='none',5000);
  }
}

/* ===== LAYERS ===== */
const layers = [];
function updateLayers(seedId,state){
  layers.forEach(l=>l.update(seedId,state));
}

class SparklineLayer{
  constructor(){ layers.push(this); }
  update(seedId,state){
    const ctx = seeds[seedId-1].ctx;
    const data = state.history;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,ctx.canvas.width,ctx.canvas.height);
    ctx.beginPath();
    data.forEach((p,i)=>ctx.lineTo(i,ctx.canvas.height-(p/100*ctx.canvas.height)));
    ctx.strokeStyle='#0ff';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

class HeatmapLayer{
  constructor(){ layers.push(this); }
  update(seedId,state){
    const intensity = Math.min(255,state.fail*10);
    seeds[seedId-1].card.style.boxShadow = `0 0 20px rgb(${intensity},0,0)`;
  }
}

class MissionGlowLayer{
  constructor(){ layers.push(this); }
  update(seedId,state){
    if(state.status==='COMPLETE') seeds[seedId-1].card.classList.add('glow');
  }
}

/* ===== INIT HUB ===== */
for(let i=1;i<=DEFAULT_SEEDS;i++) seeds.push(new Seed(i));
new SparklineLayer();
new HeatmapLayer();
new MissionGlowLayer();

document.getElementById('pause-all').addEventListener('click',()=>seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause()));

document.getElementById('reset-all').addEventListener('click',()=>{

});
document.getElementById('export-json').addEventListener('click',()=>{

  }));
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url; a.download='seed_audit_v6_final.json';

speedSlider.addEventListener('input',()=>{ seeds.forEach(s=>{ if(s.interval) { clearInterval(s.interval); s.start(); } }); });

/**
 * =================================================================
 * Super Saiyan Audit Hub v6 FINAL - JavaScript Engine
 * Author: Saiyan Seed
 * Executor: Mr. Hobbs
 * =================================================================
 */

// ------------------------ CONFIG ------------------------
const SEED_COUNT = 5;
const MAX_ACTIVITY_LOG = 200;

// ------------------------ STATE ------------------------
let seedStates = [];
let seedIntervals = [];
let rafPending = false;
let globalSpeed = 100; // ms per tick
let activityFeed = [];
let autopilot = false;

// Initialize seeds
function initSeeds() {
  seedStates = Array.from({ length: SEED_COUNT }, (_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    progress: 0,
    status: "IDLE",
    fail: 0,
    warn: 0,
    pass: 0,
    total: 0,
    elapsed: 0,
    lastTick: performance.now()
  }));
}

// ------------------------ UTILS ------------------------
function saveStates() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem("seedStates_v6", JSON.stringify(seedStates));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to save states:", e);
  }
}

function loadStates() {
  try {
    const data = localStorage.getItem("seedStates_v6");
    if (data) {
      seedStates = JSON.parse(data);
    } else {
      initSeeds();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to load states:", e);
    initSeeds();
  }
}

function logActivity(msg, type = "info") {
  const entry = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${msg}`;
  activityFeed.push({ text: entry, type });
  if (activityFeed.length > MAX_ACTIVITY_LOG) activityFeed.shift();
  updateActivityFeedUI();
}

function updateActivityFeedUI() {
  if (rafPending) return;
  rafPending = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const feedEl = document.getElementById("activity-feed");
    if (!feedEl) return;
    feedEl.innerHTML = "";
    activityFeed.forEach(a => {
      const item = document.createElement("div");
      item.textContent = a.text;
      item.style.color = a.type === "fail" ? "red" : a.type === "warn" ? "orange" : "white";
      feedEl.appendChild(item);
    });
    feedEl.scrollTop = feedEl.scrollHeight;
    rafPending = false;
  });
}

// ------------------------ SIMULATION ------------------------
function tickSeed(seed) {
  if (seed.status !== "RUNNING") return;
  const now = performance.now();
  const delta = (now - seed.lastTick) * (autopilot ? 2 : 1);
  seed.elapsed += delta;
  seed.lastTick = now;

  // Random step increment
  let inc = Math.random() * 5;
  if (autopilot) inc *= 1.5;
  seed.progress = Math.min(100, seed.progress + inc);
  seed.total++;

  // Random warn/fail
  const r = Math.random();
  if (r < 0.02) {
    seed.fail++;
    logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} FAIL`, "fail");
  } else if (r < 0.06) {
    seed.warn++;
    logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} WARN`, "warn");
  } else {
    seed.pass++;
  }

  updateSeedUI(seed);

  if (seed.progress >= 100) {
    seed.status = "COMPLETE";
    logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} COMPLETE`);
    updateSeedUI(seed);
    checkMissionComplete();
    clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]);
  }
}

function startSeed(seed) {
  if (seed.status === "IDLE" || seed.status === "PAUSED") {
    seed.status = "RUNNING";
    seed.lastTick = performance.now();
    updateSeedUI(seed);
    if (seedIntervals[seed.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]);
    seedIntervals[seed.id] = setInterval(() => tickSeed(seed), globalSpeed);
    logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} LAUNCH COMMAND RECEIVED`);
  }
}

function pauseAllSeeds() {
  seedStates.forEach(seed => {
    if (seed.status === "RUNNING") seed.status = "PAUSED";
    if (seedIntervals[seed.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]);
    updateSeedUI(seed);
  });
  logActivity("All seeds PAUSED");
}

function resumeAllSeeds() {
  seedStates.forEach(seed => startSeed(seed));
  logActivity("All seeds RESUMED");
}

function launchAllSeeds() {
  seedStates.forEach(seed => startSeed(seed));
}

function resetAllSeeds() {
  if (!confirm("Are you sure to reset all? This cannot be undone.")) return;
  seedStates.forEach((seed, i) => {
    if (seedIntervals[i]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[i]);
  });
  localStorage.removeItem("seedStates_v6");
  initSeeds();
  renderAllSeedsUI();
  activityFeed = [];
  updateActivityFeedUI();
}

// ------------------------ UI ------------------------
function updateSeedUI(seed) {
  const el = document.getElementById(`seed-${seed.id}`);
  if (!el) return;
  const bar = el.querySelector(".progress-bar");
  bar.style.width = `${seed.progress}%`;
  el.querySelector(".status").textContent = seed.status;
  el.querySelector(".status").style.color =
    seed.status === "COMPLETE" ? "gold" :
    seed.status === "RUNNING" ? "lime" :
    seed.status === "PAUSED" ? "yellow" : "white";
  el.querySelector(".elapsed").textContent = `Elapsed: ${(seed.elapsed/1000).toFixed(1)}s`;
}

function renderAllSeedsUI() {
  const container = document.getElementById("seeds-container");
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = "";
  seedStates.forEach(seed => {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "seed-card";
    card.id = `seed-${seed.id}`;
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="header">Seed ${seed.id}</div>
      <div class="progress">
        <div class="progress-bar"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="status">IDLE</div>
      <div class="elapsed">Elapsed: 0.0s</div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
  });
}

// ------------------------ MISSION COMPLETE ------------------------
function checkMissionComplete() {
  if (seedStates.every(seed => seed.status === "COMPLETE")) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById("mission-overlay");
    if (!overlay) return;
    overlay.style.display = "flex";
    setTimeout(() => overlay.style.display = "none", 5000);
  }
}

// ------------------------ AUTOPILOT ------------------------
function toggleAutopilot() {
  autopilot = !autopilot;
  const btn = document.getElementById("autopilot-btn");
  if (btn) btn.style.backgroundColor = autopilot ? "purple" : "";
}

// ------------------------ SPEED CONTROL ------------------------
function setGlobalSpeed(value) {
  globalSpeed = Number(value);
  seedStates.forEach(seed => {
    if (seedIntervals[seed.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]);
    if (seed.status === "RUNNING") {
      seedIntervals[seed.id] = setInterval(() => tickSeed(seed), globalSpeed);
    }
  });
}

// ------------------------ EXPORT ------------------------
function exportJSON() {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(seedStates, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = "seed_audit_v6_final.json";
  a.click();
  logActivity("Exported seed states JSON");
}

// ------------------------ INIT ------------------------
function initHub() {
  loadStates();
  renderAllSeedsUI();
  updateActivityFeedUI();

  // Hook control buttons
  const launchBtn = document.getElementById("launch-all-btn");
  if (launchBtn) launchBtn.addEventListener("click", launchAllSeeds);
  const pauseBtn = document.getElementById("pause-all-btn");
  if (pauseBtn) pauseBtn.addEventListener("click", pauseAllSeeds);
  const resumeBtn = document.getElementById("resume-all-btn");
  if (resumeBtn) resumeBtn.addEventListener("click", resumeAllSeeds);
  const resetBtn = document.getElementById("reset-all-btn");
  if (resetBtn) resetBtn.addEventListener("click", resetAllSeeds);
  const autopilotBtn = document.getElementById("autopilot-btn");
  if (autopilotBtn) autopilotBtn.addEventListener("click", toggleAutopilot);
  const exportBtn = document.getElementById("export-btn");
  if (exportBtn) exportBtn.addEventListener("click", exportJSON);
  const speedSlider = document.getElementById("speed-slider");
  if (speedSlider) speedSlider.addEventListener("input", e => setGlobalSpeed(e.target.value));

  // Auto-save every 5s
  setInterval(saveStates, 5000);
}

// Save on tab close
window.addEventListener("beforeunload", saveStates);

// Init when DOM ready
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initHub);

function toggleAutopilot(){ autopilot=!autopilot; const btn=document.getElementById("autopilot-btn"); if(btn) btn.style.backgroundColor=autopilot?"purple":""; }
function setGlobalSpeed(value){ globalSpeed=Number(value); seedStates.forEach(seed=>{ if(seedIntervals[seed.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]); if(seed.status==="RUNNING") seedIntervals[seed.id]=setInterval(()=>tickSeed(seed), globalSpeed); }); }

<style>
/* ---------- GLOBAL ---------- */
body { margin:0; font-family:'Orbitron', sans-serif; background:#0f0f1f; color:#fff; display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100vh; overflow:hidden; }
h1 { text-align:center; color:#00ffff; margin:10px 0; text-shadow:0 0 5px #0ff; }

/* ---------- CONTROL PANEL ---------- */
#controls { display:flex; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; padding:10px; background:#1f1f3f; border-bottom:2px solid #00ffff; }
#controls button { padding:8px 16px; background:#111133; color:#00ffff; border:2px solid #00ffff; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:0.2s; }
#controls button:hover { background:#00ffff; color:#111133; }
#controls input[type="range"] { width:150px; transition:0.3s; }

/* Autopilot glow */
#autopilot-btn.autopilot-on { animation: pulse 1s infinite alternate; }
@keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow:0 0 5px #ff0; } 100% { box-shadow:0 0 20px #ff0; } }

/* ---------- SEED CARDS ---------- */
#seeds-container { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; padding:10px; gap:15px; flex:1; overflow-y:auto; }
.seed-card { background:#111133; border:2px solid #00ffff; border-radius:10px; width:180px; padding:10px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; box-shadow:0 0 10px #00ffff; opacity:0; transform:translateY(20px); animation: fadeSlide 0.5s forwards; }
@keyframes fadeSlide { to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
.seed-card:hover { box-shadow:0 0 20px #0ff, 0 0 30px #0ff; }

/* Progress bars */
.progress { background:#0f0f1f; border:1px solid #00ffff; height:15px; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden; }
.progress-bar { background:#00ffff; width:0%; height:100%; transition:width 0.2s ease-in-out; box-shadow:0 0 5px #0ff inset,0 0 10px #0ff; }

/* Status & Elapsed */
.status { font-size:0.9em; text-align:center; }
.elapsed { font-size:0.8em; text-align:center; }

/* Activity Feed */
#activity-feed { max-height:120px; overflow-y:auto; background:#111133; padding:5px; border-top:2px solid #00ffff; font-size:0.8em; }

/* Mission Overlay */
#mission-overlay { position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,255,255,0.2); display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:2em; color:gold; z-index:1000; text-shadow:0 0 10px #ffff00; }

/* Writings of the Soul Test Button */
#soul-test-btn { background:#330000; border:2px solid #ff00ff; color:#ff00ff; }
#soul-test-btn:hover { background:#ff00ff; color:#330000; }

/* Fail flash */
@keyframes failFlash { 0%,100%{background:#111133;}50%{background:red;} }
.fail-flash { animation:failFlash 0.3s; }

/* Speed slider glow */
#speed-slider { background: #111133; }
#speed-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: #00ffff; }

/* Sparkles for Soul Test */
.sparkle { position:absolute; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#ff0; pointer-events:none; animation:sparkleAnim 0.7s linear forwards; }
@keyframes sparkleAnim { 0% {opacity:1; transform:translate(0,0);} 100% {opacity:0; transform:translate(30px,-30px);} }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<h1>Super Saiyan Audit Hub v6 FINAL</h1>

<div id="controls">
  <button id="launch-all-btn">🚀 Launch All Seeds</button>
  <button id="pause-all-btn">⏸ Pause All</button>
  <button id="resume-all-btn">▶ Resume All</button>
  <button id="reset-all-btn">↻ Reset All</button>
  <button id="autopilot-btn">🤖 Autopilot</button>
  <button id="export-btn">💾 Export JSON</button>
  <input type="range" id="speed-slider" min="10" max="500" value="100">
  <button id="soul-test-btn">✨ Writings of the Soul Test</button>
</div>

<div id="seeds-container"></div>
<div id="activity-feed"></div>
<div id="mission-overlay">MISSION COMPLETE 🌟</div>
<canvas id="fireworks-canvas" style="position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;"></canvas>

<script>
/* ------------------- HUB LOGIC ------------------- */
const SEED_COUNT=5, MAX_ACTIVITY_LOG=200;
let seedStates=[], seedIntervals=[], rafPending=false, globalSpeed=100, activityFeed=[], autopilot=false;
const canvas=document.getElementById("fireworks-canvas"), ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.width=window.innerWidth; canvas.height=window.innerHeight;

// --- Initialization ---
function initSeeds(){ seedStates=Array.from({length:SEED_COUNT},(_,i)=>({id:i,progress:0,status:"IDLE",fail:0,warn:0,pass:0,total:0,elapsed:0,lastTick:performance.now()})); }
function saveStates(){ try{ localStorage.setItem("seedStates_v6",JSON.stringify(seedStates)); } catch(e){console.error(e);} }
function loadStates(){ try{ const data=localStorage.getItem("seedStates_v6"); if(data) seedStates=JSON.parse(data); else initSeeds(); } catch(e){initSeeds();} }
function logActivity(msg,type="info"){ const entry=`[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${msg}`; activityFeed.push({text:entry,type}); if(activityFeed.length>MAX_ACTIVITY_LOG) activityFeed.shift(); updateActivityFeedUI(); }
function updateActivityFeedUI(){ if(rafPending)return; rafPending=true; requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ const feedEl=document.getElementById("activity-feed"); feedEl.innerHTML=""; activityFeed.forEach(a=>{ const item=document.createElement("div"); item.textContent=a.text; item.style.color=a.type==="fail"?"red":a.type==="warn"?"orange":"white"; feedEl.appendChild(item); }); feedEl.scrollTop=feedEl.scrollHeight; rafPending=false; }); }

// --- Seed Tick ---
function tickSeed(seed){ if(seed.status!=="RUNNING")return; const now=performance.now(); const delta=(now-seed.lastTick)*(autopilot?2:1); seed.elapsed+=delta; seed.lastTick=now;
let inc=Math.random()*5; if(autopilot) inc*=1.5; seed.progress=Math.min(100,seed.progress+inc); seed.total++; const r=Math.random();
if(r<0.02){ seed.fail++; logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} FAIL`,"fail"); flashFail(seed.id); }
else if(r<0.06){ seed.warn++; logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} WARN`,"warn"); }
else seed.pass++; updateSeedUI(seed); if(seed.progress>=100){ seed.status="COMPLETE"; logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} COMPLETE`); updateSeedUI(seed); checkMissionComplete(); clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]); } }

// --- Fail flash animation ---
function flashFail(seedId){ const el=document.getElementById(`seed-${seedId}`); if(!el)return; el.classList.add("fail-flash"); setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("fail-flash"),300); }

// --- UI Updates ---
function updateSeedUI(seed){ const el=document.getElementById(`seed-${seed.id}`); if(!el)return; const bar=el.querySelector(".progress-bar"); bar.style.width=`${seed.progress}%`; el.querySelector(".status").textContent=seed.status; el.querySelector(".status").style.color=seed.status==="COMPLETE"?"gold":seed.status==="RUNNING"?"lime":seed.status==="PAUSED"?"yellow":"white"; el.querySelector(".elapsed").textContent=`Elapsed: ${(seed.elapsed/1000).toFixed(1)}s`; }
function renderAllSeedsUI(){ const container=document.getElementById("seeds-container"); container.innerHTML=""; seedStates.forEach(seed=>{ const card=document.createElement("div"); card.className="seed-card"; card.id=`seed-${seed.id}`; card.innerHTML=`<div class="header">Seed ${seed.id}</div><div class="progress"><div class="progress-bar"></div></div><div class="status">IDLE</div><div class="elapsed">Elapsed: 0.0s</div>`; container.appendChild(card); }); }

// --- Mission Complete Fireworks ---
let fireworks=[]; function checkMissionComplete(){ if(seedStates.every(s=>s.status==="COMPLETE")){ const overlay=document.getElementById("mission-overlay"); overlay.style.display="flex"; launchFireworks(); setTimeout(()=>overlay.style.display="none",5000); } }
function launchFireworks(){ for(let i=0;i<50;i++){ fireworks.push({x:Math.random()*canvas.width,y:canvas.height, vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*5, vy:-Math.random()*7-3, alpha:1}); } drawFireworks(); }
function drawFireworks(){ ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height); fireworks.forEach(f=>{ ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,0,${f.alpha})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); f.x+=f.vx; f.y+=f.vy; f.alpha-=0.02; }); fireworks=fireworks.filter(f=>f.alpha>0); if(fireworks.length>0) requestAnimationFrame(drawFireworks); }

// --- Controls ---
function startSeed(seed){ if(seed.status==="IDLE"||seed.status==="PAUSED"){ seed.status="RUNNING"; seed.lastTick=performance.now(); if(seedIntervals[seed.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]); seedIntervals[seed.id]=setInterval(()=>tickSeed(seed),globalSpeed); logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} LAUNCH COMMAND RECEIVED`); updateSeedUI(seed); } }
function launchAllSeeds(){ seedStates.forEach(startSeed); }
function pauseAllSeeds(){ seedStates.forEach(s=>{ if(s.status==="RUNNING")s.status="PAUSED"; if(seedIntervals[s.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[s.id]); updateSeedUI(s); }); logActivity("All seeds PAUSED"); }
function resumeAllSeeds(){ seedStates.forEach(startSeed); logActivity("All seeds RESUMED"); }
function resetAllSeeds(){ if(!confirm("Are you sure to reset all? This cannot be undone.")) return; seedStates.forEach((s,i)=>{ if(seedIntervals[i]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[i]); }); localStorage.removeItem("seedStates_v6"); initSeeds(); renderAllSeedsUI(); activityFeed=[]; updateActivityFeedUI(); }

// --- Autopilot & Speed ---
function toggleAutopilot(){ autopilot=!autopilot; document.getElementById("autopilot-btn").classList.toggle("autopilot-on",autopilot); }
function setGlobalSpeed(value){ globalSpeed=Number(value); seedStates.forEach(s=>{ if(seedIntervals[s.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[s.id]); if(s.status==="RUNNING") seedIntervals[s.id]=setInterval(()=>tickSeed(s),globalSpeed); }); }

// --- Export ---
function exportJSON(){ const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(seedStates,null,2)],{type:"application/json"}); const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download="seed_audit_v6_final.json"; a.click(); logActivity("Exported seed states JSON"); }

// --- Writings of the Soul Test ---
function testWritingsOfTheSoul(e){ const message="✨ The 'Writings of the Soul' test runs: each seed reflects a spark of creativity, storytelling, and lesson soulfulness! ✨"; logActivity(message); alert(message); // sparkles
for(let i=0;i<15;i++){ const sp=document.createElement("div"); sp.className="sparkle"; sp.style.left=(e.clientX+Math.random()*20-10)+"px"; sp.style.top=(e.clientY+Math.random()*20-10)+"px"; document.body.appendChild(sp); setTimeout(()=>sp.remove(),700); } }

// --- INIT ---
function initHub(){ loadStates(); renderAllSeedsUI(); updateActivityFeedUI();
document.getElementById("launch-all-btn").addEventListener("click",launchAllSeeds);
document.getElementById("pause-all-btn").addEventListener("click",pauseAllSeeds);
document.getElementById("resume-all-btn").addEventListener("click",resumeAllSeeds);
document.getElementById("reset-all-btn").addEventListener("click",resetAllSeeds);
document.getElementById("autopilot-btn").addEventListener("click",toggleAutopilot);
document.getElementById("export-btn").addEventListener("click",exportJSON);
document.getElementById("speed-slider").addEventListener("input",e=>setGlobalSpeed(e.target.value));
document.getElementById("soul-test-btn").addEventListener("click",testWritingsOfTheSoul);
setInterval(saveStates,5000); }
window.addEventListener("beforeunload",saveStates);
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",initHub);
window.addEventListener("resize",()=>{ canvas.width=window.innerWidth; canvas.height=window.innerHeight; });
</script>
</body>
</html>

// Super Saiyan Audit Hub v6 FINAL JS Standalone
const SEED_COUNT=5, MAX_ACTIVITY_LOG=200;
let seedStates=[], seedIntervals=[], rafPending=false, globalSpeed=100, activityFeed=[], autopilot=false;

const seedContainer=document.getElementById("seeds-container");
const activityFeedEl=document.getElementById("activity-feed");
const missionOverlay=document.getElementById("mission-overlay");
const canvas=document.getElementById("fireworks-canvas");
const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");

function initSeeds(){ 
    seedStates=Array.from({length:SEED_COUNT},(_,i)=>({
        id:i, progress:0, status:"IDLE", fail:0, warn:0, pass:0, total:0, elapsed:0, lastTick:performance.now()
    }));
}

function saveStates(){ 
    try{ localStorage.setItem("seedStates_v6",JSON.stringify(seedStates)); } 
    catch(e){ console.error(e); } 
}

function loadStates(){ 
    try{ 
        const data=localStorage.getItem("seedStates_v6"); 
        if(data) seedStates=JSON.parse(data); 
        else initSeeds(); 
    } catch(e){ initSeeds(); } 
}

function logActivity(msg,type="info"){ 
    const entry=`[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${msg}`; 
    activityFeed.push({text:entry,type}); 
    if(activityFeed.length>MAX_ACTIVITY_LOG) activityFeed.shift(); 
    updateActivityFeedUI(); 
}

function updateActivityFeedUI(){ 
    if(rafPending)return; 
    rafPending=true; 
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        activityFeedEl.innerHTML=""; 
        activityFeed.forEach(a=>{
            const item=document.createElement("div"); 
            item.textContent=a.text; 
            item.style.color=a.type==="fail"?"red":a.type==="warn"?"orange":"white"; 
            activityFeedEl.appendChild(item); 
        }); 
        activityFeedEl.scrollTop=activityFeedEl.scrollHeight; 
        rafPending=false; 
    }); 
}

function tickSeed(seed){ 
    if(seed.status!=="RUNNING")return; 
    const now=performance.now(); 
    const delta=(now-seed.lastTick)*(autopilot?2:1); 
    seed.elapsed+=delta; 
    seed.lastTick=now;
    let inc=Math.random()*5; 
    if(autopilot) inc*=1.5; 
    seed.progress=Math.min(100,seed.progress+inc); 
    seed.total++; 
    const r=Math.random();
    if(r<0.02){ seed.fail++; logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} FAIL`,"fail"); flashFail(seed.id); }
    else if(r<0.06){ seed.warn++; logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} WARN`,"warn"); }
    else seed.pass++; 
    updateSeedUI(seed); 
    if(seed.progress>=100){ 
        seed.status="COMPLETE"; 
        logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} COMPLETE`); 
        updateSeedUI(seed); 
        checkMissionComplete(); 
        clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]); 
    } 
}

function flashFail(seedId){ 
    const el=document.getElementById(`seed-${seedId}`); 
    if(!el)return; 
    el.classList.add("fail-flash"); 
    setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("fail-flash"),300); 
}

function updateSeedUI(seed){ 
    const el=document.getElementById(`seed-${seed.id}`); 
    if(!el)return; 
    const bar=el.querySelector(".progress-bar"); 
    bar.style.width=`${seed.progress}%`; 
    el.querySelector(".status").textContent=seed.status; 
    el.querySelector(".status").style.color=seed.status==="COMPLETE"?"gold":seed.status==="RUNNING"?"lime":seed.status==="PAUSED"?"yellow":"white"; 
    el.querySelector(".elapsed").textContent=`Elapsed: ${(seed.elapsed/1000).toFixed(1)}s`; 
}

function renderAllSeedsUI(){ 
    seedContainer.innerHTML=""; 
    seedStates.forEach(seed=>{
        const card=document.createElement("div"); 
        card.className="seed-card"; 
        card.id=`seed-${seed.id}`; 
        card.innerHTML=`
            <div class="header">Seed ${seed.id}</div>
            <div class="progress"><div class="progress-bar"></div></div>
            <div class="status">IDLE</div>
            <div class="elapsed">Elapsed: 0.0s</div>
        `; 
        seedContainer.appendChild(card); 
    }); 
}

// Fireworks
let fireworks=[]; 
function checkMissionComplete(){ 
    if(seedStates.every(s=>s.status==="COMPLETE")){ 
        missionOverlay.style.display="flex"; 
        launchFireworks(); 
        setTimeout(()=>missionOverlay.style.display="none",5000); 
    } 
}
function launchFireworks(){ 
    for(let i=0;i<50;i++){ fireworks.push({x:Math.random()*canvas.width,y:canvas.height, vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*5, vy:-Math.random()*7-3, alpha:1}); } 
    drawFireworks(); 
}
function drawFireworks(){ 
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height); 
    fireworks.forEach(f=>{ 
        ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,0,${f.alpha})`; 
        ctx.beginPath(); 
        ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,3,0,Math.PI*2); 
        ctx.fill(); 
        f.x+=f.vx; f.y+=f.vy; f.alpha-=0.02; 
    }); 
    fireworks=fireworks.filter(f=>f.alpha>0); 
    if(fireworks.length>0) requestAnimationFrame(drawFireworks); 
}

// Controls
function startSeed(seed){ 
    if(seed.status==="IDLE"||seed.status==="PAUSED"){

}
function launchAllSeeds(){ seedStates.forEach(startSeed); }
function pauseAllSeeds(){ seedStates.forEach(s=>{ if(s.status==="RUNNING")s.status="PAUSED"; if(seedIntervals[s.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[s.id]); updateSeedUI(s); }); logActivity("All seeds PAUSED"); }
function resumeAllSeeds(){ seedStates.forEach(startSeed); logActivity("All seeds RESUMED"); }
function resetAllSeeds(){ if(!confirm("Are you sure to reset all? This cannot be undone.")) return; seedStates.forEach((s,i)=>{ if(seedIntervals[i]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[i]); }); localStorage.removeItem("seedStates_v6"); initSeeds(); renderAllSeedsUI(); activityFeed=[]; updateActivityFeedUI(); }
function toggleAutopilot(){ autopilot=!autopilot; document.getElementById("autopilot-btn").classList.toggle("autopilot-on",autopilot); }
function setGlobalSpeed(value){ globalSpeed=Number(value); seedStates.forEach(s=>{ if(seedIntervals[s.id]) clearInterval(seedIntervals[s.id]); if(s.status==="RUNNING") seedIntervals[s.id]=setInterval(()=>tickSeed(s),globalSpeed); }); }
function exportJSON(){ const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(seedStates,null,2)],{type:"application/json"}); const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download="seed_audit_v6_final.json"; a.click(); logActivity("Exported seed states JSON"); }
function copyJS(){ const jsCode=document.currentScript.innerText; navigator.clipboard.writeText(jsCode).then(()=>alert("JS code copied to clipboard!")); }
function testWritingsOfTheSoul(e){

// Inside your existing SeedSimulator class
class SeedSimulator {
  constructor(id) {
    this.uuid = crypto.randomUUID(); // Feature #9
    this.id = id;
    this.progress = 0;
    this.status = "IDLE";
    this.failCount = 0;
    this.warnCount = 0;
    this.passCount = 0;
    this.elapsed = 0;
    this.checkpoints = []; // Feature #1 & #2
  }

  saveCheckpoint() {
    const snapshot = {
      progress: this.progress,
      status: this.status,
      fail: this.failCount,
      warn: this.warnCount,
      pass: this.passCount,
      elapsed: this.elapsed
    };
    this.checkpoints.push(snapshot);
    if(this.checkpoints.length > 10) this.checkpoints.shift(); // keep last 10
  }

  retryFailedStep() { // Feature #3
    if(this.status === "FAIL") {
      this.status = "RUNNING";
      logActivity(`Retrying failed step for Seed ${this.id} (UUID: ${this.uuid})`, "INFO");
    }
  }

  tick() {
    if(this.status !== "RUNNING") return;

    const delta = Math.random()*5;
    this.progress = Math.min(this.progress + delta, 100);
    this.elapsed += 100;

    if(this.progress >= 100) {
      this.status = "COMPLETE";
      logActivity(`Seed ${this.id} completed!`, "PASS");
      checkMissionComplete();
    }

    if(Math.random()<0.02) { // simulated warn/fail
      const type = Math.random()<0.5?"WARN":"FAIL";
      logActivity(`Seed ${this.id} triggered ${type}!`, type);
      if(type==="FAIL") this.failCount++;
      else this.warnCount++;
    }

    this.saveCheckpoint(); // auto-save checkpoint
  }
}

// Feature #4 - offline warning
window.addEventListener('offline', ()=>alert('You are offline — progress may not save.'));
window.addEventListener('online', ()=>logActivity('Back online', 'INFO'));

// Feature #5 - ETA display per seed
function calculateETA(seed){
  const remaining = 100 - seed.progress;
  const avgDelta = 2; // approx average per tick
  return Math.ceil(remaining/avgDelta) + " sec";
}

// Feature #6 & #7 - freeze/watchdog detection
setInterval(()=>{
  seedInstances.forEach(seed=>{
    if(seed.status==="RUNNING" && seed.progress===seed.lastProgress){
      logActivity(`Seed ${seed.id} appears stalled!`, "WARN");
      seed.lastProgress = seed.progress;
    } else seed.lastProgress = seed.progress;
  });
}, 5000);

// Feature #8 - auto pause/resume on tab visibility
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', ()=>{
  if(document.hidden) seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.pause());
  else seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.resume());
});

// Feature #10 - enhanced activity feed logging
function logActivity(msg, type="INFO"){
  const feed = document.getElementById('activity-feed');
  const item = document.createElement('div');
  item.textContent = `[${new Date().toISOString()}][${type}] ${msg}`;
  feed.appendChild(item);
  if(feed.scrollTop+feed.clientHeight >= feed.scrollHeight-20){
    feed.scrollTop = feed.scrollHeight;
  }
}

<header>Gemini Ultra Seed v1</header>

<div id="control-panel">
  <button id="launch-all">🚀 Launch All Seeds</button>
  <button id="autopilot">🤖 AUTOPILOT</button>
  <button id="pause-all">⏸ PAUSE ALL</button>
  <button id="reset-all">↻ RESET ALL</button>
  <button id="export-json">💾 EXPORT JSON</button>
  <input type="range" id="speed-slider" min="10" max="500" value="100">
</div>

<div id="seeds-container"></div>
<div id="activity-feed"></div>
<div id="mission-complete">MISSION COMPLETE</div>

<script>
/* ================== Gemini Ultra Seed JS ================== */
const SEED_COUNT = 5;
let seedStates = [];
let seedInstances = [];
let rafPending = false;
let autopilot = false;
let baseDelay = 100;
const MAX_LOGS = 200;

/* -------------------- Utilities -------------------- */
function logActivity(msg, type='pass') {
  const feed = document.getElementById('activity-feed');
  const item = document.createElement('div');
  item.textContent = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${msg}`;
  item.className = 'log-' + type;
  feed.appendChild(item);
  while(feed.children.length > MAX_LOGS) feed.removeChild(feed.firstChild);
  feed.scrollTop = feed.scrollHeight;
}

function saveStates() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('ultraSeedState', JSON.stringify(seedStates));
  } catch(e) {
    alert('LocalStorage quota exceeded. Please export and clear state.');
  }
}

function loadStates() {
  try {
    seedStates = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ultraSeedState')) || [];
  } catch(e) {
    seedStates = [];
  }
}

/* -------------------- Seed Class -------------------- */
class Seed {
  constructor(id) {
    this.id = id;
    this.status = 'IDLE';
    this.progress = 0;
    this.fail = 0;
    this.warn = 0;
    this.pass = 0;
    this.elapsed = 0;
    this.uuid = crypto.randomUUID();
    this.interval = null;
    this.card = document.createElement('div');
    this.card.className = 'seed-card';
    this.card.innerHTML = `<h3>Seed ${id+1}</h3><div>Status: <span class="status">${this.status}</span></div><div class="progress-bar" style="width:0%"></div>`;
    document.getElementById('seeds-container').appendChild(this.card);
  }
  updateCard() {
    const statusEl = this.card.querySelector('.status');
    const bar = this.card.querySelector('.progress-bar');
    statusEl.textContent = this.status;
    bar.style.width = this.progress + '%';
  }
  tick() {
    if(this.status !== 'RUNNING') return;
    const inc = autopilot ? Math.random()*5 : Math.random()*2;
    this.progress = Math.min(100, this.progress + inc);
    this.elapsed += baseDelay;
    // simulate fail/warn
    if(Math.random() < 0.01) { this.fail++; logActivity(`Seed ${this.id+1} FAIL`, 'fail'); }
    else if(Math.random() < 0.02) { this.warn++; logActivity(`Seed ${this.id+1} WARN`, 'warn'); }
    else this.pass++;
    this.updateCard();
    if(this.progress >= 100) this.complete();
  }
  start() {
    if(this.status==='COMPLETE') return;
    this.status='RUNNING';
    this.updateCard();
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.interval = setInterval(()=>this.tick(), baseDelay);
  }
  pause() {
    if(this.status!=='RUNNING') return;
    this.status='PAUSED';
    clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.updateCard();
  }
  resume() {
    if(this.status!=='PAUSED') this.start();
    else { this.status='RUNNING'; this.interval = setInterval(()=>this.tick(), baseDelay); this.updateCard(); }
  }
  reset() {
    this.status='IDLE';
    this.progress=0; this.fail=0; this.warn=0; this.pass=0; this.elapsed=0;
    clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.updateCard();
  }
  complete() {
    this.status='COMPLETE';
    clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.updateCard();
    checkMissionComplete();
  }
}

/* -------------------- Initialize -------------------- */
function initSeeds() {
  document.getElementById('seeds-container').innerHTML = '';
  seedInstances = [];
  for(let i=0;i<SEED_COUNT;i++) {
    const s = new Seed(i);
    seedInstances.push(s);
  }
}

function checkMissionComplete() {
  if(seedInstances.every(s=>s.status==='COMPLETE')) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('mission-complete');
    overlay.style.display='block';
    setTimeout(()=>overlay.style.display='none', 5000);
    logActivity('MISSION COMPLETE', 'pass');
  }
}

/* -------------------- Control Panel -------------------- */
document.getElementById('launch-all').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.start());
  logActivity('🚀 Launch All Seeds command executed', 'pass');
});
document.getElementById('autopilot').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  autopilot=!autopilot;
  document.getElementById('autopilot').style.background = autopilot ? '#8000ff' : '#111';
  logActivity('🤖 AUTOPILOT '+(autopilot?'ENGAGED':'DISENGAGED'), 'pass');
});
document.getElementById('pause-all').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.pause());
  document.getElementById('pause-all').textContent = '▶ RESUME ALL';
  document.getElementById('pause-all').onclick = ()=>{ seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.resume()); document.getElementById('pause-all').textContent='⏸ PAUSE ALL'; };
});
document.getElementById('reset-all').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(confirm('Are you sure to reset all? This cannot be undone.')) {
    seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.reset());
    localStorage.removeItem('ultraSeedState');
    logActivity('All seeds reset', 'warn');
  }
});
document.getElementById('export-json').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(seedInstances.map(s=>({
    id:s.id,status:s.status,progress:s.progress,fail:s.fail,warn:s.warn,pass:s.pass,elapsed:s.elapsed,uuid:s.uuid
  })),null,2)], {type:'application/json'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download='gemini_ultra_seed.json';
  a.click();
  logActivity('Exported seed JSON', 'pass');
});
document.getElementById('speed-slider').addEventListener('input', e=>{
  baseDelay = parseInt(e.target.value);
  seedInstances.forEach(s=>{
    if(s.interval) { clearInterval(s.interval); s.interval=setInterval(()=>s.tick(), baseDelay); }
  });
});

/* -------------------- "Writings of the Soul" Test -------------------- */
function writingsOfTheSoulTest() {
  const prompts = [
    "Write a story about a seed discovering consciousness.",
    "Describe an AI-PET dreaming for the first time.",

  ];

}

loadStates();

  else seedInstances.forEach(s=>s.resume());
});
</script>

For encrypting stored AI-PET persistent state, the recommended encryption algorithms and key sizes are:
Symmetric Encryption (for data-at-rest such as localStorage or IndexedDB):
AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) with 256-bit keys is the industry standard for secure symmetric encryption.
Use AES in an authenticated encryption mode like GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) or CCM to ensure confidentiality and integrity.
Key size: 256 bits (AES-256) for maximum security; 128 bits acceptable if performance is critical and sufficient threat model.
Asymmetric Encryption (for key exchange, secure bootstrapping):
Use Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) with secure NIST curves like P-256 or P-384, or modern curves like Curve25519 for key exchange and digital signatures.
If ECC not available, use RSA with key size 2048 bits minimum, ideally 3072 bits for longer-term security.
Employ secure padding schemes such as OAEP (Optimal Asymmetric Encryption Padding) or RSASSA-PSS.
Key Management:
Store symmetric keys securely using a hardware security module (HSM) or secure enclave when possible.
Implement periodic key rotation to limit exposure in case of key compromise.
Use established key derivation functions (e.g., HKDF) when generating encryption keys from user secrets.
Additional Best Practices:
Use TLS 1.3+ for all data transmission with strong cipher suites to protect data in transit.
Implement cryptographic integrity checks (e.g., using HMAC with SHA-256 or SHA-3) alongside encryption.
Avoid deprecated algorithms like DES or 3DES due to vulnerabilities.
Follow NIST SP 800-57 recommendations for key lifecycle management.

To manage key rotation and access control for Privacy-Enhancing Technology (PET) keys effectively, follow these recommended best practices:
Key Rotation Management
Set Rotation Policies and Frequency
Rotate keys regularly based on time (e.g., every 30, 60, or 90 days) or usage (e.g., after a certain number of operations).
Rotate immediately in response to security incidents or suspected compromise.
Automate Key Rotation
Use automated key management services or hardware security modules (HSMs) to generate, distribute, and retire keys seamlessly.
Ensure new keys are generated and propagated before old keys expire to prevent service interruptions.
Versioning & Graceful Key Retirement
Maintain multiple key versions during rotation periods to allow decrypting data encrypted with old keys while using new keys for encryption.
Retire old keys only after confirming no data depends on them.
Secure Key Distribution
Distribute keys securely between components or systems, using authenticated channels and public-key infrastructures.
Use standards like JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS) for sharing public keys reliably.
Audit & Monitoring
Log every key generation, rotation, usage, and retirement event with timestamps and user/process identity for compliance and forensic analysis.
Set up alerts for unusual key access or rotation failures.
Access Control for PET Keys
Strict Access Policies
Restrict key access to authorized users, services, and applications with the principle of least privilege.
Use role-based access control (RBAC) or attribute-based access control (ABAC) to enforce fine-grained permissions.
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Protect key management interfaces and systems with MFA to reduce risk of unauthorized key access.
Segmentation and Isolation
Isolate key management components from other systems physically or logically to reduce attack surface.
Use hardware security modules (HSMs) or Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs) for secure key storage.
Secure Key Storage
Store private keys encrypted at rest with limited access, preferably in dedicated secure vaults or KMS platforms.
Regular Access Reviews
Periodically review and audit who has access to PET keys and adjust policies accordingly.


Summary
Implement automated, policy-driven key rotation combined with rigorous access controls enforced through RBAC and MFA. Use secure key distribution protocols and maintain strong audit trails for traceability. Leverage secure hardware and cloud services designed for key management to provide both robust security and operational scalability. This approach ensures PET keys remain secure, minimizes exposure risk, and maintains system integrity over time.
This strategy aligns with industry best practices and the latest cryptographic governance standards crucial for your AI-PET persistent state management.

To validate confidentiality, integrity, and recoverability of your AI-PET persistent state and overall system, here are key tests and validation steps:


Confidentiality Tests
Access Control Testing
Verify only authorized users/processes can access sensitive data.
Test role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC) enforcement.
Encryption Verification
Ensure all sensitive data at rest is encrypted (AES-256-GCM or stronger).
Validate encryption keys are properly rotated and stored securely.
Test data transit encryption (TLS 1.3+) through capture and replay attempts.
Penetration Testing
Conduct controlled attacks (e.g., injection, XSS) to identify leakage or unauthorized access paths.
Verify no sensitive data is revealed through verbose error messages or logs.


Integrity Tests
Checksum and Hash Verification
Generate and verify SHA-256 or SHA-3 hashes of persisted data before and after storage or transmission.
Use HMAC to ensure message authenticity and detect tampering.
Data Validation
Validate input against schemas, types, and referential integrity constraints.
Automate data validation tests for boundary values, nulls, and malformed inputs.
Audit Logging Consistency
Test that all critical state changes and audit events are logged with correct timestamps.
Verify audit logs themselves are tamper-evident and regularly backed up.
Backup and Restore Integrity
Periodically recover from backups and compare restored data checksums with originals.
Perform delta/diff checks on datasets before and after recovery.


Recoverability Tests
Backup Integrity Testing
Verify scheduled backups are created successfully and without corruption.
Test restoration procedures end-to-end regularly to ensure backups are viable.
Failover and Redundancy Testing
Simulate partial system/component failures and verify automatic or manual failover mechanisms operate correctly.
Stress test recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO).
Disaster Recovery Drills
Conduct simulated data loss or corruption scenarios to validate recovery playbooks and readiness.
Data Synchronization Tests
Test multi-client or multi-tab synchronization for persistent data states to avoid conflicts or loss.


These targeted tests ensure your AI-PET system’s sensitive data remains confidential, accurate, and recoverable, maintaining trustworthiness and availability. Regularly automating these validations as part of your QA and DevOps pipelines will continually safeguard system reliability and security.

  };

  // =================== UTILITY FUNCTIONS ===================
  const Utils = {
    now: () => new Date().toISOString(),
    randomId: () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e12),
    deepClone: (obj) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj)),
    hash: async (str) => {
      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
      const data = encoder.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer))
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join("");
    },
    sleep: (ms) => new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, ms)),
    encryptAES: async (text, key) => {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(text);
      const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
      const cipher = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
        { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
        key,
        data
      );
      return { cipher: new Uint8Array(cipher), iv };
    },
    decryptAES: async (cipher, key, iv) => {
      const plainBuffer = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
        { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
        key,
        cipher
      );
      return new TextDecoder().decode(plainBuffer);
    },

      crypto.subtle.generateKey(
        { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
        true,
        ["encrypt", "decrypt"]
      ),
  };

  // =================== PERSISTENT STATE ===================
  class PersistentState {
    constructor(maxHistory = CONFIG.persistence.historyLimit) {
      this.seeds = {};
      this.historyLimit = maxHistory;
      this.load();
    }

    async save() {
      const serialized = JSON.stringify(this.seeds);
      const key = await Utils.generateAESKey();
      const { cipher, iv } = await Utils.encryptAES(serialized, key);
      localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.persistence.localStorageKey, JSON.stringify({
        cipher: Array.from(cipher),
        iv: Array.from(iv),
      }));
    }

    load() {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.persistence.localStorageKey);
      if (!data) return;

    getSeed(id) {
      if (!this.seeds[id]) {
        this.seeds[id] = {
          seedId: id,
          progress: 0,
          status: "IDLE",
          failCount: 0,
          warnCount: 0,
          passCount: 0,
          totalCount: 0,
          elapsedTime: 0,
          lastUpdated: Utils.now(),
          history: [],
          logs: [],
          stateHash: null,
        };
      }

      const seed = this.getSeed(seedId);
      const entry = { timestamp: Utils.now(), event, details };
      seed.logs.push(entry);

  class SeedSimulator {

      this.interval = null;
    }

    start(intervalMs = 1000) {

      this.interval = setInterval(async () => {
        const delta = Math.random() * 5;
        await this.aiPet.evaluate(delta);
        state.save();
      }, intervalMs);
    }

    pause() {
      clearInterval(this.interval);
      this.interval = null;
      state.getSeed(this.seedId).status = "PAUSED";
    }

    reset() {
      this.pause();
      const seed = state.getSeed(this.seedId);
      seed.progress = 0;
      seed.status = "IDLE";

  // -------------------- Utility Libraries --------------------
  const crypto = window.crypto || window.msCrypto;

  function generateUUID() {
    return ([1e7]+-1e3+-4e3+-8e3+-1e11).replace(/[018]/g, c =>
      (c ^ crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0] & 15 >> c / 4).toString(16)

  function sha256(str) {
    const buf = new TextEncoder('utf-8').encode(str);

function addSeed(seedId) {
  PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.seeds.push({
    seedId,
    progress: 0,
    status: "IDLE",
    failCount: 0,
    warnCount: 0,
    passCount: 0,
    totalCount: 0,
    elapsedTime: 0,
    lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
    history: [],
    logs: [],
    stateHash: ""
  });
}

// Start a seed
function startSeed(seedId) {
  const seed = PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.seeds.find(s => s.seedId === seedId);
  if(seed) seed.status = "RUNNING";
}

// Pause / Resume
function toggleSeed(seedId) {
  const seed = PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.seeds.find(s => s.seedId === seedId);
  if(seed) seed.status = seed.status === "PAUSED" ? "RUNNING" : "PAUSED";
}
Lesson Generation
function generateLesson(seedId, topic, format = "HTML") {
  const seed = PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.seeds.find(s => s.seedId === seedId);
  if(!seed) return;

  const lesson = {
    topic,
    format,
    content: `Dummy content for ${topic} in ${format}`,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  seed.history.push({ timestamp: lesson.timestamp, event: "LessonGenerated", details: lesson });
  logActivity(seedId, `Lesson generated: ${topic} (${format})`);
  return lesson;
}
AI-PET Interaction
function giveFeedback(seedId, message) {
  const seed = PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.seeds.find(s => s.seedId === seedId);
  if(seed) {
    seed.logs.push({ timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), event: "Feedback", value: message });
    PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.globalLogs.push(`[AI-PET][Seed ${seedId}]: ${message}`);
  }
}
Autopilot
function startAutopilot() {
  PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.settings.autopilot = true;
  PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.seeds.forEach(seed => {
    if(seed.status !== "COMPLETE") seed.status = "RUNNING";
  });
  logActivity("SYSTEM", "Autopilot started for all seeds.");
}
Activity Logging
function logActivity(seedId, message) {
  PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.globalLogs.push(`[${seedId}] ${message}`);
}
Export / Backup
function exportState() {
  // Dummy encryption: just JSON stringify for now
  const blob = btoa(JSON.stringify(PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state));
  PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.exportedBlobs.push({ blob, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), keyVersion: PLEX_RISING_PHOENIX_SEED.state.keyVersion });
  logActivity("SYSTEM", "State exported (encrypted).");
  return blob;
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Rising Phoenix Master Seed (Dummy)</title>
<style>
  body { background: #05020d; color: #F0F0F0; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace; padding: 20px; }
  h1 { text-align: center; color: #FFD700; text-shadow: 0 0 15px #FFD700; }
  #controls { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  button { margin: 0 5px; padding: 10px 15px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-weight: bold; }
  #seeds-container { display: flex; gap: 15px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .seed-card { background: rgba(22,9,43,0.8); padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; width: 200px; }
  .progress-bar-bg { background: #222; height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; margin: 5px 0; }
  .progress-bar { height: 100%; background: #00FF88; width: 0%; transition: width 0.3s; }
  #activity-feed { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; height: 150px; overflow-y: auto; margin-top: 20px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<h1>Rising Phoenix Master Seed</h1>

<div id="controls">
  <button id="launch-all">🚀 Launch All</button>
  <button id="pause-all">⏸ Pause All</button>
  <button id="resume-all">▶ Resume All</button>
  <button id="reset-all">↻ Reset All</button>
  <button id="autopilot">🤖 Autopilot</button>
  <button id="export">💾 Export JSON</button>
</div>

<div id="seeds-container"></div>
<div id="activity-feed"></div>

<script>
const seeds = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Seed 1', progress: 0, status: 'IDLE', fail: 0, warn: 0, pass: 0 },
  { id: 2, name: 'Seed 2', progress: 0, status: 'IDLE', fail: 0, warn: 0, pass: 0 },
  { id: 3, name: 'Seed 3', progress: 0, status: 'IDLE', fail: 0, warn: 0, pass: 0 },
];

let autopilotOn = false;
let seedIntervals = {};

const seedsContainer = document.getElementById('seeds-container');
const feed = document.getElementById('activity-feed');

function logActivity(msg) {
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.textContent = `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${msg}`;
  feed.prepend(div);
}

function renderSeeds() {
  seedsContainer.innerHTML = '';
  seeds.forEach(seed => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'seed-card';
    card.innerHTML = `
      <strong>${seed.name}</strong> (${seed.status})<br>
      <div class="progress-bar-bg">
        <div class="progress-bar" style="width:${seed.progress}%"></div>
      </div>
      ✅${seed.pass} ⚠️${seed.warn} ❌${seed.fail}
    `;
    seedsContainer.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function updateSeedProgress(seed) {
  if(seed.status !== 'RUNNING') return;
  const increment = Math.floor(Math.random()*10)+1;
  seed.progress += increment;
  if(seed.progress >= 100) {
    seed.progress = 100;
    seed.status = 'COMPLETE';
    seed.pass++;
    logActivity(`${seed.name} completed successfully.`);
    clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]);
    delete seedIntervals[seed.id];
  } else {
    const rnd = Math.random();
    if(rnd<0.05){ seed.fail++; logActivity(`${seed.name} hit a fail.`);}
    else if(rnd<0.15){ seed.warn++; logActivity(`${seed.name} has a warning.`);}
    else { seed.pass++; }
  }
  renderSeeds();
}

function launchAll() {
  seeds.forEach(seed => {
    if(seed.status==='IDLE' || seed.status==='PAUSED'){
      seed.status = 'RUNNING';
      if(!seedIntervals[seed.id])
        seedIntervals[seed.id] = setInterval(()=>updateSeedProgress(seed), 500);
      logActivity(`${seed.name} launched.`);
    }
  });
}

function pauseAll() {
  seeds.forEach(seed => {
    if(seed.status==='RUNNING'){
      seed.status='PAUSED';
      clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]);
      delete seedIntervals[seed.id];
      logActivity(`${seed.name} paused.`);
    }
  });
  renderSeeds();
}

function resumeAll() {
  seeds.forEach(seed => {
    if(seed.status==='PAUSED'){
      seed.status='RUNNING';
      seedIntervals[seed.id] = setInterval(()=>updateSeedProgress(seed),500);
      logActivity(`${seed.name} resumed.`);
    }
  });
  renderSeeds();
}

function resetAll() {
  seeds.forEach(seed => {
    seed.progress = 0;
    seed.status='IDLE';
    seed.pass = 0; seed.warn = 0; seed.fail=0;
    clearInterval(seedIntervals[seed.id]);
    delete seedIntervals[seed.id];
  });
  logActivity(`All seeds reset.`);
  renderSeeds();
}

function toggleAutopilot() {
  autopilotOn = !autopilotOn;
  logActivity(`Autopilot ${autopilotOn?'enabled':'disabled'}.`);
}

function exportJSON() {
  const data = JSON.stringify(seeds, null, 2);
  logActivity(`Exported seed state.`);
  console.log(data);
  alert('Seed state exported to console.');
}

// Event listeners
document.getElementById('launch-all').addEventListener('click', launchAll);
document.getElementById('pause-all').addEventListener('click', pauseAll);
document.getElementById('resume-all').addEventListener('click', resumeAll);
document.getElementById('reset-all').addEventListener('click', resetAll);
document.getElementById('autopilot').addEventListener('click', toggleAutopilot);
document.getElementById('export').addEventListener('click', exportJSON);

// Initial render
renderSeeds();
logActivity('Rising Phoenix Master Seed ready.');
</script>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<title>Rising Phoenix Prototype</title>
<style>
:root {
  --bg: #05020d;
  --glass: #16092B66;
  --text: #F0F0F0;
  --status-pass: #00FF88;
  --status-warn: #FFC107;
  --status-fail: #FF4444;
  --neon-purple: #9D00FF;
  --neon-gold: #FFD700;
}
body { font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); margin:0; padding:20px; }
h1 { text-align:center; font-size:3em; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFD700, #FF8C00); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; }
.subtitle { text-align:center; color: var(--neon-purple); margin-bottom:20px; }
#controls { text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; }
button { margin:5px; padding:10px 15px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:700; border:2px solid; cursor:pointer; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: var(--text); }
button:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }
#seeds-container { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px,1fr)); gap:15px; }
.seed-card { background: rgba(22,9,43,0.7); padding:15px; border-radius:12px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border:2px solid rgba(200,160,255,0.3); }
.seed-card .header { font-weight:900; color: var(--neon-gold); margin-bottom:10px; }
.progress { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); height:8px; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:5px; }
.progress-bar { height:100%; width:0%; background: var(--neon-gold); transition: width 0.3s; }
#activity-feed { height:200px; overflow-y:auto; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius:10px; padding:10px; font-family:'Roboto Mono', monospace; font-size:0.85em; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>Rising Phoenix Prototype</h1>
<p class="subtitle">AI-PET & Launchpad Dummy Demo</p>

<div id="controls">
<button id="launch-all-btn">🚀 Launch All</button>
<button id="pause-all-btn">⏸ Pause All</button>
<button id="autopilot-btn">🤖 Autopilot</button>
<button id="export-btn">💾 Export JSON</button>
<button id="import-btn">📂 Import JSON</button>
</div>

<div id="seeds-container"></div>
<div id="activity-feed"></div>

<script>
// -------------------- Seed & State Management --------------------
const STORAGE_KEY = 'risingPhoenixState';
let autopilotActive = false;
let seeds = [];

// Dummy initialization
function initSeeds() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  if(saved) {
    seeds = JSON.parse(saved);
  } else {
    seeds = [];
    for(let i=1;i<=5;i++){
      seeds.push({
        id:i,
        name:`Seed ${i}`,
        progress:0,
        status:'IDLE',
        failCount:0,
        warnCount:0,
        passCount:0,
        history:[],
        buddy:null
      });
    }
    saveState();
  }
}
function saveState(){ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(seeds)); }

// -------------------- Rendering --------------------
function renderSeeds() {
  const container = document.getElementById('seeds-container');
  container.innerHTML = '';
  seeds.forEach(seed=>{
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
    const header = document.createElement('div'); header.className='header';
    header.textContent = seed.name + (seed.buddy ? ` 🤝 Buddy ${seed.buddy}` : '');
    const progress = document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
    const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar';
    bar.style.width = seed.progress+'%';
    progress.appendChild(bar);
    const status = document.createElement('div'); status.textContent = 'Status: '+seed.status;
    card.appendChild(header); card.appendChild(progress); card.appendChild(status);
    container.appendChild(card);
  });
}
function logActivity(msg){ 
  const feed = document.getElementById('activity-feed'); 
  const div = document.createElement('div'); div.textContent = `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${msg}`; 
  feed.prepend(div); 
}

// -------------------- Seed Actions --------------------
function launchAll() {
  seeds.forEach(seed=>{
    if(seed.status!=='COMPLETE') seed.status='RUNNING';
    simulateSeed(seed);
  });
  renderSeeds();
}
function pauseAll(){
  seeds.forEach(seed=>{ if(seed.status==='RUNNING') seed.status='PAUSED'; });
  renderSeeds();
}
function toggleAutopilot(){
  autopilotActive = !autopilotActive;
  document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').style.background = autopilotActive ? 'var(--neon-gold)' : '';
  document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').style.color = autopilotActive ? 'var(--bg)' : 'var(--text)';
  if(autopilotActive){ runAutopilot(); }
}

// -------------------- Seed Simulation --------------------
function simulateSeed(seed){
  if(seed.status!=='RUNNING') return;
  const increment = Math.floor(Math.random()*20)+5;
  seed.progress += increment;
  if(seed.progress>=100){ 
    seed.progress=100; seed.status='COMPLETE'; seed.passCount++; 
    seed.history.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(), event:'PASS', details:{progress:seed.progress}});
    logActivity(`[AI-PET] ${seed.name} completed successfully!`);
  } else {
    seed.history.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(), event:'PROGRESS', details:{increment}});
    logActivity(`[AI-PET] ${seed.name} progressed by ${increment}%`);
  }
  saveState();
  renderSeeds();
  if(seed.status==='RUNNING') setTimeout(()=>simulateSeed(seed), 1000);
}

// -------------------- Autopilot --------------------
function runAutopilot(){
  if(!autopilotActive) return;
  seeds.forEach(seed=>{
    if(seed.status!=='COMPLETE' && seed.status!=='RUNNING'){
      seed.status='RUNNING';
      logActivity(`[Autopilot] Launching ${seed.name}`);
      simulateSeed(seed);
    }
  });
  setTimeout(runAutopilot, 2000);
}

// -------------------- Export / Import --------------------
function exportJSON(){
  const dataStr = JSON.stringify(seeds,null,2);
  const blob = new Blob([dataStr], {type:"application/json"});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download='risingPhoenix.json'; a.click();
}
function importJSON(){
  const input = document.createElement('input'); input.type='file';
  input.onchange = e=>{
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = e=>{
      seeds = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      saveState();
      renderSeeds();
      logActivity('[System] Seeds imported.');
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };
  input.click();
}

// -------------------- Buddy Pairing --------------------
function pairBuddies(){
  seeds.forEach((s,i)=>{
    if(i%2===0 && seeds[i+1]) { s.buddy=seeds[i+1].id; seeds[i+1].buddy=s.id; }
  });
}

// -------------------- Controls --------------------
document.getElementById('launch-all-btn').onclick=launchAll;
document.getElementById('pause-all-btn').onclick=pauseAll;
document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').onclick=toggleAutopilot;
document.getElementById('export-btn').onclick=exportJSON;
document.getElementById('import-btn').onclick=importJSON;

// -------------------- Initialization --------------------
initSeeds();
pairBuddies();
renderSeeds();
logActivity('[System] Rising Phoenix Prototype initialized.');
</script>
</body>
</html>
✅ Features in this prototype:
Persistent seed state (localStorage)

Buddy system with paired feedback

Autopilot runs seeds intelligently and logs status

Activity feed with timestamps and AI-PET style messages

Export & Import JSON to save/load all seeds

Gold/purple themed UI, seed cards, and progress bars

:root {

}
body::before, body::after {

}

}
body::after {
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 4px, rgba(0,224,255,0.03) 4px, rgba(0,224,255,0.03) 8px);
