}
@keyframes bgShift {0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg);}50%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(2deg);}}
@keyframes gridPulse {0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}50%{opacity:0.7;}}
h1 {text-align:center;font-size:3em;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFD700,#FF8C00,#FFD700);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-size:200% 200%;animation:goldShimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.6));margin-bottom:10px;}
@keyframes goldShimmer {0%,100%{background-position:0% 50%;}50%{background-position:100% 50%;}}
.subtitle {text-align:center;color:#9D00FF;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:0.9em;text-shadow:0 0 15px #9D00FF;margin-bottom:40px;}
#controls {text-align:center;margin:20px 0;padding:20px;background:rgba(22,9,43,0.5);border-radius:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;}
button {padding:12px 20px;margin:0 5px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s;border:2px solid;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);color:var(--text);}
button:hover {transform:scale(1.05);box-shadow:0 0 20px currentColor;}
button:disabled {opacity:0.4;cursor:not-allowed;transform:scale(1);box-shadow:none;}
#launch-all-btn {border-color:var(--status-pass);color:var(--status-pass);}
#pause-all-btn {border-color:var(--status-warn);color:var(--status-warn);}
#resume-all-btn {border-color:var(--status-pass);color:var(--status-pass);display:none;}
#reset-all-btn {border-color:var(--status-fail);color:var(--status-fail);}
#autopilot-btn {border-color:var(--neon-purple);color:var(--neon-purple);}
#autopilot-btn.autopilot-on {background:var(--neon-purple);color:var(--bg);box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--neon-purple);}
#export-btn {border-color:var(--neon-cyan);color:var(--neon-cyan);}
#copy-js-btn {border-color:#888;color:#888;}
#soul-test-btn {border-color:var(--neon-gold);color:var(--neon-gold);}
#speed-slider {vertical-align:middle;accent-color:#9D00FF;}
#seeds-container {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:20px;}
.seed-card {background:rgba(22,9,43,0.7);padding:20px;border-radius:16px;backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(180%);border:2px solid rgba(200,160,255,0.3);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1);transition:all 0.4s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.seed-card:hover {transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 40px var(--neon-cyan), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2);border-color:var(--neon-cyan);}
.seed-card .header {font-size:1.3em;font-weight:900;color:var(--neon-gold);text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--neon-gold);}
.progress {background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);height:8px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px;}
.progress-bar {height:100%;background:var(--neon-gold);width:0%;transition:width 0.3s;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--neon-gold);}
.status-label {font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.8em;color:#A0A0C0;margin-top:10px;}
.status {font-weight:700;font-size:0.9em;letter-spacing:2px;margin:5px 0;}
.elapsed {font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.8em;color:#A0A0C0;}
.fail-flash {animation:failPulse 0.3s;}
@keyframes failPulse {0%,100%{background:rgba(22,9,43,0.7);}50%{background:rgba(255,68,68,0.5);}}
#activity-feed {height:200px;overflow-y:auto;font-size:0.8rem;margin-top:20px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;border:1px solid var(--neon-purple);font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
.activity-feed div {padding:2px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);}
#mission-overlay {position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.9);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#FFD700;font-size:3em;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:5px;z-index:999;text-shadow:0 0 20px #FFD700;}
#fireworks-canvas {position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1000;}
.sparkle {position:fixed;width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--neon-gold);border-radius:50%;z-index:1001;pointer-events:none;opacity:1;animation:sparkle-fade 0.7s forwards;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--neon-gold),0 0 20px var(--neon-gold);}
@keyframes sparkle-fade {to{transform:translateY(20px) scale(0);opacity:0;}}
/* Cheat Sheet Panel */
#cheat-sheet {position:fixed;right:10px;top:80px;width:250px;background:rgba(22,9,43,0.8);padding:10px;border-radius:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-family:'Roboto Mono',monospace;font-size:0.75rem;color:#FFF;line-height:1.4;z-index:2000;}
#cheat-sheet h3{color:var(--neon-gold);margin-bottom:5px;}

<body>
<h1>RISING PHOENIX HUB</h1>
<div class="subtitle">AI-PET & Launchpad v7.0 Prototype</div>

<div id="controls">
  <button id="launch-all-btn">Launch All</button>
  <button id="pause-all-btn">Pause All</button>
  <button id="resume-all-btn">Resume All</button>
  <button id="reset-all-btn">Reset All</button>
  <button id="autopilot-btn">Autopilot</button>
  <button id="export-btn">Export Logs</button>
  <button id="copy-js-btn">Copy JS Seed</button>
  <button id="soul-test-btn">Run SOUL Test</button>
  <label>Speed: <input type="range" min="50" max="500" value="200" id="speed-slider"></label>
</div>

<div id="seeds-container"></div>

<div id="activity-feed"></div>

<div id="mission-overlay">MISSION COMPLETE!</div>

<div id="cheat-sheet">
<h3>Rising Phoenix Cheat Sheet</h3>
<ul>
<li>Launch All → Start all seeds</li>
<li>Pause/Resume → Control all seeds</li>
<li>Autopilot → Automatic seed optimization</li>
<li>Buddy System → Pair seeds for accountability</li>
<li>Export Logs → JSON export of all interactions</li>
<li>SOUL Test → Generate sample lessons & narrative</li>
<li>Speed Slider → Adjust seed tick interval</li>
<li>Activity Feed → Obi persona messages & logs</li>
<li>Mission Overlay → Shown on full completion</li>
<li>Persistence → LocalStorage dummy state saved per seed</li>
</ul>
</div>

<canvas id="fireworks-canvas"></canvas>

<script>
// ==================== Rising Phoenix Prototype JS ====================

// -------- Seed Class --------
class Seed {
  constructor(id) {
    this.id = id;
    this.progress = 0;
    this.status = 'IDLE';
    this.failCount=0; this.warnCount=0; this.passCount=0; this.totalCount=0;
    this.elapsedTime = 0;
    this.history = [];
    this.logs = [];
    this.stateHash = '';
    this.card = null;
    this.interval = null;
  }

  createCard(container){
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
    const header = document.createElement('div'); header.className='header'; header.innerText=`Seed ${this.id}`;
    const progress = document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
    const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar';
    progress.appendChild(bar);
    const statusLabel = document.createElement('div'); statusLabel.className='status-label';
    const status = document.createElement('div'); status.className='status'; status.innerText=this.status;
    const elapsed = document.createElement('div'); elapsed.className='elapsed'; elapsed.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
    statusLabel.appendChild(status); statusLabel.appendChild(elapsed);
    card.append(header, progress, statusLabel);
    container.appendChild(card);
    this.card = card;
    this.bar = bar;
    this.statusEl = status; this.elapsedEl = elapsed;
  }

  updateProgress(step){
    if(this.status==='COMPLETE'){return;}
    this.progress+=step; this.elapsedTime+=step*50;
    if(this.progress>=100){this.progress=100; this.status='COMPLETE'; this.showCompletion();}
    else this.status='RUNNING';
    this.bar.style.width = this.progress+'%';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
    this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
    this.logs.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
  }

  start(interval){
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.status='RUNNING';
    this.interval=setInterval(()=>{this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5);}, interval);
  }

  pause(){
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null;
    if(this.status!=='COMPLETE') this.status='PAUSED';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
  }

  resume(interval){
    if(this.status==='PAUSED') this.start(interval);
  }

  reset(){
    this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.bar.style.width='0%';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status; this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: 0ms`;
  }

  showCompletion(){
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!`);
    triggerMissionOverlay();
  }
}

// -------- Buddy System --------
class BuddySystem {
  constructor(seeds){
    this.seeds = seeds;
  }
  pairAll(){
    for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){
      const s1=this.seeds[i]; const s2=this.seeds[i+1];
      if(s2) logActivity(`[BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`);
    }
  }
}

// -------- Autopilot --------
class Autopilot {
  constructor(seeds, interval){
    this.seeds=seeds; this.interval=interval; this.active=false;
  }
  toggle(){
    this.active=!this.active;
    const btn=document.getElementById('autopilot-btn');
    btn.classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active);
    if(this.active) this.run();
  }
  run(){
    if(!this.active) return;
    this.seeds.forEach(s=>{ if(s.status!=='COMPLETE') s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10); });
    setTimeout(()=>this.run(), this.interval);
  }
}

// -------- Logger / Activity Feed --------
function logActivity(msg){
  const feed=document.getElementById('activity-feed');
  const div=document.createElement('div'); div.innerText=msg;
  feed.appendChild(div); feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight;
}

// -------- Mission Overlay & Fireworks --------
function triggerMissionOverlay(){
  const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay'); overlay.style.display='flex';
  setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.display='none'; spawnFireworks();},2000);
}

function spawnFireworks(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('fireworks-canvas'); const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width=window.innerWidth; canvas.height=window.innerHeight;
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    const x=Math.random()*canvas.width; const y=Math.random()*canvas.height;
    const sparkle=document.createElement('div'); sparkle.className='sparkle';
    sparkle.style.left=x+'px'; sparkle.style.top=y+'px';
    document.body.appendChild(sparkle);
    setTimeout(()=>{sparkle.remove();},700);
  }
}

// -------- System Initialization --------
const seeds=[]; const container=document.getElementById('seeds-container');
for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){const s=new Seed(i); s.createCard(container); seeds.push(s);}
const buddySystem=new BuddySystem(seeds); buddySystem.pairAll();
const autopilot=new Autopilot(seeds,200);

// -------- Control Buttons --------
document.getElementById('launch-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.start(speedSlider.value));};
document.getElementById('pause-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause()); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='inline-block';};
document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.resume(speedSlider.value)); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='none';};
document.getElementById('reset-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.reset());};
document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').onclick=()=>{autopilot.toggle();};
document.getElementById('export-btn').onclick=()=>{download(JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>s.logs)),'rising_phoenix_logs.json');};
document.getElementById('copy-js-btn').onclick=()=>{navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.querySelector('script').innerText); alert('JS Seed copied!');};
document.getElementById('soul-test-btn').onclick=()=>{logActivity('[SOUL TEST] Sample lesson generated: Lorem Ipsum + Narrative');};
const speedSlider=document.getElementById('speed-slider'); speedSlider.oninput=()=>{autopilot.interval=speedSlider.value;};

// -------- Utility: Download JSON --------
function download(content, fileName){const a=document.createElement("a"); const file=new Blob([content],{type:"application/json"}); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(file); a.download=fileName; a.click();}

// ==================== Rising Phoenix Prototype JS END ====================
</script>

</body>
</html>

// ==================== Rising Phoenix Protocol Seed JS ====================

// -------- Seed Class --------
class Seed {
  constructor(id) {
    this.id = id;
    this.progress = 0; this.status = 'IDLE';
    this.failCount=0; this.warnCount=0; this.passCount=0; this.totalCount=0;
    this.elapsedTime = 0; this.history=[]; this.logs=[]; this.stateHash='';
    this.card=null; this.interval=null;
  }

  createCard(container){
    const card=document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
    const header=document.createElement('div'); header.className='header'; header.innerText=`Seed ${this.id}`;
    const progress=document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
    const bar=document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar';
    progress.appendChild(bar);
    const statusLabel=document.createElement('div'); statusLabel.className='status-label';
    const status=document.createElement('div'); status.className='status'; status.innerText=this.status;
    const elapsed=document.createElement('div'); elapsed.className='elapsed'; elapsed.innerText=`Elapsed: 00:00`;
    statusLabel.append(status,elapsed);
    card.append(header,progress,statusLabel); container.appendChild(card);
    this.card=card; this.bar=bar; this.statusEl=status; this.elapsedEl=elapsed;
    card.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{card.classList.add('hover-glow');});
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{card.classList.remove('hover-glow');});
  }

  updateProgress(step){
    if(this.status==='COMPLETE') return;
    this.progress+=step; this.elapsedTime+=step*50;
    if(this.progress>=100){this.progress=100; this.status='COMPLETE'; this.showCompletion();}
    else this.status='RUNNING';
    this.bar.style.width=this.progress+'%'; this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
    this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: ${formatTime(this.elapsedTime)}`;
    this.logs.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
  }

  start(interval){
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval); this.status='RUNNING';
    this.interval=setInterval(()=>{this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5);},interval);
  }

  pause(){if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null;
    if(this.status!=='COMPLETE') this.status='PAUSED'; this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
    this.card.style.opacity=0.85;
  }

  resume(interval){if(this.status==='PAUSED'){this.card.style.opacity=1; this.start(interval);}}

  reset(){if(!confirm(`Reset Seed ${this.id}?`)) return;
    this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[];
    this.bar.style.width='0%'; this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
    this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: 00:00`;
  }

  showCompletion(){
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!`);
    triggerMissionOverlay();
  }
}

// -------- Buddy System --------
class BuddySystem{
  constructor(seeds){this.seeds=seeds;}
  pairAll(){
    for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){
      const s1=this.seeds[i], s2=this.seeds[i+1];
      if(s2){logActivity(`[BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`);
        [s1.card,s2.card].forEach(c=>{c.classList.add('pulse'); setTimeout(()=>c.classList.remove('pulse'),800);});
      }
    }
  }
}

// -------- Autopilot --------
class Autopilot{
  constructor(seeds,interval){this.seeds=seeds; this.interval=interval; this.active=false;}
  toggle(){this.active=!this.active; document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active); if(this.active)this.run();}
  run(){if(!this.active)return;
    this.seeds.forEach(s=>{if(s.status!=='COMPLETE') s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10);});
    setTimeout(()=>this.run(),this.interval);
  }
}

// -------- Logger / Activity Feed --------
function logActivity(msg){
  const feed=document.getElementById('activity-feed');
  const div=document.createElement('div'); div.innerText=msg;
  feed.appendChild(div); feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight;
  if(msg.includes('FAIL')) div.style.color='red';
  else if(msg.includes('WARN')) div.style.color='yellow';
  else if(msg.includes('PASS')) div.style.color='lime';
  setTimeout(()=>{div.style.opacity=0.7;},5000);
}

// -------- Mission Overlay & Fireworks --------
function triggerMissionOverlay(){
  const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay'); overlay.style.display='flex';
  let countdown=3; const countEl=document.getElementById('mission-countdown'); if(countEl)countEl.innerText=countdown;
  const timer=setInterval(()=>{countdown--; if(countEl)countEl.innerText=countdown; if(countdown<=0){clearInterval(timer); overlay.style.display='none'; spawnFireworks();}},1000);
}
function spawnFireworks(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('fireworks-canvas'); const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width=window.innerWidth; canvas.height=window.innerHeight;
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    const x=Math.random()*canvas.width; const y=Math.random()*canvas.height;
    const sparkle=document.createElement('div'); sparkle.className='sparkle'; sparkle.style.left=x+'px'; sparkle.style.top=y+'px';
    document.body.appendChild(sparkle); setTimeout(()=>{sparkle.remove();},700);
  }
}

// -------- Utility --------
function formatTime(ms){const s=Math.floor(ms/1000); return `${String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;}
function download(content,fileName){const a=document.createElement("a"); const file=new Blob([content],{type:"application/json"}); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(file); a.download=fileName; a.click();}

// -------- Collapsible Cheat Sheet --------

cheatHeader.onclick=()=>{cheatSheet.classList.toggle('collapsed');}

for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){const s=new Seed(i); s.createCard(container); seeds.push(s);}

// -------- Seed Class --------
class Seed {
  constructor(id) {
    this.id = id;
    this.progress = 0;
    this.status = 'IDLE';
    this.failCount=0; this.warnCount=0; this.passCount=0; this.totalCount=0;
    this.elapsedTime = 0;
    this.history = [];
    this.logs = [];
    this.stateHash = '';
    this.card = null;
    this.interval = null;
  }

  createCard(container){
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
    const header = document.createElement('div'); header.className='header'; header.innerText=`Seed ${this.id}`;
    const progress = document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
    const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar';
    progress.appendChild(bar);
    const statusLabel = document.createElement('div'); statusLabel.className='status-label';
    const status = document.createElement('div'); status.className='status'; status.innerText=this.status;
    const elapsed = document.createElement('div'); elapsed.className='elapsed'; elapsed.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
    statusLabel.appendChild(status); statusLabel.appendChild(elapsed);
    card.append(header, progress, statusLabel);
    container.appendChild(card);
    this.card = card;
    this.bar = bar;
    this.statusEl = status; this.elapsedEl = elapsed;
  }

  updateProgress(step){
    if(this.status==='COMPLETE'){return;}
    this.progress+=step; this.elapsedTime+=step*50;
    if(this.progress>=100){this.progress=100; this.status='COMPLETE'; this.showCompletion();}
    else this.status='RUNNING';
    this.bar.style.width = this.progress+'%';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
    this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
    this.logs.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
  }

  start(interval){
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.status='RUNNING';
    this.interval=setInterval(()=>{this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5);}, interval);
  }

  pause(){
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null;
    if(this.status!=='COMPLETE') this.status='PAUSED';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
  }

  resume(interval){
    if(this.status==='PAUSED') this.start(interval);
  }

  reset(){
    this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.bar.style.width='0%';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status; this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: 0ms`;
  }

  showCompletion(){
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!`);
    triggerMissionOverlay();
  }
}

// -------- Buddy System --------
class BuddySystem {
  constructor(seeds){ this.seeds=seeds; }
  pairAll(){
    for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){
      const s1=this.seeds[i]; const s2=this.seeds[i+1];
      if(s2) logActivity(`[BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`);
    }
  }
}

// -------- Autopilot --------
class Autopilot {
  constructor(seeds, interval){ this.seeds=seeds; this.interval=interval; this.active=false; }
  toggle(){
    this.active=!this.active;
    const btn=document.getElementById('autopilot-btn');
    btn.classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active);
    if(this.active) this.run();
  }
  run(){
    if(!this.active) return;
    this.seeds.forEach(s=>{ if(s.status!=='COMPLETE') s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10); });
    setTimeout(()=>this.run(), this.interval);
  }
}

// -------- Logger / Activity Feed --------
function logActivity(msg){
  const feed=document.getElementById('activity-feed');
  const div=document.createElement('div'); div.innerText=msg;
  feed.appendChild(div); feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight;
}

// -------- Mission Overlay & Fireworks --------
function triggerMissionOverlay(){
  const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay'); overlay.style.display='flex';
  setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.display='none'; spawnFireworks();},2000);
}

function spawnFireworks(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('fireworks-canvas'); const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width=window.innerWidth; canvas.height=window.innerHeight;
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    const x=Math.random()*canvas.width; const y=Math.random()*canvas.height;
    const sparkle=document.createElement('div'); sparkle.className='sparkle';
    sparkle.style.left=x+'px'; sparkle.style.top=y+'px';
    document.body.appendChild(sparkle);
    setTimeout(()=>{sparkle.remove();},700);
  }
}

// -------- System Initialization --------
const seeds=[]; const container=document.getElementById('dashboard');
for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){const s=new Seed(i); s.createCard(container); seeds.push(s);}
const buddySystem=new BuddySystem(seeds); buddySystem.pairAll();

// -------- Control Buttons --------
const speedSlider=document.getElementById('speed-slider');
document.getElementById('launch-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.start(speedSlider.value));};
document.getElementById('pause-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause()); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='inline-block';};
document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.resume(speedSlider.value)); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='none';};
document.getElementById('reset-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.reset());};
document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').onclick=()=>{autopilot.toggle();};
document.getElementById('export-btn').onclick=()=>{download(JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>s.logs)),'rising_phoenix_logs.json');};
document.getElementById('soul-test-btn').onclick=()=>{logActivity('[SOUL TEST] Sample lesson generated: Lorem Ipsum + Narrative');};

// -------- Utility: Download JSON --------
function download(content, fileName){
  const a=document.createElement("a");
  const file=new Blob([content],{type:"application/json"});
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(file);
  a.download=fileName; a.click();
}

// -------- Cheat Sheet Toggle --------
document.getElementById('toggle-cheat').onclick=()=>{
  const content=document.getElementById('cheat-sheet-content');
  content.style.display=(content.style.display==='none')?'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('toggle-cheat').innerText=(content.style.display==='none')?'[+]':'[–]';
};

<head>

<style>

.progress { background:#444; border-radius:5px; height:10px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:5px; }

#speed-slider { width:120px; }
#cheat-sheet { position:fixed; bottom:0; right:0; background:#2c2c44; color:#fff; width:300px; max-height:200px; overflow-y:auto; border-radius:10px 10px 0 0; padding:10px; font-size:0.8em; cursor:pointer; transition:max-height 0.3s; }
#cheat-sheet.collapsed { max-height:25px; overflow:hidden; }
.sparkle { position:absolute; width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background: #ffd700; pointer-events:none; }
.autopilot-on { background:#ffd700; color:#1b1b2f; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div>Rising Phoenix Audit Machine v7</div>
  <div>
    <button id="launch-all-btn">Launch All</button>
    <button id="pause-all-btn">Pause All</button>
    <button id="resume-all-btn" style="display:none;">Resume All</button>
    <button id="reset-all-btn">Reset All</button>
    <button id="autopilot-btn">Autopilot</button>
    <button id="export-btn">Export Logs</button>
    <button id="soul-test-btn">Soul Test</button>
    Speed: <input type="range" id="speed-slider" min="50" max="1000" value="200">
  </div>
</header>

<div id="seeds-container"></div>
<div id="activity-feed"></div>
<canvas id="fireworks-canvas"></canvas>
<div id="mission-overlay">Mission Complete!</div>
<div id="cheat-sheet" class="collapsed">
  <div><strong>Cheat Sheet (click to toggle)</strong></div>
  <ul>
    <li>Launch All: Starts all seeds</li>
    <li>Pause All / Resume All: Pause or resume progress</li>
    <li>Reset All: Resets all seeds</li>
    <li>Autopilot: Auto-progress seeds</li>
    <li>Export Logs: Save activity feed to JSON</li>
    <li>Soul Test: Generate sample lesson log</li>
    <li>Speed Slider: Adjust autopilot speed</li>
  </ul>
</div>

<script>
// ------------------- Toggle Cheat Sheet -------------------
const cheatSheet = document.getElementById('cheat-sheet');
cheatSheet.onclick = ()=>{cheatSheet.classList.toggle('collapsed');};

// ------------------- Seed Class -------------------
class Seed {
  constructor(id){
    this.id=id; this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.failCount=0; this.warnCount=0; this.passCount=0; this.totalCount=0;
    this.elapsedTime=0; this.history=[]; this.logs=[]; this.stateHash='';
    this.card=null; this.interval=null;
  }

  createCard(container){
    const card=document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
    const header=document.createElement('div'); header.className='header'; header.innerText=`Seed ${this.id}`;
    const progress=document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
    const bar=document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar';
    progress.appendChild(bar);
    const statusLabel=document.createElement('div'); statusLabel.className='status-label';
    const status=document.createElement('div'); status.className='status'; status.innerText=this.status;
    const elapsed=document.createElement('div'); elapsed.className='elapsed'; elapsed.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
    statusLabel.appendChild(status); statusLabel.appendChild(elapsed);
    card.append(header, progress, statusLabel); container.appendChild(card);
    this.card=card; this.bar=bar; this.statusEl=status; this.elapsedEl=elapsed;
  }

  updateProgress(step){
    if(this.status==='COMPLETE') return;
    this.progress+=step; this.elapsedTime+=step*50;
    if(this.progress>=100){this.progress=100; this.status='COMPLETE'; this.showCompletion();}
    else this.status='RUNNING';
    this.bar.style.width=this.progress+'%';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
    this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: ${Math.floor(this.elapsedTime)}ms`;
    this.logs.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
  }

  start(interval){
    if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval);
    this.status='RUNNING';
    this.interval=setInterval(()=>{this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5);}, interval);
  }

  pause(){ if(this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null; if(this.status!=='COMPLETE') this.status='PAUSED'; this.statusEl.innerText=this.status; }
  resume(interval){ if(this.status==='PAUSED') this.start(interval); }
  reset(){ this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.bar.style.width='0%'; this.statusEl.innerText=this.status; this.elapsedEl.innerText='Elapsed: 0ms'; }
  showCompletion(){ logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!`); triggerMissionOverlay(); }
}

// ------------------- Buddy System -------------------
class BuddySystem{
  constructor(seeds){ this.seeds=seeds; }
  pairAll(){ for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){ const s1=this.seeds[i]; const s2=this.seeds[i+1]; if(s2) logActivity(`[BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`); } }
}

// ------------------- Autopilot -------------------
class Autopilot{
  constructor(seeds, interval){ this.seeds=seeds; this.interval=interval; this.active=false; }
  toggle(){ this.active=!this.active; const btn=document.getElementById('autopilot-btn'); btn.classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active); if(this.active) this.run(); }
  run(){ if(!this.active) return; this.seeds.forEach(s=>{ if(s.status!=='COMPLETE') s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10); }); setTimeout(()=>this.run(), this.interval); }
}

// ------------------- Logger -------------------
function logActivity(msg){ const feed=document.getElementById('activity-feed'); const div=document.createElement('div'); div.innerText=msg; feed.appendChild(div); feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight; }

// ------------------- Mission Overlay & Fireworks -------------------
function triggerMissionOverlay(){ const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay'); overlay.style.display='flex'; setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.display='none'; spawnFireworks();},2000); }

function spawnFireworks(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('fireworks-canvas'); const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width=window.innerWidth; canvas.height=window.innerHeight;
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    const x=Math.random()*canvas.width; const y=Math.random()*canvas.height;
    const sparkle=document.createElement('div'); sparkle.className='sparkle';
    sparkle.style.left=x+'px'; sparkle.style.top=y+'px';
    document.body.appendChild(sparkle); setTimeout(()=>{sparkle.remove();},700);
  }
}

// ------------------- System Init -------------------
const seeds=[]; const container=document.getElementById('seeds-container');
for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){const s=new Seed(i); s.createCard(container); seeds.push(s);}
const buddySystem=new BuddySystem(seeds); buddySystem.pairAll();
const autopilot=new Autopilot(seeds,200);

// ------------------- Controls -------------------
document.getElementById('launch-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.start(document.getElementById('speed-slider').value));};
document.getElementById('pause-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause()); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='inline-block';};
document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.resume(document.getElementById('speed-slider').value)); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='none';};
document.getElementById('reset-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.reset());};
document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').onclick=()=>{autopilot.toggle();};
document.getElementById('export-btn').onclick=()=>{download(JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>s.logs)),'rising_phoenix_logs.json');};
document.getElementById('soul-test-btn').onclick=()=>{logActivity('[SOUL TEST] Sample lesson generated: Lorem Ipsum + Narrative');};
document.getElementById('speed-slider').oninput=()=>{autopilot.interval=document.getElementById('speed-slider').value;};

// ------------------- Download Utility -------------------
function download(content, fileName){ const a=document.createElement("a"); const file=new Blob([content],{type:"application/json"}); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(file); a.download=fileName; a.click(); }
</script>

</body>
</html>

// ==================== Rising Phoenix Inspector ====================

(function(){
  if(!window.seeds || seeds.length===0){console.warn('No seeds detected!'); return;}
  console.log('=== Rising Phoenix Mini Audit ===');

  const report = {seeds:[], autopilot: {}, buddyPairs:[], overlays:[], logsIntegrity: true};
  
  // --- Seed State Audit ---
  seeds.forEach(s=>{
    let seedReport = {id: s.id, progress: s.progress, status: s.status, failCount: s.failCount, warnCount: s.warnCount, passCount: s.passCount};
    
    // Check progress bounds
    if(s.progress <0 || s.progress >100){seedReport.error='Progress out of bounds!';}
    // Check elapsedTime
    if(s.elapsedTime<0){seedReport.error='Negative elapsedTime!';}
    // Check logs existence
    if(!Array.isArray(s.logs) || s.logs.length===0){seedReport.warn='No logs found';}
    // Check completion logic
    if(s.progress===100 && s.status!=='COMPLETE'){seedReport.warn='Completed seed not marked COMPLETE';}
    report.seeds.push(seedReport);
  });

  // --- Buddy System Audit ---
  if(window.buddySystem && buddySystem.seeds){
    for(let i=0;i<buddySystem.seeds.length;i+=2){
      const s1=buddySystem.seeds[i], s2=buddySystem.seeds[i+1];
      if(s2) report.buddyPairs.push(`Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`);
    }
  }

  // --- Autopilot Audit ---
  if(window.autopilot){
    report.autopilot.active = autopilot.active;
    report.autopilot.interval = autopilot.interval;
    // Check seeds running states vs autopilot
    const runningSeeds = seeds.filter(s=>s.status==='RUNNING');
    if(autopilot.active && runningSeeds.length===0){report.autopilot.warn='Autopilot active but no seeds running';}
  }

  // --- Mission Overlay Audit ---
  const overlay = document.getElementById('mission-overlay');
  if(overlay && overlay.style.display==='flex'){report.overlays.push('Mission overlay currently visible');}

  // --- Logs Integrity Check ---
  seeds.forEach(s=>{
    let lastTimestamp = 0;
    for(let log of s.logs){
      const t = new Date(log.timestamp).getTime();
      if(t<lastTimestamp){report.logsIntegrity=false; console.warn(`Seed ${s.id} logs out of order!`);}
      lastTimestamp=t;
    }
  });

  // --- Final Summary ---
  console.log('=== Rising Phoenix Mini Audit Report ===');
  console.table(report.seeds);
  if(report.buddyPairs.length>0){console.log('Buddy Pairs:', report.buddyPairs);}
  console.log('Autopilot Status:', report.autopilot);
  console.log('Mission Overlay:', report.overlays.length>0?report.overlays:'None');
  console.log('Logs Integrity:', report.logsIntegrity?'OK':'FAILED');
  console.log('=== End of Mini Audit ===');
})();

    }

    });
  } catch(e){report.uiConnections=false;}

  // --- Final Summary ---

})();

  });

    }

  // 5. Autopilot status

// ================= Rising Phoenix Audit & Hardening JS =================

(() => {
  if (!window.seeds) return console.warn("No seeds detected!");

  const report = {
    seedStateCheck: [],
    logsCheck: [],
    buddyPairsCheck: [],

      report.autoFixActions.push(`Seed ${s.id} progress corrected to ${s.progress}%`);
    }
    if (!s.status) s.status='IDLE';
    report.seedStateCheck.push({
      id: s.id,
      progress: s.progress,
      status: s.status,
      stateHash: s.stateHash,
      consistent
    });
  });

  // ---------------- Logs Integrity Check ----------------
  seeds.forEach(s => {
    const chronological = s.logs.every((l,i,a) => i===0 || new Date(l.timestamp) >= new Date(a[i-1].timestamp));
    if (!chronological) {
      s.logs.sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.timestamp)-new Date(b.timestamp));
      report.autoFixActions.push(`Seed ${s.id} logs reordered chronologically`);
    }
    report.logsCheck.push({id: s.id, logCount: s.logs.length, chronological});
  });

  // ---------------- Buddy System Check & Repair ----------------
  if (window.buddySystem && buddySystem.seeds) {
    for(let i=0;i<buddySystem.seeds.length;i+=2){
      const s1=buddySystem.seeds[i]; const s2=buddySystem.seeds[i+1]||null;
      if(!s2) report.autoFixActions.push(`Seed ${s1.id} has no buddy, pairing skipped`);
      report.buddyPairsCheck.push({pair:`${s1.id}-${s2? s2.id : 'UNPAIRED'}`});
    }
  }

  // ---------------- LocalStorage Check & Auto-Fix ----------------
  try {
    let test = localStorage.getItem('seedState');
    if(!test){
      localStorage.setItem('seedState', JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>({id:s.id, progress:s.progress,status:s.status}))));
      report.autoFixActions.push("LocalStorage seedState initialized");
    }
    report.localStorageCheck.push({exists:!!test, length: test ? test.length : 0});
  } catch(e){
    report.localStorageCheck.push({error: e.message});
  }

  // ---------------- Autopilot Status Check ----------------
  if (window.autopilot) {
    if(autopilot.active && autopilot.interval<50) {
      autopilot.interval=50;
      report.autoFixActions.push("Autopilot interval increased to 50ms minimum");
    }
    report.autopilotCheck.push({active: autopilot.active, interval: autopilot.interval});
  }

  // ---------------- Console Report ----------------
  console.group("=== Rising Phoenix Audit & Hardening Report ===");
  console.log("Seed State Validation:", report.seedStateCheck);
  console.log("Logs Chronology Check:", report.logsCheck);
  console.log("Buddy Pairs Check:", report.buddyPairsCheck);
  console.log("LocalStorage Check:", report.localStorageCheck);
  console.log("Autopilot Status:", report.autopilotCheck);
  console.log("Auto-Fix Actions Taken:", report.autoFixActions);
  console.groupEnd();

  alert("Audit & minor hardening complete! Check console for details ✅");
})();

// ==================== Rising Phoenix Protocol v7.0 AUDIT REQUEST ====================
// Target: Seed Machine / AI-PET & Launchpad
// Mode: Full Hardening & Optimization
// Instructions:
// 1. Validate initialization of all seeds.
// 2. Verify BuddySystem pairing and logging.
// 3. Test Autopilot behavior.
// 4. Confirm progress, status, completion, and logs.
// 5. Check stateHash, localStorage persistence, and concurrency.
// 6. Ensure UI aesthetic mandates and collapsible cheat sheets.
// 7. Flag all memory leaks, undefined references, NaN/negative values.
// 8. Suggest additional UX/AI-PET optimizations.

// ------------------ Rising Phoenix JS Seed ------------------
class Seed{
  constructor(id){this.id=id;this.progress=0;this.status='IDLE';
  this.failCount=0;this.warnCount=0;this.passCount=0;this.totalCount=0;
  this.elapsedTime=0;this.history=[];this.logs=[];this.stateHash='';
  this.card=null;this.interval=null;}
  createCard(container){
    const card=document.createElement('div');card.className='seed-card';
    const header=document.createElement('div');header.className='header';
    header.innerText=`Seed ${this.id}`;
    const progress=document.createElement('div');progress.className='progress';
    const bar=document.createElement('div');bar.className='progress-bar';
    progress.appendChild(bar);
    const statusLabel=document.createElement('div');statusLabel.className='status-label';
    const status=document.createElement('div');status.className='status';status.innerText=this.status;
    const elapsed=document.createElement('div');elapsed.className='elapsed';
    elapsed.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
    statusLabel.appendChild(status);statusLabel.appendChild(elapsed);
    card.append(header,progress,statusLabel);
    container.appendChild(card);
    this.card=card;this.bar=bar;this.statusEl=status;this.elapsedEl=elapsed;
  }
  updateProgress(step){
    if(this.status==='COMPLETE')return;
    this.progress+=step;this.elapsedTime+=step*50;
    if(this.progress>=100){this.progress=100;this.status='COMPLETE';this.showCompletion();}
    else this.status='RUNNING';
    this.bar.style.width=this.progress+'%';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;
    this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
    this.logs.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
    logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
  }
  start(interval){if(this.interval)clearInterval(this.interval);this.status='RUNNING';
    this.interval=setInterval(()=>{this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5);},interval);}
  pause(){if(this.interval)clearInterval(this.interval);this.interval=null;
    if(this.status!=='COMPLETE')this.status='PAUSED';this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;}
  resume(interval){if(this.status==='PAUSED')this.start(interval);}
  reset(){this.progress=0;this.status='IDLE';this.elapsedTime=0;this.logs=[];this.bar.style.width='0%';
    this.statusEl.innerText=this.status;this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: 0ms`;}
  showCompletion(){logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!`);triggerMissionOverlay();}
}

class BuddySystem{constructor(seeds){this.seeds=seeds;}
  pairAll(){for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){const s1=this.seeds[i];const s2=this.seeds[i+1];
  if(s2)logActivity(`[BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`);}}}

class Autopilot{constructor(seeds,interval){this.seeds=seeds;this.interval=interval;this.active=false;}
  toggle(){this.active=!this.active;const btn=document.getElementById('autopilot-btn');
  btn.classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active);if(this.active)this.run();}
  run(){if(!this.active)return;this.seeds.forEach(s=>{if(s.status!=='COMPLETE')s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10);});
  setTimeout(()=>this.run(),this.interval);}}

function logActivity(msg){const feed=document.getElementById('activity-feed');
  const div=document.createElement('div');div.innerText=msg;feed.appendChild(div);feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight;}

function triggerMissionOverlay(){const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay');overlay.style.display='flex';
  setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.display='none';spawnFireworks();},2000);}

function spawnFireworks(){const canvas=document.getElementById('fireworks-canvas');const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width=window.innerWidth;canvas.height=window.innerHeight;for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
  const x=Math.random()*canvas.width;const y=Math.random()*canvas.height;
  const sparkle=document.createElement('div');sparkle.className='sparkle';
  sparkle.style.left=x+'px';sparkle.style.top=y+'px';document.body.appendChild(sparkle);
  setTimeout(()=>{sparkle.remove();},700);}}

const seeds=[];const container=document.getElementById('seeds-container');
for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){const s=new Seed(i);s.createCard(container);seeds.push(s);}
const buddySystem=new BuddySystem(seeds);buddySystem.pairAll();
const autopilot=new Autopilot(seeds,200);

document.getElementById('launch-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.start(speedSlider.value));};
document.getElementById('pause-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause());document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='inline-block';};
document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.resume(speedSlider.value));document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='none';};
document.getElementById('reset-all-btn').onclick=()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.reset());};
document.getElementById('autopilot-btn').onclick=()=>{autopilot.toggle();};
document.getElementById('export-btn').onclick=()=>{download(JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>s.logs)),'rising_phoenix_logs.json');};
document.getElementById('copy-js-btn').onclick=()=>{navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.querySelector('script').innerText);alert('JS Seed copied!');};
document.getElementById('soul-test-btn').onclick=()=>{logActivity('[SOUL TEST] Sample lesson generated: Lorem Ipsum + Narrative');};
const speedSlider=document.getElementById('speed-slider');speedSlider.oninput=()=>{autopilot.interval=speedSlider.value;};

function download(content,fileName){const a=document.createElement("a");const file=new Blob([content],{type:"application/json"});
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(file);a.download=fileName;a.click();}

// ==================== Rising Phoenix JS Seed END ====================

<script>
(async function(){

      const div=document.createElement('div'); div.innerText=msg.replace(/[<>]/g,''); feed.appendChild(div); feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight;
    },
    async hashState(obj){
      const enc=new TextEncoder(); const data=enc.encode(JSON.stringify(obj));
      const hash=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',data);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    },
    persistState(seeds){
      const state=seeds.map(s=>({id:s.id,progress:s.progress,status:s.status,elapsedTime:s.elapsedTime,logs:s.logs}));
      localStorage.setItem('rising_phoenix_v1',JSON.stringify(state));
    },
    loadState(seeds){
      const data=localStorage.getItem('rising_phoenix_v1'); if(!data)return;
      const parsed=JSON.parse(data);
      parsed.forEach(saved=>{
        const s=seeds.find(seed=>seed.id===saved.id);
        if(s){s.progress=saved.progress; s.status=saved.status; s.elapsedTime=saved.elapsedTime; s.logs=saved.logs||[]; s.updateUI();}
      });
    },
    download(content,fileName){ const a=document.createElement('a'); const f=new Blob([content],{type:'application/javascript'}); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(f); a.download=fileName; a.click();}
  };

  // ---------------- SEED ----------------
  class Seed{
    constructor(id){this.id=id; this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.stateHash=''; this.interval=null; this.card=null; this.bar=null; this.statusEl=null; this.elapsedEl=null;}
    createCard(container){
      const card=document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
      const header=document.createElement('div'); header.className='header'; header.innerText=Seed ${this.id};
      const progress=document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
      const bar=document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar'; progress.appendChild(bar);
      const statusLabel=document.createElement('div'); statusLabel.className='status-label';
      const status=document.createElement('div'); status.className='status'; status.innerText=this.status;
      const elapsed=document.createElement('div'); elapsed.className='elapsed'; elapsed.innerText=Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms;
      statusLabel.appendChild(status); statusLabel.appendChild(elapsed); card.append(header,progress,statusLabel); container.appendChild(card);
      this.card=card; this.bar=bar; this.statusEl=status; this.elapsedEl=elapsed;
    }
    async updateProgress(step){
      if(this.status==='COMPLETE')return;
      this.progress+=step; this.elapsedTime+=step*50; this.status=this.progress>=100?'COMPLETE':'RUNNING'; if(this.progress>=100)this.progress=100;
      this.updateUI(); this.logs.push({timestamp:utils.now(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
      this.stateHash=await utils.hashState(this);
      utils.logActivity([Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%);
      if(this.status==='COMPLETE'){ utils.logActivity([Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!); triggerMissionOverlay(); }
      utils.persistState(seeds);
    }
    start(interval=200){this.pause(); this.status='RUNNING'; this.updateUI(); this.interval=setInterval(()=>this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5),interval);}
    pause(){if(this.interval)clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null; if(this.status!=='COMPLETE')this.status='PAUSED'; this.updateUI();}
    resume(interval=200){if(this.status==='PAUSED')this.start(interval);}
    reset(){this.pause(); this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.updateUI(); utils.persistState(seeds);}
    updateUI(){if(this.bar)this.bar.style.width=this.progress+'%'; if(this.statusEl)this.statusEl.innerText=this.status; if(this.elapsedEl)this.elapsedEl.innerText=Elapsed: ${Math.round(this.elapsedTime)}ms;}
  }

  // ---------------- BUDDY & AUTOPILOT ----------------
  class BuddySystem{ constructor(seeds){this.seeds=seeds;} pairAll(){for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){const s1=this.seeds[i]; const s2=this.seeds[i+1]; if(s2) utils.logActivity([BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id});}}}
  class Autopilot{ constructor(seeds,interval=200){this.seeds=seeds; this.interval=interval; this.active=false;} toggle(){this.active=!this.active; const btn=document.getElementById('autopilot-btn'); if(btn)btn.classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active); if(this.active)this.run();} run(){if(!this.active)return; this.seeds.forEach(s=>{if(s.status!=='COMPLETE')s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10);}); setTimeout(()=>this.run(),this.interval);}}

  // ---------------- MISSION & FIREWORKS ----------------
  function triggerMissionOverlay(){ const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay'); if(!overlay)return; overlay.style.display='flex'; overlay.style.opacity=0; setTimeout(()=>overlay.style.opacity=1,10); setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.opacity=0; setTimeout(()=>overlay.style.display='none',500); spawnFireworks();},2000);}
  function spawnFireworks(){ const count=30; for(let i=0;i<count;i++){ const sparkle=document.createElement('div'); sparkle.className='sparkle'; sparkle.style.left=Math.random()*window.innerWidth+'px'; sparkle.style.top=Math.random()*window.innerHeight+'px'; document.body.appendChild(sparkle); setTimeout(()=>sparkle.remove(),700); } }

  // ---------------- INITIALIZE ----------------
  const seedsContainer=document.getElementById('seeds-container'); const seeds=[];
  for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){ const s=new Seed(i); s.createCard(seedsContainer); seeds.push(s);}
  const buddySystem=new BuddySystem(seeds); buddySystem.pairAll();
  const autopilot=new Autopilot(seeds,200);
  utils.loadState(seeds);

  // ---------------- CONTROLS ----------------
  const speedSlider=document.getElementById('speed-slider'); if(speedSlider) speedSlider.oninput=()=>autopilot.interval=Number(speedSlider.value);
  document.getElementById('launch-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>seeds.forEach(s=>s.start(Number(speedSlider?.value||200))));
  document.getElementById('pause-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause()); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='inline-block'; });
  document.getElementById('resume-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ seeds.forEach(s=>s.resume(Number(speedSlider?.value||200))); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='none'; });
  document.getElementById('reset-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>seeds.forEach(s=>s.reset()));
  document.getElementById('autopilot-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>autopilot.toggle());
  document.getElementById('export-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>utils.download(JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>s.logs)),'rising_phoenix_logs.json'));
  document.getElementById('copy-js-btn')?.addEventListener('click',async()=>{ try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.querySelector('script').innerText); alert('JS Seed copied!'); } catch{ alert('Clipboard copy failed'); } });
  document.getElementById('soul-test-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>utils.logActivity('[SOUL TEST] Sample lesson generated: Lorem Ipsum + Narrative'));

  // ---------------- CHEAT SHEET ----------------
  const cheatSheet=document.getElementById('cheat-sheet'); 
  if(cheatSheet){ 
    const btn=document.createElement('button'); 
    btn.innerText='Toggle Cheat Sheet'; 
    btn.onclick=()=>{cheatSheet.style.display=cheatSheet.style.display==='none'?'block':'none'; btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',cheatSheet.style.display==='block');};
    document.body.insertBefore(btn,cheatSheet);
  }
})();

  <button id="export-btn">Export Logs</button>
  <button id="copy-js-btn">Copy JS Seed</button>
  <button id="soul-test-btn">Soul Test</button>
  Speed: <input type="range" id="speed-slider" min="50" max="1000" value="200">
</div>

<!-- ----------------- SEEDS & ACTIVITY FEED ----------------- -->
<div id="seeds-container"></div>
<div id="activity-feed"></div>

<!-- ----------------- MISSION OVERLAY ----------------- -->
<div id="mission-overlay">Mission Complete!</div>

<!-- ----------------- CHEAT SHEET ----------------- -->
<div id="cheat-sheet"><h3>Cheat Sheet</h3>
<p>Seed controls, hints, and shortcuts.</p>
</div>

<script>
(async function(){
  /* ====================== UTILS & HARDENING ====================== */
  const utils = {
    // Timestamp helper
    now:()=>new Date().toISOString(),
    // Activity logging with sanitization (avoids XSS from accidental HTML injection)
    logActivity(msg){
      const feed=document.getElementById('activity-feed'); if(!feed)return;
      const div=document.createElement('div'); div.innerText=msg.replace(/[<>]/g,'');
      feed.appendChild(div); feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight;
    },
    // SHA-256 hash of seed state for audit & integrity checks
    async hashState(obj){
      const enc=new TextEncoder(); const data=enc.encode(JSON.stringify(obj));
      const hash=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',data);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    },
    // Persist state securely
    persistState(seeds){
      const state=seeds.map(s=>({id:s.id,progress:s.progress,status:s.status,elapsedTime:s.elapsedTime,logs:s.logs}));
      localStorage.setItem('rising_phoenix_v1',JSON.stringify(state));
    },
    // Load state for continuity
    loadState(seeds){
      const data=localStorage.getItem('rising_phoenix_v1'); if(!data)return;
      const parsed=JSON.parse(data);
      parsed.forEach(saved=>{
        const s=seeds.find(seed=>seed.id===saved.id);
        if(s){s.progress=saved.progress; s.status=saved.status; s.elapsedTime=saved.elapsedTime; s.logs=saved.logs||[]; s.updateUI();}
      });
    },
    // Download file utility
    download(content,fileName){
      const a=document.createElement('a'); const f=new Blob([content],{type:'application/javascript'});
      a.href=URL.createObjectURL(f); a.download=fileName; a.click();
    }
  };

  /* ====================== SEED CLASS ====================== */
  class Seed{
    constructor(id){
      this.id=id; this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0;
      this.logs=[]; this.stateHash=''; this.interval=null; this.card=null; this.bar=null; this.statusEl=null; this.elapsedEl=null;
    }

    // Create UI card for seed
    createCard(container){
      const card=document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
      const header=document.createElement('div'); header.className='header'; header.innerText=`Seed ${this.id}`;
      const progress=document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
      const bar=document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar'; progress.appendChild(bar);
      const statusLabel=document.createElement('div'); statusLabel.className='status-label';
      const status=document.createElement('div'); status.className='status'; status.innerText=this.status;
      const elapsed=document.createElement('div'); elapsed.className='elapsed'; elapsed.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
      statusLabel.appendChild(status); statusLabel.appendChild(elapsed); card.append(header,progress,statusLabel); container.appendChild(card);
      this.card=card; this.bar=bar; this.statusEl=status; this.elapsedEl=elapsed;
    }

    // Update progress with step, logging, hash, and persistent save
    async updateProgress(step){
      if(this.status==='COMPLETE')return;
      this.progress+=step;
      this.elapsedTime+=step*50;
      this.status=this.progress>=100?'COMPLETE':'RUNNING';
      if(this.progress>=100) this.progress=100;
      this.updateUI();
      this.logs.push({timestamp:utils.now(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
      this.stateHash=await utils.hashState(this);
      utils.logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
      if(this.status==='COMPLETE'){ utils.logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!`); triggerMissionOverlay(); }
      utils.persistState(seeds);
    }

    start(interval=200){this.pause(); this.status='RUNNING'; this.updateUI(); this.interval=setInterval(()=>this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5),interval);}
    pause(){if(this.interval)clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null; if(this.status!=='COMPLETE')this.status='PAUSED'; this.updateUI();}
    resume(interval=200){if(this.status==='PAUSED')this.start(interval);}
    reset(){this.pause(); this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.updateUI(); utils.persistState(seeds);}
    updateUI(){if(this.bar)this.bar.style.width=this.progress+'%'; if(this.statusEl)this.statusEl.innerText=this.status; if(this.elapsedEl)this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: ${Math.round(this.elapsedTime)}ms`;}
  }

  /* ====================== BUDDY SYSTEM ====================== */
  class BuddySystem{ 
    constructor(seeds){this.seeds=seeds;} 
    pairAll(){for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){const s1=this.seeds[i]; const s2=this.seeds[i+1]; if(s2) utils.logActivity(`[BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`);}}
  }

  /* ====================== AUTOPILOT ====================== */
  class Autopilot{ 
    constructor(seeds,interval=200){this.seeds=seeds; this.interval=interval; this.active=false;} 
    toggle(){this.active=!this.active; const btn=document.getElementById('autopilot-btn'); if(btn)btn.classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active); if(this.active)this.run();}
    run(){if(!this.active)return; this.seeds.forEach(s=>{if(s.status!=='COMPLETE')s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10);}); setTimeout(()=>this.run(),this.interval);}
  }

  /* ====================== MISSION OVERLAY & FIREWORKS ====================== */
  function triggerMissionOverlay(){ 
    const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay'); if(!overlay)return;
    overlay.style.display='flex'; overlay.style.opacity=0; 
    setTimeout(()=>overlay.style.opacity=1,10); 
    setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.opacity=0; setTimeout(()=>overlay.style.display='none',500); spawnFireworks();},2000);
  }
  function spawnFireworks(){ const count=30; for(let i=0;i<count;i++){ const sparkle=document.createElement('div'); sparkle.className='sparkle'; sparkle.style.left=Math.random()*window.innerWidth+'px'; sparkle.style.top=Math.random()*window.innerHeight+'px'; document.body.appendChild(sparkle); setTimeout(()=>sparkle.remove(),700); } }

  /* ====================== INITIALIZATION ====================== */
  const seedsContainer=document.getElementById('seeds-container'); const seeds=[];
  for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){ const s=new Seed(i); s.createCard(seedsContainer); seeds.push(s);}
  const buddySystem=new BuddySystem(seeds); buddySystem.pairAll();
  const autopilot=new Autopilot(seeds,200);
  utils.loadState(seeds);

  /* ====================== CONTROL BUTTONS ====================== */
  const speedSlider=document.getElementById('speed-slider'); if(speedSlider) speedSlider.oninput=()=>autopilot.interval=Number(speedSlider.value);
  document.getElementById('launch-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>seeds.forEach(s=>s.start(Number(speedSlider?.value||200))));
  document.getElementById('pause-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause()); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='inline-block'; });
  document.getElementById('resume-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ seeds.forEach(s=>s.resume(Number(speedSlider?.value||200))); document.getElementById('resume-all-btn').style.display='none'; });
  document.getElementById('reset-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>seeds.forEach(s=>s.reset()));
  document.getElementById('autopilot-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>autopilot.toggle());
  document.getElementById('export-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>utils.download(JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>s.logs)),'rising_phoenix_logs.json'));
  document.getElementById('copy-js-btn')?.addEventListener('click',async()=>{ try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.querySelector('script').innerText); alert('JS Seed copied!'); } catch{ alert('Clipboard copy failed'); } });
  document.getElementById('soul-test-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>utils.logActivity('[SOUL TEST] Sample lesson generated: Lorem Ipsum + Narrative'));

  /* ====================== CHEAT SHEET TOGGLE ====================== */
  const cheatSheet=document.getElementById('cheat-sheet'); 
  if(cheatSheet){ 
    const btn=document.createElement('button'); 
    btn.innerText='Toggle Cheat Sheet'; 
    btn.onclick=()=>{cheatSheet.style.display=cheatSheet.style.display==='none'?'block':'none'; btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',cheatSheet.style.display==='block');};
    document.body.insertBefore(btn,cheatSheet);
  }

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

#activity-feed { background:#111; padding:10px; height:150px; overflow-y:auto; margin:10px; border-radius:5px; }
#mission-overlay { display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); justify-content:center; align-items:center; transition:opacity 0.5s; z-index:1000; color:#FFD700; font-size:2em; text-align:center; }
.sparkle { position:absolute; width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:#FFD700; animation:sparkleAnim 0.7s forwards; }
@keyframes sparkleAnim {0% {opacity:1; transform:scale(1);} 100% {opacity:0; transform:scale(2);} }
#cheat-sheet { background:#222; padding:10px; margin:10px; border-radius:5px; display:none; }
#lesson-module { background:#111; padding:10px; margin:10px; border-radius:5px; }
input[type=text], textarea { width:100%; padding:5px; margin:5px 0; border-radius:5px; border:none; }
#lesson-feedback { color:#00FFAA; margin-top:5px; font-weight:bold; }
input[type=range] { width:100px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="controls">
  <button id="launch-all-btn">Launch All</button>
  <button id="pause-all-btn">Pause All</button>
  <button id="resume-all-btn" style="display:none;">Resume All</button>
  <button id="reset-all-btn">Reset All</button>
  <button id="autopilot-btn">Autopilot</button>
  <button id="max-pro-btn">Max-Pro / Flash</button>
  <button id="export-btn">Export Logs</button>
  <button id="copy-js-btn">Copy JS Seed</button>
  <button id="soul-test-btn">Soul Test</button>
  Speed: <input type="range" id="speed-slider" min="50" max="1000" value="200">
</div>

<div id="seeds-container"></div>
<div id="activity-feed"></div>
<div id="mission-overlay">Mission Complete!</div>
<div id="cheat-sheet"><h3>Cheat Sheet</h3><p>Seed controls, hints, and shortcuts.</p></div>

<!-- Lesson Module -->
<div id="lesson-module">
  <h3>Lesson: What is your passion?</h3>
  <p>Key Vocabulary: passion, hobby, interest, favorite, goal</p>
  <p>Idioms: "follow your heart", "in the zone", "burning curiosity"</p>
  <p>Write a short paragraph (2-4 sentences) about your passion.</p>
  <textarea id="lesson-input" rows="4" placeholder="Type here..."></textarea>
  <button id="lesson-submit-btn">Submit</button>
  <div id="lesson-feedback"></div>
</div>

<script>
(async function(){
  // ---------------- UTILS ----------------
  const utils = {
    now:()=>new Date().toISOString(),
    logActivity(msg){
      const feed=document.getElementById('activity-feed'); if(!feed)return;
      const div=document.createElement('div'); div.innerText=msg.replace(/[<>]/g,''); feed.appendChild(div); feed.scrollTop=feed.scrollHeight;
    },
    async hashState(obj){
      const enc=new TextEncoder(); const data=enc.encode(JSON.stringify(obj));
      const hash=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',data);
      return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    },
    persistState(seeds){
      const state=seeds.map(s=>({id:s.id,progress:s.progress,status:s.status,elapsedTime:s.elapsedTime,logs:s.logs}));
      localStorage.setItem('rising_phoenix_v1',JSON.stringify(state));
    },
    loadState(seeds){
      const data=localStorage.getItem('rising_phoenix_v1'); if(!data)return;
      const parsed=JSON.parse(data);
      parsed.forEach(saved=>{
        const s=seeds.find(seed=>seed.id===saved.id);
        if(s){s.progress=saved.progress; s.status=saved.status; s.elapsedTime=saved.elapsedTime; s.logs=saved.logs||[]; s.updateUI();}
      });
    },
    download(content,fileName){ const a=document.createElement('a'); const f=new Blob([content],{type:'application/javascript'}); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(f); a.download=fileName; a.click();}
  };

  // ---------------- SEED ----------------
  class Seed{
    constructor(id){this.id=id; this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.stateHash=''; this.interval=null; this.card=null; this.bar=null; this.statusEl=null; this.elapsedEl=null;}
    createCard(container){
      const card=document.createElement('div'); card.className='seed-card';
      const header=document.createElement('div'); header.className='header'; header.innerText=`Seed ${this.id}`;
      const progress=document.createElement('div'); progress.className='progress';
      const bar=document.createElement('div'); bar.className='progress-bar'; progress.appendChild(bar);
      const statusLabel=document.createElement('div'); statusLabel.className='status-label';
      const status=document.createElement('div'); status.className='status'; status.innerText=this.status;
      const elapsed=document.createElement('div'); elapsed.className='elapsed'; elapsed.innerText=`Elapsed: ${this.elapsedTime}ms`;
      statusLabel.appendChild(status); statusLabel.appendChild(elapsed); card.append(header,progress,statusLabel); container.appendChild(card);
      this.card=card; this.bar=bar; this.statusEl=status; this.elapsedEl=elapsed;
    }
    async updateProgress(step){
      if(this.status==='COMPLETE')return;
      this.progress+=step; this.elapsedTime+=step*50; this.status=this.progress>=100?'COMPLETE':'RUNNING'; if(this.progress>=100)this.progress=100;
      this.updateUI(); this.logs.push({timestamp:utils.now(),event:'ProgressUpdate',value:this.progress});
      this.stateHash=await utils.hashState(this);
      utils.logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Progress: ${this.progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
      if(this.status==='COMPLETE'){ utils.logActivity(`[Obi][Seed ${this.id}] Completed!`); triggerMissionOverlay(); }
      utils.persistState(seeds);
    }
    start(interval=200){this.pause(); this.status='RUNNING'; this.updateUI(); this.interval=setInterval(()=>this.updateProgress(Math.random()*5),interval);}
    pause(){if(this.interval)clearInterval(this.interval); this.interval=null; if(this.status!=='COMPLETE')this.status='PAUSED'; this.updateUI();}
    resume(interval=200){if(this.status==='PAUSED')this.start(interval);}
    reset(){this.pause(); this.progress=0; this.status='IDLE'; this.elapsedTime=0; this.logs=[]; this.updateUI(); utils.persistState(seeds);}
    updateUI(){if(this.bar)this.bar.style.width=this.progress+'%'; if(this.statusEl)this.statusEl.innerText=this.status; if(this.elapsedEl)this.elapsedEl.innerText=`Elapsed: ${Math.round(this.elapsedTime)}ms`;}
  }

  // ---------------- BUDDY SYSTEM ----------------
  class BuddySystem{ constructor(seeds){this.seeds=seeds;} pairAll(){for(let i=0;i<this.seeds.length;i+=2){const s1=this.seeds[i]; const s2=this.seeds[i+1]; if(s2) utils.logActivity(`[BuddySystem] Seed ${s1.id} paired with Seed ${s2.id}`);}}}

  // ---------------- AUTOPILOT ----------------
  class Autopilot{
    constructor(seeds, interval=200){this.seeds=seeds; this.interval=interval; this.active=false; this.timeoutId=null;}
    toggle(){this.active=!this.active; const btn=document.getElementById('autopilot-btn'); if(btn) btn.classList.toggle('autopilot-on',this.active); if(this.active){utils.logActivity('[Autopilot] Activated.'); this.run();} else {utils.logActivity('[Autopilot] Deactivated.'); if(this.timeoutId) clearTimeout(this.timeoutId); this.timeoutId=null;}}
    run(){if(!this.active) return; this.seeds.forEach(s=>{if(s.status!=='COMPLETE' && s.status!=='PAUSED') s.updateProgress(Math.random()*10);}); this.timeoutId=setTimeout(()=>this.run(), this.interval);}
    setInterval(newInterval){this.interval=newInterval;}
  }

  // ---------------- MAX-PRO / FLASH MODE ----------------
  const maxPro={ active:false, intervalBackup:200, toggle(seeds, autopilot){ this.active=!this.active; const btn=document.getElementById('max-pro-btn'); if(btn) btn.classList.toggle('active',this.active); if(this.active){utils.logActivity('[MAX-PRO] Flash mode activated! All seeds turbocharged.'); this.intervalBackup=autopilot.interval; autopilot.setInterval(10); if(!autopilot.active) autopilot.toggle(); seeds.forEach(s=>s.updateProgress(Math.random()*20)); } else { utils.logActivity('[MAX-PRO] Flash mode deactivated. Restoring normal speed.'); autopilot.setInterval(this.intervalBackup);}}};

  // ---------------- MISSION & FIREWORKS ----------------
  let missionCompleteTimer=null;
  function triggerMissionOverlay(){ if(missionCompleteTimer) return; const overlay=document.getElementById('mission-overlay'); if(!overlay)return; overlay.style.display='flex'; overlay.style.opacity=0; setTimeout(()=>overlay.style.opacity=1,10); missionCompleteTimer=setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.opacity=0; setTimeout(()=>{overlay.style.display='none'; missionCompleteTimer=null;},500); spawnFireworks();},2000);}
  function spawnFireworks(){ for(let i=0;i<30;i++){ const sparkle=document.createElement('div'); sparkle.className='sparkle'; sparkle.style.left=Math.random()*window.innerWidth+'px'; sparkle.style.top=Math.random()*window.innerHeight+'px'; document.body.appendChild(sparkle); setTimeout(()=>sparkle.remove(),700);}}

  // ---------------- INITIALIZATION ----------------
  const seedsContainer=document.getElementById('seeds-container'); const seeds=[];
  if(seedsContainer){for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){const s=new Seed(i); s.createCard(seedsContainer); seeds.push(s);}}
  const buddySystem=new BuddySystem(seeds); buddySystem.pairAll();
  const autopilot=new Autopilot(seeds,200);
  utils.loadState(seeds);

  // ---------------- CONTROLS ----------------
  const speedSlider=document.getElementById('speed-slider'); if(speedSlider) speedSlider.oninput=()=>autopilot.setInterval(Number(speedSlider.value));
  document.getElementById('launch-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>seeds.forEach(s=>s.start(Number(speedSlider?.value||200))));
  document.getElementById('pause-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.pause()); const resumeBtn=document.getElementById('resume-all-btn'); if(resumeBtn) resumeBtn.style.display='inline-block';});
  document.getElementById('resume-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{seeds.forEach(s=>s.resume(Number(speedSlider?.value||200))); const resumeBtn=document.getElementById('resume-all-btn'); if(resumeBtn) resumeBtn.style.display='none';});
  document.getElementById('reset-all-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>seeds.forEach(s=>s.reset()));
  document.getElementById('autopilot-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>autopilot.toggle());
  document.getElementById('max-pro-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>maxPro.toggle(seeds,autopilot));
  document.getElementById('export-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>utils.download(JSON.stringify(seeds.map(s=>s.logs)),'rising_phoenix_logs.json'));
  document.getElementById('copy-js-btn')?.addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.querySelector('script').innerText); alert('JS Seed copied!');}catch{alert('Clipboard copy failed.')}});

  document.getElementById('soul-test-btn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>utils.logActivity('[SOUL TEST] Sample lesson generated: Lorem Ipsum + Narrative'));

  // ---------------- CHEAT SHEET ----------------
  const cheatSheet=document.getElementById('cheat-sheet'); 
  if(cheatSheet){ 
    const btn=document.createElement('button'); 
    btn.innerText='Toggle Cheat Sheet'; 
    btn.onclick=()=>{cheatSheet.style.display=cheatSheet.style.display==='none'?'block':'none'; btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',cheatSheet.style.display==='block');};
    cheatSheet.parentNode.insertBefore(btn,cheatSheet);
  }

  // ---------------- LESSON MODULE ----------------
  const lessonInput=document.getElementById('lesson-input');
  const lessonSubmitBtn=document.getElementById('lesson-submit-btn');
  const lessonFeedback=document.getElementById('lesson-feedback');

  lessonSubmitBtn?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const text=lessonInput.value.trim();
    if(!text){ lessonFeedback.innerText='Please write something about your passion!'; return; }

    // Simple "evaluation" logic: check key vocab and idioms
    const keyWords=['passion','hobby','interest','favorite','goal'];
    const idioms=['follow your heart','in the zone','burning curiosity'];
    let score=0;
    keyWords.forEach(w=>{if(text.toLowerCase().includes(w)) score+=1;});
    idioms.forEach(id=>{if(text.toLowerCase().includes(id)) score+=2;});
    lessonFeedback.innerText=`Score: ${score} / ${keyWords.length + idioms.length}. Great work! Keep going!`;
  });

  utils.logActivity('[Rising Phoenix Protocol + Lesson Module] System ready.');
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
