        hobby: { def: "An activity done regularly in one's leisure time for pleasure.", trans: "Sở thích: Một hoạt động được thực hiện thường xuyên trong thời gian rảnh để giải trí." }
    };
    
    // --- Utility Functions ---
    function setFeedback(elId, message, type = 'success') {
        const el = document.getElementById(elId);
        if (!el) return;
        el.textContent = message;
        el.className = feedback ${type} show;
    }
    
    function shuffleArray(array) {
        for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
            [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
        }
        return array;
    }

    // --- Progress & Persistence (JUICE #1) ---
    async function updateLessonProgress(task, value = true) {
        if (lessonProgress[task] === value) return; // No change
        
        lessonProgress[task] = value;
        
        let completedTasks = 0;
        if (lessonProgress.game1) completedTasks++;
        if (lessonProgress.game2) completedTasks++;
        if (lessonProgress.writing) completedTasks++;
        
        const percentage = Math.round((completedTasks / lessonProgress.totalTasks) * 100);
        const progressBar = document.getElementById('lesson-progress-bar');
        
        progressBar.style.width = percentage + '%';
        progressBar.textContent = percentage + '%';
        
        document.getElementById('stat-game1').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game1);
        document.getElementById('stat-game1').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game1 ? '✓' : '○';
        
        document.getElementById('stat-game2').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game2);
        document.getElementById('stat-game2').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game2 ? '✓' : '○';
        
        document.getElementById('stat-writing').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.writing);
        document.getElementById('stat-writing').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.writing ? '✓' : '○';
        
        if (percentage === 100) {
            document.getElementById('global-mission-complete').style.display = 'block';
            progressBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--cyan) 100%)';
        }
        
        // Save to Firestore
        await saveProgressToFirestore();
    }
    
    async function saveProgressToFirestore() {
        if (!db || !userId) return;
        const { getFirestore, doc, setDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-firestore.js');
        
        const progressRef = doc(db, artifacts/${appId}/users/${userId}/${lessonDocId});
        try {
            await setDoc(progressRef, lessonProgress, { merge: true });
            document.getElementById('diag-firestore-state').textContent = 'Saved';
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Firestore save error: ", e);
            document.getElementById('diag-firestore-state').textContent = 'Save Error';
        }
    }

    async function loadProgressFromFirestore() {
        if (!db || !userId) return;
        const { getFirestore, doc, getDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-firestore.js');
        
        const progressRef = doc(db, artifacts/${appId}/users/${userId}/${lessonDocId});
        try {
            const docSnap = await getDoc(progressRef);
            if (docSnap.exists()) {
                const loadedProgress = docSnap.data();
                // Merge loaded progress with defaults
                lessonProgress = { ...lessonProgress, ...loadedProgress };
                // Manually trigger a UI update based on loaded data
                updateLessonProgress('game1', lessonProgress.game1);
                updateLessonProgress('game2', lessonProgress.game2);
                updateLessonProgress('writing', lessonProgress.writing);
                
                // Show completed missions if loaded
                if (lessonProgress.game1) document.getElementById('mission-complete-1').style.display = 'block';
                if (lessonProgress.game2) document.getElementById('mission-complete-2').style.display = 'block';
                if (lessonProgress.writing) {
                     setFeedback('writing-feedback', 'AI feedback submitted and saved.', 'success');
                }

                document.getElementById('diag-firestore-state').textContent = 'Loaded';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('diag-firestore-state').textContent = 'No data, saving default.';
                await saveProgressToFirestore(); // Save the default state
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Firestore load error: ", e);
            document.getElementById('diag-firestore-state').textContent = 'Load Error';
        }
    }

    // --- Vocab Module ---
    function createVocabList() {
        const container = document.getElementById('vocab-list-container');
        if (!container) return;
        container.innerHTML = '';
        for (const [word, data] of Object.entries(vocabData)) {
            const item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'vocab-item';
            item.textContent = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1);
            item.setAttribute('role', 'button');
            item.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

            const details = document.createElement('div');
            details.className = 'vocab-details';

            const definition = document.createElement('div');
            definition.className = 'definition';
            definition.textContent = '📖 ' + data.def;
            definition.setAttribute('role', 'button');
            definition.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

            const translation = document.createElement('div');
            translation.className = 'translation';
            translation.textContent = '🇻🇳 ' + data.trans;

            definition.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const isVisible = translation.style.display === 'block';
                translation.style.display = isVisible ? 'none' : 'block';
            };
            
            // A11y
            definition.onkeypress = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); definition.onclick(e); }};

            details.appendChild(definition);
            details.appendChild(translation);
            item.appendChild(details);

            const toggleVocab = () => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.vocab-item.active').forEach(activeItem => {
                    if (activeItem !== item) {
                        activeItem.classList.remove('active');
                        activeItem.querySelector('.translation').style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
                item.classList.toggle('active');
                if (!item.classList.contains('active')) {
                    translation.style.display = 'none';
                }
            };

            item.onclick = toggleVocab;
            item.onkeypress = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggleVocab(); }};

            container.appendChild(item);
        }
    }

    // --- Writing Module (JUICE #2) ---
    function initWritingPrompt() {
        const input = document.getElementById('writing-prompt-input');
        const countEl = document.getElementById('word-count');
        const submitBtn = document.getElementById('writing-prompt-submit');
        const feedbackEl = document.getElementById('writing-feedback');
        
        if (!input || !countEl || !submitBtn || !feedbackEl) return;

        input.addEventListener('input', () => {
            const text = input.value.trim();
            const wordCount = text.length > 0 ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
            countEl.textContent = wordCount + ' words';
            countEl.classList.toggle('sufficient', wordCount >= 20);
        });

        submitBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            const userText = input.value.trim();
            
            if (userText.length < 10) {
                setFeedback('writing-feedback', 'Please write a more thoughtful answer before submitting.', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            setFeedback('writing-feedback', 'Submitting to AI-PET for analysis... Please wait.', 'loading');
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('diag-api-status').textContent = 'Pending...';

            const systemPrompt = You are an encouraging Grade 12 English teacher (Obi). Your tone is positive and constructive. The student is answering a critical thinking prompt.
            
            Prompt: "Based on the reading, how did Maria's passion and her ambition differ? How did one fuel the other?"
            
            Reading: "Maria wasn't just a mechanic... Her passion was restoring classic cars... This wasn't just a job; it was her ambition. Her commitment to perfection and her relentless drive... fueled by pure enthusiasm. This motivation, born from a deep love for her craft, is what separates a career from a calling."

            Your task:
            1. Briefly praise the student's effort.
            2. Analyze their response based on the prompt (distinction between passion/internal and ambition/external).
            3. Provide one piece of specific, constructive feedback.
            4. Keep the entire response under 80 words.
            5. Do not use markdown. Respond in plain text.;
            
            const userQuery = Analyze this student's response: "${userText}";

            try {
                const aiFeedback = await callGeminiAPI(systemPrompt, userQuery);
                setFeedback('writing-feedback', aiFeedback, 'success');
                document.getElementById('diag-api-status').textContent = 'Success';
                await updateLessonProgress('writing', true);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("Gemini API Error:", error);
                setFeedback('writing-feedback', 'Error connecting to the AI. Please try again later.', 'error');
                document.getElementById('diag-api-status').textContent = Error: ${error.message};
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }

    async function callGeminiAPI(systemPrompt, userQuery, retries = 3, delay = 1000) {
        const payload = {
            contents: [{ parts: [{ text: userQuery }] }],
            systemInstruction: {
                parts: [{ text: systemPrompt }]
            },
        };

        for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(GEMINI_API_URL + API_KEY, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(API Error: ${response.status});
                }

                const result = await response.json();
                const text = result.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
                
                if (text) {
                    return text;
                } else {
                    throw new Error("Invalid AI response structure.");
                }
            } catch (error) {
                if (i === retries - 1) {
                    throw error; // Last retry failed
                }
                await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, delay * (i + 1)));
            }
        }
    }


    // --- Game 1: Vocab Scramble ---
    function initScrambleGame() {
        if (lessonProgress.game1) {
            document.getElementById('mission-complete-1').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        const container = document.getElementById('gameContainer1');
        const feedbackEl = document.getElementById('game-feedback-1');
        if (!container || !feedbackEl) return;
        
        let words = shuffleArray(Object.keys(vocabData)).slice(0, 3); // 3-word game
        let currentWordIndex = 0;

        function scrambleWord(word) {
            let a = word.split(""), n = a.length;
            for(let i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                let j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
            }
            return (a.join("") === word) ? scrambleWord(word) : a.join(""); // Ensure it's scrambled
        }

        function createScrambleUI() {
            if (currentWordIndex >= words.length) {
                document.getElementById('mission-complete-1').style.display = 'block';
                container.innerHTML = '';
                setFeedback('game-feedback-1', 'Module 1 Complete!', 'success');
                updateLessonProgress('game1', true);
                return;
            }
            
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const word = words[currentWordIndex];
            const scrambled = scrambleWord(word);

            const p = document.createElement('p');
            p.textContent = Unscramble this word:;
            p.style.color = "var(--gold)";
            p.style.fontWeight = "bold";
            p.style.fontSize = "1.2em";
            p.style.textAlign = "center";
            
            const h3 = document.createElement('h3');
            h3.textContent = scrambled;
            h3.style.color = "var(--cyan)";
            h3.style.letterSpacing = "2px";
            h3.style.textAlign = "center";
            h3.style.fontSize = "1.5em";
            
            const input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'text';
            input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Unscramble your answer');
            input.id = 'scramble-input';

            const button = document.createElement('button');
            button.textContent = 'Check Answer';
            button.onclick = () => {
                const answer = document.getElementById('scramble-input').value;
                if (answer.toLowerCase() === word.toLowerCase()) {
                    setFeedback('game-feedback-1', 'Correct!', 'success');
                    currentWordIndex++;
                    setTimeout(createScrambleUI, 1000);
                } else {
                    setFeedback('game-feedback-1', 'Try again.', 'error');
                }
            };
            
            container.append(p, h3, input, button);
        }
        createScrambleUI();
    }
    
    // --- Game 2: Definition Match ---
    function initMatchGame() {
        if (lessonProgress.game2) {
            document.getElementById('mission-complete-2').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        const container = document.getElementById('gameContainer2');
        const feedbackEl = document.getElementById('game-feedback-2');
        if (!container || !feedbackEl) return;
        
        container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear
        
        const gameWords = shuffleArray(Object.keys(vocabData)).slice(0, 4); // 4-pair game
        const definitions = gameWords.map(word => ({ id: word, text: vocabData[word].def }));
        const words = gameWords.map(word => ({ id: word, text: word }));

        shuffleArray(definitions);
        shuffleArray(words);

        let selectedWord = null;
        let selectedDef = null;
        let matchedCount = 0;
        
        const gameEl = document.createElement('div');
        gameEl.className = 'match-game-container';
        
        const wordCol = document.createElement('div');
        wordCol.className = 'match-col';
        wordCol.innerHTML = '<div class="match-col-header">Words</div>';
        
        const defCol = document.createElement('div');
        defCol.className = 'match-col';
        defCol.innerHTML = '<div class="match-col-header">Definitions</div>';

        function checkMatch() {
            if (!selectedWord || !selectedDef) return;

            if (selectedWord.dataset.id === selectedDef.dataset.id) {
                // Match
                selectedWord.classList.add('matched');
                selectedDef.classList.add('matched');
                selectedWord.classList.remove('selected');
                selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');
                setFeedback('game-feedback-2', 'Match found!', 'success');
                matchedCount++;
            } else {
                // Mismatch
                selectedWord.classList.remove('selected');
                selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');
                setFeedback('game-feedback-2', 'Not a match. Try again.', 'error');
            }
            
            selectedWord = null;
            selectedDef = null;
            
            if (matchedCount === gameWords.length) {
                document.getElementById('mission-complete-2').style.display = 'block';
                setFeedback('game-feedback-2', 'Module 2 Complete!', 'success');
                updateLessonProgress('game2', true);
            }
        }

        words.forEach(word => {
            const item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'match-item';
            item.textContent = word.text;
            item.dataset.id = word.id;
            item.onclick = () => {
                if (item.classList.contains('matched')) return;
                if (selectedWord) selectedWord.classList.remove('selected');
                selectedWord = item;
                item.classList.add('selected');
                checkMatch();
            };
            wordCol.appendChild(item);
        });
        
        definitions.forEach(def => {
            const item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'match-item';
            item.textContent = def.text;
            item.dataset.id = def.id;
            item.onclick = () => {
                if (item.classList.contains('matched')) return;
                if (selectedDef) selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');
                selectedDef = item;
                item.classList.add('selected');
                checkMatch();
            };
            defCol.appendChild(item);
        });

        gameEl.append(wordCol, defCol);
        container.appendChild(gameEl);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. LAUNCH PROTOCOL (MAIN EXECUTION)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    async function launchProtocol() {
        
        // --- 1. Inject CSS ---
        const styleTag = document.createElement('style');
        styleTag.id = 'plex-v11-styles';
        styleTag.textContent = v11_CSS;
        document.head.appendChild(styleTag);

        // --- 2. Inject HTML ---
        // Create a container for the lesson
        const lessonContainer = document.createElement('div');
        lessonContainer.id = 'plex-v11-root';
        lessonContainer.innerHTML = v11_HTML;
        // Clear the body and append the lesson
        document.body.innerHTML = '';
        document.body.appendChild(lessonContainer);
        document.body.style.background = "var(--bg-dark)"; // Ensure body bg matches

        document.getElementById('diag-app-id').textContent = appId;
        
        // --- 3. Initialize Firebase ---
        try {
            const { initializeApp } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-app.js');
            const { getAuth, signInAnonymously, signInWithCustomToken } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-auth.js');
            const { getFirestore, setLogLevel } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-firestore.js');
            
            // Use __firebase_config from global scope
            const firebaseConfig = JSON.parse(__firebase_config);
            const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
            db = getFirestore(app);
            auth = getAuth(app);
            setLogLevel('debug'); // Per mandate

            // Sign in
            if (typeof __initial_auth_token !== 'undefined') {
                await signInWithCustomToken(auth, __initial_auth_token);
            } else {
                await signInAnonymously(auth);
            }
            
            userId = auth.currentUser?.uid || crypto.randomUUID();
            document.getElementById('diag-status').textContent = 'Firebase Authenticated';
            document.getElementById('diag-user-id').textContent = userId;

            // --- 4. Load Persistent Progress ---
            await loadProgressFromFirestore();
            
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Firebase Init Error:", e);
            document.getElementById('diag-status').textContent = 'Firebase Error';
            document.getElementById('diag-firestore-state').textContent = 'Offline';
            // Continue without persistence
        }

        // --- 5. Initialize Modules ---
        createVocabList();
        initScrambleGame();
        initMatchGame();
        initWritingPrompt();
        
        console.log("[PLEX PROTOCOL V11] Final JS Seed executed. Lesson is live.");
    }
    
    // Check if the host page has included Firebase
    if (typeof __firebase_config !== 'undefined' && typeof __app_id !== 'undefined') {
        launchProtocol();
    } else {
        console.error("[PLEX V11] FAILED TO LAUNCH: Host page is missing '__firebase_config' or '__app_id'.");
        // Fallback: render without persistence
        // launchProtocol(); // Or just fail completely
    }

})();

            div.textContent = lesson.title;
            if (this.completedLessons.includes(lesson.id)) div.classList.add('completed');
            div.onclick = () => this.completeLesson(lesson.id, div);
            container.appendChild(div);
        });
    }

    completeLesson(lessonId, element) {

            this.completedLessons.push(lessonId);
            element.classList.add('completed');

    }
}

class AIPetModule {

        this.name = name;
        this.happiness = 50;
        this.energy = 50;
        this.hunger = 50;

    }

    play() {
        this.happiness = Math.min(this.happiness + 10, 100);
        this.energy = Math.max(this.energy - 5, 0);
        this.hunger = Math.min(this.hunger + 5, 100);
        this.updateUI();
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('happiness').textContent = this.happiness;
        document.getElementById('energy').textContent = this.energy;
        document.getElementById('hunger').textContent = this.hunger;

        const petImg = document.getElementById('petImg');
        if (this.happiness > 75) petImg.src = 'assets/pet_happy.png';
        else if (this.happiness < 25) petImg.src = 'assets/pet_sad.png';
        else petImg.src = 'assets/pet_idle.png';
    }
}

// =======================
class LessonLauncher{
    constructor(){
        this.lessons = lessonSnippets;
        this.completed = [];
        this.render();
    }
    render(){
        const container = document.getElementById('lessonList');
        container.innerHTML = '';
        this.lessons.forEach(lesson=>{
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = lesson.title;
            div.className='lesson-card';
            if(this.completed.includes(lesson.id)) div.classList.add('completed');
            div.onclick=()=>this.completeLesson(lesson.id,div);
            container.appendChild(div);
        });
    }
    completeLesson(id,el){
        if(!this.completed.includes(id)){
            this.completed.push(id);
            el.classList.add('completed');
            this.updateProgress();
            AIPet.feed(id);
            AIPet.gainXP(10);
        }
    }
    updateProgress(){
        const percent = Math.floor((this.completed.length/this.lessons.length)*100);
        document.getElementById('progressText').textContent=`${percent}%`;
        document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width=`${percent}%`;
    }
}

// AI-Pet

            alert('Mini-game fail. Happiness -5');
        }
        this.updateUI();
    }
    gainXP(amount){
        this.xp+=amount;
        if(this.xp>=this.level*50){
            this.levelUp();
        }
        this.updateUI();
    }
    levelUp(){
        this.level++;
        this.xp=0;

        alert(`Aurora leveled up! Now Level ${this.level}`);

    playGame(gameIndex){

        this.energy=Math.max(this.energy-energyCost,0);

        this.updateUI();
        alert(`Game played! XP +${xpReward}, Happiness +${happinessChange}, Energy -${energyCost}`);
    }

        document.getElementById('hunger').textContent=this.hunger;

    }
}

        feedback.textContent = 'Please write at least 20 words.'; feedback.className = 'feedback warn'; log('writing:too_short'); return;

        const fb = aiPet.generateFeedback(text);
        feedback.textContent = fb; feedback.className = 'feedback ok';
        state.progress.writing = true; saveState(); updateProgressUI(); log('writing:submitted', { length: text.split(/\s+/).length });
      }, 600);
    });

    exportBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { const out = exportState(); const blob = new Blob([out], {type:'application/json'}); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'launchpad_state.json'; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); log('export:state'); });

    const words = shuffle(Object.keys(vocabData)).slice(0,3);

    function render() {
